1.l: Puff the Fractal Dragon is here, contemplating a higher reality.

items_sold.name: an electric couch made of molten plastic

2.l: Abishai, Ayesha's siamese cat, paces around fretfully.

3.l: Test, the testing mob is here... testing.

4.l: An aged man stands here, selling used souls.
4.d:
A grey goatee matches tangled shoulder-length hair. An aura of great
power surrounds him.

5.l: A generic prototype stands here, waiting for an identity.
5.d:
This is a generic prototype, meant to be used with string
for the amusement of the Gods.

6.d: She's almost as pretty as Ayesha.

7.l: A lunatic stands here, raving about the moon.
7.d:
He's human, but only barely. Blood coats his nails, obviously from the
damage he's inflicted on his own body. Tattered rags cover his body, which
although thin, professes the strength of madness.

8.l: An old man carrying a bundle of staves and wands stands here.
8.d:
He looks like a half-elf, and has a very dour expression on his face. Perhaps
he is tired of selling his goods (or services?)
8.noise: Someone yells out, "Recharge your staves here! Recharge your wands!"

spw.name: The Immortal Map Room of Haven

9.l: A flaming skull floats in midair here.
9.d:
It's a human skull from which flames shoot forth brightly. It's magickal
existance in this plane seems tenuous at best, or it shimmers as if it was
about to disappear at any second.

10.l: A zombie stares mindlessly into space.
10.d:
The zombie appears fragile. Its grey-green flesh looks soft and even its bones
seem brittle. Its eyes are dark, empty pits that somehow seem to see anyway. The
zombie's lips and cheeks have shrunk, revealing large, crooked teeth. Its hands
end in sharp, talonlike nails that bear little resemblance to a normal persons
fingernails.
10.noise: A strong, rotting stench fills the air.

23.d:
It is a huge brown and black roach, much like it's smaller counterpart.  But
you can not squash this one with your boot.  It appears to be searching for
food.  You best be careful of this beast.

30.l: A lost adventurer wanders aimlessly past you.
30.d:
He looks rather tired and worn out and seems to have no idea where he is
or where he's going. He has a small satchel at his side and it looks as
though there's something in it.

31.l: A black void senses you and moves towards you.
31.d:
You're not even sure what you're seeing is there, but the thing before you
is quite real and it looks like it's found you. It knows nothing but death
and destroys all within its path.
31.noise: The sky grows dark and you shiver uncomfortably.

32.s: Galeru, the Master of the Elements
32.l: A giant rainbow snake coils itself around you.
32.d:
The snake is enormous! Towering well above you, the snake peers at you with
sheer disdain. It is the one, the master, the creator of all and you are
but a small part of that.

33.k: mordraneth stealer souls black cloaked figure
33.d:
A skeletal figure peers back at you, a glowing ball of fire in its right
hand. Its eyes seem to bury deep within your soul and you shiver as you feel
your life force slip away. Best you leave it alone...

34.l: A figure moves silently in the shadows, his body covered with weapons.
34.d:
You can't see him very well, he prefers the darkness before striking at his
prey. You want to hope it's not you...

66.l: A big black demon glares at you.
66.d:
He's big with horns and glowing red eyes.
The number 666 is tattooed into his forehead.
He looks like someone your mother would probably date.

70.l: Satan Klaus sings, "Slay Bells Ring, Are Ya Listening?"
70.d:
Satan Klaus looks a little bit like Adolf Hitler 
in a big red suit. He has a VERY evil grin on his
face.

71.l: Death Dealer looks you over coldly.
71.d:
A tall, otherworldly man in jet black armor with a sinister lochaber.
Death Dealer wanders the world in search of souls for his
demonic masters.

81.l: A large animated rock in the shape of a man stands here.
81.d:
Summoned from the plane of elemental Earth, this elemental has been bound
to this plane by powerful magicks. The elemental can barely conceal the
rage in its cold, stone eyes.

82.l: A waterspout about the size of a man whirls about.
82.d:
Summoned from the elemental plane of Water, this elemental has been
bound to this plane by powerful magicks.

83.d:
Summoned from the elemental plane of Air, this elemental has been
bound to this plane by powerful magicks.

84.l: A column of living fire twists and burns everything in its path.
84.d:
This elemental has been summoned from the elemental plane of Fire.
It has been bound to this plane by powerful magicks.

85.l: A glorious Angel in full battle dress stands before you.
85.d:
This is a Dominion Angel, the race of Angels that are sent to the material world to aid
the mortal servants of their eldrich masters. He looks very solemn and holy.

86.l: A evil looking Angel dressed in full battle array stands before you.
86.d:
This is Angel belongs to the Dominion, a class of Angels sent to the material world to
further their masters goals. He looks and smells of Death.

87.l: Tymora, Mistress of the 8th Dimension, looks at you in disdain.
87.d:
Tymora is a beautiful half-demon, with nut-brown skin and amber eyes. Legend
holds her to be the first of the succubi, it is said that her vagina is a
many-toothed maw capable of devouring men whole.

10021.l: An angry spectator doesn't look very happy with the game's results.
10021.d:
Wearing the colors of the losing team, he looks extremely pissed. Better not
do anything to offend him.

10022.l: A depressed spectator looks like he's ready to go home.
10022.d:
Wearing the colors of the losing team, he acts like life just isn't worth
living anymore.

10023.l: An excited spectator cheers loudly with approval.
10023.d: Wearing the colors of the winning team, he's one happy go-lucky kind of guy.

10024.l: A joyful spectator is dancing in the aisles.
10024.d: Wearing the colors of the winning team, he's as happy as happy can be.

10025.l: A dedicated spectator is here, as usual.
10025.d:
Fully dressed in the colors of his favorite team, he even has all of his
exposing skin and hair painted to those colors.

10026.l: A loud spectator shouts at the top of his lungs.
10026.d:
You can't tell which team he's on, but you're sure that he's the most 
obnoxious person you've ever met.

10027.l: A fierce lion comes at you with a roar of hunger.
10027.d:
Saliva drips from his gaping jaws, and the bones showing through his silky
fur tell you that he's been starved for just this occasion: a chance to eat 
you.

10028.l: A lioness leaps at you with outstretched claws.
10028.d:
She's a beautiful animal, but her captors have transformed her into a man-
eater.. and a dwarf-eater, and an elf-eater, and...

10029.l: Targ the troll gladiator stands here, grinning at you.
10029.d:
Standing over 7 feet tall, Targ has been trained to kill. To kill you, in 
particular.

10030.l: Elrik, the elven warrior looks like he's ready to rumble.
10030.d:
His frail seeming features and general delicate appearance give many 
misconceptions as to his prowess in combat. Do not be misled.

11000.l: The brown dragon rises up from the sand!
11000.d:
This wingless dragon is covered in craggy scales that seem to blend into the
sand around him. Razor sharp teeth are honed to the point that tearing your
flesh from your bones is child's play.

11001.l: The blue dragon is here, watching you with sparkling eyes.
11001.d:
Covered in deep indigo scales, the blue dragon roars at you through a mouth
full of glistening fangs. A sharp row of small horns starts at the tip of his
snout and morph into rigid fins as they head down the back of his neck. The
great wyrm seems infuriated at your presence.

spw.name: The Lair of the Blue Dragon

drp.name: a necklace of blue dragon scales

11002.l: The brass dragon lunges at you from across the room.
11002.d:
Covered in burnished scales, the brass dragon has made the abandoned citadel
his home, and is not happy you have entered it. A long tongue snakes from his
mouth, and sharp talons claw the air.
11002.noise: The floor shakes beneath your feet.

11004.l: An enormous sphinx is here, resting on a pedestal.
11004.d: It appears to be living marble, and pays little attention to you.

11005.l: Draco, the First Desert Raider, scours the desert for souls.
11005.d:
He seems to be little more than a rotting skeleton, held together by strong
forces of magic. Fire glows in his empty eye sockets as he looks for souls
to steal.  Little is left of recognition of this once mighty commander of
Drakaan's desert raiders.

11006.l: Sabbat, the Second Desert Raider, scours the desert for souls.
11006.d:
She seems to be little more than a rotting skeleton, held together by strong
forces of magic. Fire glows in her empty eye sockets as she looks for souls
to steal. A mangled bloody ribbon tied to her belt reads "Drakaan".

11007.l: Daemon, the Third Desert Raider, scours the desert for souls.
11007.d:
He seems to be little more than a rotting skeleton, held together by strong
forces of magic. Fire glows in his empty eye sockets as he looks for souls
to steal.  Little is left of recognition of this once mighty commander of
Drakaan's desert raiders.

11008.l: Malleus, the Fourth Desert Raider, scours the desert for souls.
11008.d:
He seems to be little more than a rotting skeleton, held together by strong
forces of magic. Fire glows in his empty eye sockets as he looks for souls
to steal.  Little is left of recognition of this once mighty commander of
Drakaan's desert raiders.

11009.l: A landshark searches the desert for something edible.
11009.d:
Covered in blue-grey stoney plates, the bulette (also known as a
landshark) will eat anything, and decides to start with you.

11010.l: A giant tarantula skitters under the sand as you pass.
11010.d:
It's a big hairy arachnid that is probably more scared of you than you are of
it.

11011.l: A gigantic beholder floats amid probing eyestalks.
11011.d:
Nearly twice the size of other beholders, the Ultimate fills the room. Eyes
probe you from the end of long stalks attached to the Ultimate's body, and a
cavernous mouth drips saliva from between rows of sharp teeth.

11012.l: A headless spirit searches for new trophies.
11012.d:
Wait! it DOES have a head... it's tucked under its arm. No, wait again.. 
that's someone else's head.

11013.l: A stalactite grows from the cave ceiling.
11013.d: The piercer looks like a sentinent stalactite, intent on puncturing your skull.

11014.l: An umber hulk burrows through the earth.
11014.d:
The umber hulk looks like a humanoid ant.. huge mandibles on a squat body.
Long, stone-hard claws used for breaking up rock are just as easily used
for breaking apart your bones.

11015.l: A female umber hulk is building a nest here.
11015.d:
The umber hulk looks like a humanoid ant.. huge mandibles on a squat body.
Long, stone-hard claws used for breaking up rock are just as easily used
for breaking apart your bones.

11016.s: Drakaan, Leader of the Desert Raiders
11016.l: Drakaan, Leader of the Desert Raiders stands here in a pool of his own blood.
11016.d:
Drakaan has obviously been here for a long time, and been dead for the
majority of that time. Betrayed by Sabbat and the other desert raiders,
Drakaan called down a curse from the gods. The gods saw fit to punish all
the raiders for their unjust ways.. and turned them all into living corpses.
Sabbat and her companions fled into the desert.. after hacking Drakaan to
pieces and burning enough of him to leave Drakaan barely in existence.
Drakaan lived on as a broken undead being; barely able to kill the few
foolish mortals who stumbled upon him.

11017.l: A roper larva writhes in anticipation of hot blood.
11017.d:
This newly-hatched roper is still in the larvic stage. Three tendrils stretch
out of the central slug-like mass and flail about madly for the blood the
creature sense flowing in your veins.

11018.l: The vodyanoi attacks from beneath the surface of the pool.
11018.d:
It looks like something out of a nightmare... Huge mandibles on a scaled
body that looks almost humanoid. Powerful claws sprout out the edge of
webbed paws.

11019.l: The vengeful spirit of a Knight of Solamnia floats about.
11019.d:
It resents your intrusion into its home; resents your trespassing on its
last resting place; and most of all resents your life where it has none.

11020.l: A rakshasa eyes you with a cold hatred before attacking.
11020.d:
It's a humanoid tiger, dressed in male clothes. His hatred for humanity knows
no bounds, and your presence in his village angers him more.

drp.name: a set of fine silk slippers

11021.l: A rakshasi consort awaits orders from her master.
11021.d:
It's a humanoid tiger, dressed in female clothes. Her loyalty is with the
maharajah and she will do as he commands. Her hatred for humanity knows no
bounds, and your presence in her village angers her more.

drp.name: a set of fine silk slippers

11022.l: A rakshasa ruhk draws his weapon and attacks.
11022.d:
It's a humanoid tiger, dressed in intricate armor. Sworn to defend his leader,
the maharajah, you seem only a minor threat, but still a threat.

11023.l: A rakshasa rajah signs an unholy symbol in the air.
11023.d:
It's a humanoid tiger, dressed in priestly robes. Sworn to uphold his faith,
he must kill you, or be killed, to appease his god.

11024.l: A rakshasa maharajah bellows for your destruction.
11024.d:
This seems to be the leader of the Rakshasa. Richly detailed armor covers
his body, and his sleek fur glints of perfumed oils. When he stands, he is
well over 8-feet-tall, and growls as he looks down on you. You may be his 
next meal.

11025.l: A saber-toothed tiger prowls restlessly guarding the village.
11025.d:
Fur as soft as velvet covers muscles as hard as iron. Long canine teeth
protrude from the tiger's mouth, and low growl issues from his throat. You get
the feeling he doesn't trust you.

11026.l: A black iron golem wanders about, mindlessly.
11026.d:
It's made out of.. iron. It's big, it's bad and it could probably kick your
ass with one hand smelted behind its back.

11027.l: A manscorpion warrior patrols the desert.
11027.d:
Part-human and part-scorpion, the manscorpion is a grotesque freak of
nature. A human torso sits atop a bony 6-legged arachnoid body. A barbed
hook twitches nervously at the end long tail.

11028.l: A manscorpion leader rallies his men.
11028.d:
Part-human and part-scorpion, the manscorpion is a grotesque freak of
nature. A human torso sits atop a bony 6-legged arachnoid body. A barbed
hook twitches nervously at the end long tail.

11029.l: A manscorpion mage stares into the void.
11029.d:
Part-human and part-scorpion, the manscorpion is a grotesque freak of
nature. A human torso sits atop a bony 6-legged arachnoid body. A barbed
hook twitches nervously at the end long tail.

11030.l: A rakshasa wizard won't trade with the likes of you.
11030.d:
It's a humanoid tiger, dressed in dark robes. He sells magic items to the
citizens in his village, but he would never deal with you. However, the idea
of killing you makes him happy.

11031.l: A rakshasa weaponsmith picks from an assortment of arms for one to use on you.
11031.d:
It's a humanoid tiger, dressed in black armor. He sells weapons to the
citizens in his village, but he would never deal with you. However, he will
gladly take your life.

11032.l: A small scorpion scurries under the sand as you approach.
11032.d:
It's about 4 inches long, with two inch-long pinchers. It's more scared of you
than you are of it.

11033.l: A giant scorpion lifts a venom-dripping stinger at you.
11033.d:
It's about as long as you are tall, and looks quite well protected under its
hard, chitinous carapace. A foot-long stinger drips deadly poison.

11034.l: A rakshasa cub growls at you, half-heartedly.
11034.d:
It seems a little more aware than a human baby of its size would be. Covered
in sleek fur, yet with fingers and toes instead of paws, it seems a shame
to kill such a defenseless creature. Maybe you'll do it anyway.

11035.d: It looks like.. a baby tiger.

11036.l: A dune stalker roams the desert, searching for its summoner.
11036.d:
It looks like a naked human, with clawed fingers and toes. It's bony
appearance belies its true nature as a creature of great strength.

11037.l: An enormous sphinx is here, resting on a pedestal.
11037.d: It appears to be living marble, and pays little attention to you.

11038.l: A minion of Serapis walks the land in search of souls for his master.
11038.d:
Sent by Serapis to search the land for threats to his rule... you
seem to qualify. Death by his hand will not be pretty.

11039.l: A skeletal dragon rises before you.
11039.d:
Covered in bony scales, this undead creature's only intent is to seal
your doom.

drp.name: the wickedly-sharp claws of a dracolich

11040.l: A young landshark searches the desert for something edible.
11040.d:
Covered in blue-grey stoney plates, the bulette (also known as a
landshark) will eat anything, and decides to start with you.

spw.name: A Dusty Road Through The Desert
The Gates of the Rakshasa Village

11041.l: An enormous sphinx is here, resting on a pedestal.
11041.d: It appears to be living marble, and pays little attention to you.

11042.l: An enormous sphinx is here, resting on a pedestal.
11042.d: It appears to be living marble, and pays little attention to you.

11700.l: A crystal golem lumbers by on an unknown errand.
11700.d: Almost transparent, the golem stomps around mindlessly.

11701.l: An enormous crystal shell houses a living flame.
11701.d: It looks to be a burning soul encased in crystal.

spw.name: On the Dais of the Crystal Flame
On the Dais of the Crystal Flame

11702.l: A wizened old man runs about madly.
11702.d:
A long flowing beard on his face is the same shade as the frazzled hair on his 
head.
You gather that his job is the upkeep of the eternal flames.

11703.l: A huge black bat claws at your eyes.
11703.d: It looks like a ferocious black rat with wings.

11704.l: A crystal golem lumbers by on an unknown errand.
11704.d: Almost transparent, the golem stomps around mindlessly.

11705.l: A crystal golem stares aimlessly into space.
11705.d: Almost transparent, the golem stomps around mindlessly.

11706.l: Two red eyes glow softly in the darkness.
11706.d:
The demon L'cath has escaped into this world.. and seems quite intent
upon remaining.

12100.l: A plump and jovial merchant hovers around you.
12100.d:
The merchant could stand to lose a few pounds as he lumbers his way towards
you, obviously happy to see a customer in the otherwise deserted store.
12100.noise: A merchant calls out, "Spices...spices for sale"

12101.l: A local fisherman smiles as you enter and asks you to look around.
12101.d:
Largo is one of the few local fisherman who has chosen to stay in Haven,
the majority sailing to more prosperous and safer areas. He is well built
and is quite capable of taking care of himself.

12102.l: Hansen, the owner of this store, welcomes you in with open arms.
12102.d:
A fairly prosperous merchant compared to others in Haven, Hansen is an
expert at shady deals and has gathered a variety of junk to sell to the
unaware adventurer.

12103.l: A huge beast lumbers towards you, angry at your intrusion.
12103.d:
Obtained from one of the remote islands, the beast before you is like nothing
you've seen before. It is large, will not reason with you, and definitely
looks like it can kill you.

12104.l: A guild member wanders by, planning his next journey.
12104.d: He looks deep in thought and doesn't pay any attention to you.

12105.k: flustered man repair public works officer talis
12105.l: A flustered man sits here, muttering something about repairs.
12105.d:
This guy is stressed! His sole responsibility is the upkeep of the town and
with the amount of visitors that journey here, the town certainly needs to
be kept in top condition.

12106.l: An old mariner sits at the desk offering to sell you a boat.
12106.d:
Once captain of his own ship, the retired mariner has been conditioned over
years spent at sea and despite his age is quite capable of defending himself.

12107.l: A store keeper rearranges a shipment of new barrels.
12107.d:
She moves with grace and ease, despite the fact that she is stronger and
bigger than many of the males in the town.

12108.l: A drunk sailor has collapsed on the mattress and is sleeping soundly.
12108.d:
He's rather large and it would have taken a number of rum shots to put him
in such a deep sleep. Do you really want to wake him up?

12109.l: A well tanned man stumbles around, spilling beer in the process.
12109.d: A weatherworn man who has probably spent more time on board a ship then dry land.

12110.l: The innkeeper walks around, serving drinks and cleaning tables.
12110.d:
The innkeeper smells as much of alcohol as do the patrons of the inn. He
works tirelessly for what must be days on end.
12110.noise: Many sets of eyes move with you as you wander around.

12111.l: An elven pirate sits calmly at the table examining her cards.
12111.d: She has traveled far and sacked a number of towns and villages.
12111.noise: A scuffle breaks out in the corner of the room.

12112.l: A large ogre sits at the table and is annoyed at your entrance.
12112.d:
He is here for one reason only...to win money. And you seem to have broken
his thinking process.

12113.l: An adventurer looks nervously at her cards.
12113.d:
Livian has explored the far reaches of the world and has unfortunately ended
up here.

12114.l: A large, nimble looking pirate gives you a toothy grin.
12114.d:
Bad mistake! Those who rape, pillage and loot for a profession do not like
to be recognized and unfortunately you now have an accurate description of
the pirate in front of you. He draws his cutlass with a grim smile and saunters
your way.

spw.name: Walking Down the Back Streets of Haven

12115.l: A seagull is scavenging for food here.
12115.d:
It's a loud, dirty, annoying bird, and you're tempted to give it a quick kick
in the tail-feathers.

12116.l: An officious looking man gives you a greasy smile as you enter his office.
12116.d:
Ulrich seems to be doing rather well for himself for a customs official.  His
smile makes you wonder if perhaps he can persuaded to look the other way while
you conduct your business.

12117.l: A strange, tiger-like humanoid looks at you arrogantly.
12117.d:
This must be one of the legendary rakshasas on a trading mission for his master.
The look he gives you is that of a calculating killer, but no one else seems
to look worried, maybe he's on a peaceful mission.

12118.l: A mischevious, elf-like woman stares at everything in wide-eyed wonder.
12118.d:
GROAN! Oh, no! It's a kender! You hastily check your belongings to make sure
everything is still in place.

12119.l: One of the local dock workers walks by, awaiting the next ship.
12119.d:
Years of loading and unloading ships has created the stevedore before you,
muscles bulging from his tattered clothes.

12120.l: A dwarven trader checks her coin purse as she heads for the nearest store.
12120.d:
Having traveled from afar on a mission known only to her, the trader gives
you a wide berth considering the amount of coins she must carry.

12121.l: A dark-haired man shoves his way through the crowds, maybe you should run.
12121.d:
Black Dog is a mean looking pirate with wrists as thick as your neck.
Maybe you better run.

drp.name: a set of sharp steel claws

12122.l: A slender cat-like creature sits quietly drinking in the corner.
12122.d:
The rakshasa merchant has traveled far to sell or perhaps buy goods from
Haven. Her yellow eyes stare right into your soul.

12123.l: A rowdy dock worker attempts to sing to an unknown tune.
12123.d:
He is probably more interested in making a fool of himself than worrying
about you, but he does look drunk enough to fly off the handle at any
given moment.
12123.noise: You can hear someone singing a drunken jig off-key.

12124.l: Fiona stands her in disgust, looking at the mess around her.
12124.d:
Having journeyed from afar, Fiona is a well renowned adventurer and is
definitely not impressed with the state of the room!

12125.l: A pirate captain glares at you with utter disdain.
12125.d:
Kataar has earned the reputation for the toughest, meanest and unfriendliest
human to walk the world or sail the seas. He has murdered as many people as
he has sacked cities and you are simply in his way...

12126.l: A large, ugly troll stands at the doorway to the south.
12126.d:
He is a big, ugly troll whose job it is to keep the ruffians and scabs out
of the gambling establishment to the south. He seems to enjoy his work,
smiling with large crooked teeth as he throws would-be patrons out of the
doorway.

spw.name: Walking Down the Back Streets of Haven

12127.l: A shady character eyes you from the shadows.
12127.d:
You're not sure what it is because of the cloak it has wrapped itself in,
but you do know that it has its eye on your coin purse.
12127.noise: A shout for help can be heard in the distance.

12128.l: The Harbor Master awaits the next ship.
12128.d:
Lars is a tall human in his early forties.  It is his responsibility to
ensure the safe loading and unloading of cargoes from the ships that
dock in Haven.

12129.s: a member of the port authority
12129.l: One of the port authorities wanders by, ensuring order is maintained.
12129.d:
These guards patrol the streets of Haven to maintain order in what could
easily become a lawless town.

drp.name: a pair of scale mail gloves
a pair of scale mail boots

12130.l: The Games Master roams the den, looking for thieves and cheats.
12130.d:
Hirto the Games Master is a big, ugly troll.  It's his job to catch
anyone stealing or cheating inside the casino.  Best not get caught
doing anything wrong... this guy could hurt you.

12131.l: A drunken floosy falls all over you.
12131.d:
She is a young girl with enormous breasts and a drunken flush across
her face.  She looks at you with glazed eyes and smiles coyly before
bursting out in a fit of giggles.

12132.l: A depressed man gambles away his life.
12132.d:
He looks sad and pathetic, his skin a dull grey and his eyes sunken from long
days and nights inside the casino.

12133.l: An old woman gambles away her life savings.
12133.d:
She just sits here, day after day, throwing all of her money away.
She doesn't acknowledge you or anyone else around her, seemingly cold
and isolated.

12200.l: A magical whirlpool is spinning through the water.
12200.d: A magical whirlpool is here, bearing people to far away places.

12201.l: A strange, amphibian-looking creature stalks you from the bushes.
12201.d:
The bullywug is covered with a smooth, mottled olive green hide. It's face
resembles that of a frog, with a wide mouth and large, bulbous eyes; it's
feet and hands are webbed.

12202.l: A large crocodile floats in the water here.
12202.d: It has a long, squat body and a jaw filled with sharp, conical teeth.

12203.l: A giant crocodile begins floating towards you, jaws glistening.

12204.l: A giant crayfish pops out of the water next to you.
12204.d:
It has a multi-plated shell, numerous legs, eyes set on stalks, and two wicked
pincers.

12205.l: A giant frog sits here, staring at you with bulging eyes.
12205.d: It looks like a normal frog, only this one is 6 feet long.

12206.l: A giant killer frog sits here, contemplating you as it's next meal.
12206.d:
It looks like a normal frog, except larger and with a mouth filled with sharp
teeth.

12207.l: A small man that looks like a frog is hiding here, eyeing you warily.
12207.d: Grippli resemble small, intelligent, humanoid tree frogs.

12208.l: A giant leech squirms around here, dreaming of it's next meal.
12208.d:
Giant leeches are horrid, slug-like creatures that dwell in wet, slimy areas
and suck the blood of warm-blooded creatures.

12209.l: A dark cloud moves under the water here, looking evil.
12209.d:
Almost as one body, the dark flitting shapes churn the water to a boil
trying to get to the blood that feeds them. Each one almost 6 inches in
length, this is the most leeches you've ever encountered.

12210.l: A small, toad-like man sits here, ready to hop.
12210.d:
Standing about three feet tall, this creature has a lower body that strongly
resembles that of a giant frog or toad, with powerful legs and large, webbed
feet. It's upper body, however, is more developed, with muscular forelimbs,
opposable thumbs, and a smaller, more humanoid looking head.

12211.l: The oddest thing you've ever seen is standing here.
12211.d:
A froghemoth has a yellowish underbelly; undersides of the rear legs and
tentacles are a pale yellowish color. Its sides are light green and its back
and upper legs and tentacles are mottled green. The ocular appendage is 
yellow-green, as are its 2 nostril stalks. Its eyeballs are amber with a
greenish tinge, and the slit, vertical pupils are bright green edged with
orange.

12212.l: A pile of mud moves slowly by.
12212.d:
The pile of mud has the vague shape of a bipedal figure. It slowly churns
the water as it passes through the area. Two eyes, dark as night, stare back
at you from a featureless face.

12213.l: A very small dinosaur is standing here.
12213.d:
This small creature resembles an upright gila monster. From the back of its
head protrudes a dorsal fin. It's standing here, chattering its teeth 
insanely fast. Wonder what it's up to?

12214.l: A swamp giant warrior stands here, eyeing you over.
12214.d:
This guy stands about nine feet tall and is wearing quite a bit of old,
rusted armor. On his hip is a well-used and well-rusted sword. He looks at
you with mild interest, probably because no one usually comes this deep into
the swamp.

12215.l: A turtle swims slowly through the water
12215.d:
A long slender neck extends from a stumpy, pointed shell. Its large eyes are
set back in its head, slightly behind its mouth. The mouth looks like a beak
with a sharp point aimed down on the very tip.

12216.l: A very large snapping turtle floats by lazily.
12216.d:
This turtle is huge. Its shell looks to be nearly four feet in diameter and
its neck extends about a foot out from under its armored carapace. It glances
in your direction and emits a loud hiss. It doesn't look like something to be
trifled with.

12217.l: A mosquito buzzes annoyingly around your head.
12217.d:
This mosquito is quite annoying. He looks like all the other ones, long legged
and has a nasty sucker on his nose.

12218.l: A very large mosquito buzzes by you.
12218.d:
This mosquito is HUGE. Its wingspan is at least three feet, its eyes glow
with an inner light and it seems as though an outer world intelligence guides
its movements.

12219.l: A funny looking larvae floats by you.
12219.d:
Its head barely sticks out of the muck surrounding you. A large set of eyes
protrude from small stalks, which reside right behind a large needle-looking
mouth.

12220.l: An old ssauran healer sits here, weary with age.
12220.d:
Lacking the stength to continue his journey, the healer has chosen this
location in which to practise his skills in what little time he has left.
Well adapted to the swamp, the healer is more than happy and you would do
well not to assume too much from his appearance.

12832.l: A treasure hunter stands here searching in vain for treasure.
12832.d:
He is very dirty and looks as though he hasn't seen the outside 
light in several months.

12848.l: A large demon knight stands before you looking for his next victim.
12848.d:
You are so repulsed by his looks that you almost can not bear to look 
at him.  He is a decaying corpse with pieces of putrid flesh hanging
loosely from his body.  There is blood dripping from many parts of him.
You gaze into his demonic eyes and you realize that he most certainly
means to kill you.  

>
The Demon Knight grins at you with a satanic grin.

12850.l: Indiana Jones stands here ready for action.
12850.d:
He stands up from a kneeling position and turns around to face you.
He is a man of about six feet in height and a medium build.  He looks
a little rough since he hasn't shaved in a couple of days.  He has a 
bullwhip in one hand and a glowing golden idol in the other.  He is 
wearing a leather jacket that is quite old and dirty.  His hat also 
has the same much-used look about it.  He looks at you but does not
say anything.

12868.l: A short skeleton with a satanic grin on his face stands here.
12868.d:
It appears to be a living, breathing skeleton.  The skeleton is short in
stature and stands there with an evil grin.  He would look quite harmless
were it not for that very large scythe that he is wielding in his right
hand.  You wonder how such a tiny creature could wield such a large and 
heavy weapon.

12870.l: A grave robber pops out of the shadows and attacks.
12870.d: He is a little upset that you are coming after his treasure.

12876.l: A statue stands here blocking your path.
12876.d:
It is made of solid gold as is much of this tomb.  The statue stands 
about 10 feet in height and appears to be looking down at you.  As you 
try to move past him he blocks your path and says, "None shall pass."

12877.l: The wise King Solomon stands here adorned in gold.
12877.d:
He looks to be about seven feet tall with a very big build.  You feel
dwarfed as you stand before this mighty king.  He projects an aura of
intelligence and wisdom greater than any that you have ever seen before.
His face wears the burdens of a very troubled man who has ruled for many,
many years.  He looks as though he is still alive.

12900.l: A tong guard hides in the shadows.
12900.d: This tong guard hides just out of view in the shadows.

1300.l: A ferocious-looking fish swims toward you.
1300.d:
The churka has extremely sharp teeth, and its mouth is full of them. While not
overly large, it tends to hunt in packs, which allows it to combat far larger
prey. It excretes a venom into its victim that slowly poisons it, should it
escape.

1301.l: The ground shakes as a huge rock golem walks by.
1301.d:
These creatures have been given life by the greatest of magicks and, as such,
serve their masters until their destruction. Composed completely of rock, they
possess massive strength.

1302.l: A strange shape moves silently on unseen air currents.
1302.d:
Nothing more than a collection of particles, the essence has been given the
gift of sentience, and serves its master with complete devotion.

1303.l: A large magma beast lumbers past you.
1303.d:
This beast has been 'constructed' of molten lava, and moves with heavy steps.
Given its nature, the magma beast is able to regenerate quickly, making it
quite difficult to kill.

1304.l: A strange creature brushes past your legs.
1304.d:
Preferring to swim beyond your sight, you're not exactly sure what the lurker
is. It obviously intends you no harm as it passes by, but provoking something
you can't see may not be wise.
1304.noise: You are tossed around in the turbulent water.

1305.l: An earth elemental materialises before you.
1305.d:
Khelereth is an elemental of the earth - it can disappear and reappear at
will, and can take on the form of any earth-bound creature. Within the earthly
plane, however, Khelereth exists in its natural form, and is quite annoyed at
your intrusion.

1306.l: An air elemental tries to knock you off your feet.
1306.d:
Geshrak is everywhere, making it a difficult opponent. It has the ability to
disperse and reform anywhere it chooses, but within the aerial plane such
powers are weaker, making him slightly more vulnerable to attack.

1307.l: In an explosion of flame, a fire elemental engulfs you.
1307.d:
With intense magickal powers, the fire elemental is able to sustain itself
without the need of a fuel source. It can assume any shape or form, but still
retains its flames.

1308.l: Arising from the water depths, a water elemental crashes down upon you.
1308.d:
A magickal construct of water, the elemental is extremely difficult to hit
and destroy using conventional means. In this environment, it simply crashes
down upon you and reforms without damage to itself.

1309.l: A small, crystalline entity floats nearby.
1309.d:
It closely resembles an uncut gem, and you would almost assume it was, except
for the fact that it glows softly, and seems to have a mind of its own. The
creature looks very quick and agile.

1310.d:
You're not exactly sure what it is, since you can't see it. You only feel its
presence.
1310.noise: The wind blows softly across your face.

1311.l: An impish little creature dances around you.
1311.d:
The sprite looks like a ball of flame, dancing around with sheer pleasure only
it knows. You glance into its eye and there is a definate twinkle... perhaps
it is up to some kind of mischief.
1311.noise: The surrounding lava bubbles away quietly.

1312.l: A dangerous-looking creature scuttles towards you.
1312.d:
You're not sure what it is, exactly, but it has a dangerous-looking set of
fangs and a tail with a sharp series of spikes. It crawls along on six legs,
and a forked tongue flicks out occassionally from a gaping mouth.

1313.l: A servant to the elements awaits a command from his master.
1313.d:
The minion has little to no intelligence of his own, only a strict desire to
obey his master. He will do whatever is necessarily to accomplish that, and is
even willing to sacrifice his own life.

1314.l: A guardian spirit chants softly in odd tones.
1314.d:
The spirit has been summoned to this place in an effort to keep adventurers
such as yourself out! It is quite devoted to fulfilling this role so that
it may return to its etherial slumber.
1314.noise: A soothing chant floats softly through the chamber.

1315.s: Galeru, the Master of the Elements
1315.l: A giant rainbow snake coils itself around you.
1315.d:
Galeru is a symbol for the maintenance of life, the master of elements from
which all things in this world were formed. You have intruded upon its abode,
and it doesn't look happy.

13100.l: An angry guardsman is here, protecting the fortress from invaders.
13100.d: He's big, mean, and about to lob your head off.

13101.l: King E'douird is sitting on his throne here, accepting bribes.
13101.d:
He is the war-proclaimed King of Dun Liu, his rule is tyrannical and cruel.
Just the sight of him and how he rules makes you want to rip off his arms and
feed them to some poor beggar of the crime ridden streets of Dun Liu.

13102.l: The Cheese Vendor is here, resting on all fours.

13103.l: An angry patrolman is here, making his rounds.
13103.d:
He's angry at the King, who is always making his life more miserable, but
then the King does that to everyone...

13104.l: Swiss is here, mixing strange potions and feeding them to dogs.
13104.d:
He is apparently from Switzerland. He wears four watches and sums you up
with a quick glance and an eager smile.

drp.name: a yellow potion of see invisible

items_sold.name: a yellow potion of see invisible

13105.l: Gandalf is here, counting his profits greedily.

13106.l: The Black Knight is here, guarding the bridge.
13106.d:
He stands tall and alert, ready for any sort of attack his enemies might
try to use against him.  To enter the castle, you will have to defeat him.
13106.noise: Someone shouts, 'Come back and I'll bite your kneecaps off!

13107.l: A dark figure is wandering about here, hiding in the shadows.
13107.d:
You can't make out much about the dark figure. It appears to be a man, but
his entire body is covered by his cloak and other garments. The look in his
eyes tells you this is a man not to be trifled with.

13108.l: A gremlin is here, wondering what the hell you're doing.
13108.d:
It's a short green... ummm... thing! The little monster glares are you
greedily and puts out his hand.

13109.l: The King's mistress is lying here, sharing pillow talk.
13109.d:
She's beautiful. Long blond hair with a voluptuous body that would make any
woman jealous. As you look at her she merely licks her lips and smiles.

13110.l: A filthy peasant lies here, reeking of his own fluids.
13110.d:
He smells like the worst shit you've ever smelt. He wears rags that are torn
and caked with grease and sweat. You feel disgusted just being around him.

13111.l: A beady-eyed rat stares at you angrily.
13111.d:
The rat glares at you with a fierce look in it's eyes. Although it looks
small, who knows what kinds of diseases it carries in it's mangy black
fur and long fangs.

13112.l: A huge, fruity-looking creature glares at you with beady eyes.
13112.d:
"Um" is the first word to come to mind. This rodent has more colors than a
Frutopia bottle and looks just as psychadellic. This is one whacked rat.

13199.l: A odif yltsaeb stands here growling furiously.

13333.l: A large monk stands here, guarding the shrine of Wind.
13333.d:
He is a tall, ancient man. He wears long, flowing robes, and
is quite average in size. He looks so peaceful and harmless.

13342.l: A large fish-man is here, guarding the shrine of Water.

13344.l: The Priestess of Fire stands here, harmonizing with a blue flame.
13344.d:
She's gorgeous! The priestess has long, red hair that flows halfway
down her back. She smiles briefly at you before continuing to mingle
continuing her chanting among the flames, not even breaking a sweat.
13344.noise: You hear the sounds of a fire roaring in the distance.

13351.l: A large serpent slithers about the shrine protectively.
13351.d:
The Earth Serpent is a long, slender snake, with hideous fangs and a long,
forked tongue. It hisses at you with pure content.
13351.noise: A faint hissing noise comes from somewhere nearby.

14001.l: A retired, powerful-looking man controls the entry of new gladiators.
14001.d:
The man appears to be in his late fifties to mid sixties, and is probably a
retired gladiator or warrior, judging by the various scars on his face, neck,
and arms.  He has been given the position of gatekeeper: to make sure noone
unauthorized enters the arena, and to register new challengers.  He looks
friendly, but not like a man you'd want to mess with.

spw.name: East Gate of the "Lion's Mouth" Arena

14002.l: A small snake slivers along the ground towards you.
14002.d: The snake is about one foot in length, and looks pretty harmless.

14003.l: A small rabbit with black fur hops around innocently...then jumps at you!
14003.d: The rabbit looks so cute with snuggly fur, but then bears its teeth.

14004.l: A striped snake rattles its tail in warning.
14004.d: The snake looks like its been in combat before...and won.

14005.l: A tall, but dumb looking female swings her club at you!
14005.d: She stands about eight feet tall, and has a look of idiocy about her.

14006.l: An elf in shackles can barely walk, let alone fight.
14006.d:
He looks sad, like he doesn't really want to fight.  Someone must have put
him here with force.

14007.l: An angry-looking troll looks at you as if you were a big juicy steak.
14007.d: The troll has green scaly skin and is about seven feet tall.

14008.l: A hungry mountain lion leaps toward your neck!
14008.d: The lion is rather large, definitely an adult.  It looks starved.

14009.l: A man riding a chariot tramples you with his horses!
14009.d: The man would be very hard to hit, up there.

14010.l: A small orc swings a rusty scimitar at your head!
14010.d: The orc is about three feet tall, and looks both angry and confused.

14011.l: A tall orc looks at you, laughs, and takes a cheap shot at your chest!
14011.d: The orc is over five feet tall and looks like it has been in battle before.

14012.l: A tall, muscular gladiator grins evilly and approaches.
14012.d: Brutus looks very strong, and he has obviously fought here before.

14100.l: A hungry troll stands near a boiling cauldron.
14100.d:
The troll's hide is a nauseating moss green, mottled with green and grey.
The writhing hair-like growth on the troll's head is iron grey and the troll's
eyes are a dull black.

14101.l: Echidna the greater medusa stares at you as you enter the room.
14101.d: Her petrifying gaze can even kill gods.. Don't look at her!

14102.d: His petrifying gaze can even kill gods... Don't look at him!

drp.name: the Flail of the Desert Kings

14103.l: A large snake slithers around here.
14103.d:
Covered in a diamond-shaped pattern of sanguine scales, it's both a beauty
and a terror to behold. A forked tongue the size of your forearm whips in and
out of it's mouth, silently tasting the air.. and your scent with it.

14106.l: A transparent image is sitting here, brushing her hair.
14106.d:
You can barely see her, but from what you can see, she looks like a very
beautiful woman.

14107.l: A skeleton is here, toasting his comrades.
14107.d:
It's almost a complete skeleton, with only a few bits of flesh clinging to
age blackened bones.

14109.l: An ugly ghoul stands here, stirring a cauldron.

14110.l: Lothar the Vampire Lord stands here, waiting for you.
14110.d:
He's tall and lean, with a handsomely muscled waist. His hair is blond and
cut so that it falls across his brow with practiced nonchalance. His eyes
are electric blue, cold as witchfire. They are the eyes of a white tiger on
the prowl.

14127.l: A small snake slithers around here.
14127.d:
It's a small, black snake, no more around than your thumb, but it's eyes glow
with a fierce red light, and as it looks at you a chill runs up your spine.

14198.l: An amorphous body of crackling black energy fills the room.
14198.d:
The One is an extradimensional entity that the ancients said was older
than our own world.  It is intelligent and completely evil, it survives
by devouring the energy from entire worlds.

14199.l: Tak screams, 'Tak an la! Tak an la!'
14199.d: Serapis's most powerful minion and guardian.

14200.l: Nimos stands here, drilling into Lady Amber.
14200.d: What are you? Some typa prevert?

14201.l: Zephyr is standing here, with flowers blooming at his bare feet.
14201.d:
Dressed in ragged brown robes, with his thin limbs poking out from the sleeves,
this man seems a very humorous sight. But as he looks at you, you seem to peer
into his soul and see a very strong man, who has lived throughout a long and
hard life without many friends. His eyes glimmer with a vast intelligence as he
watches you.

spw.name: In the Corner of a Battlefield

14202.l: Amidst all the ambient green smoke that permeates this place, Bhang stands before you.
14202.d:
This short, stocky man radiates a distinct aura of power. His face is etched
with lines and scars mark a lot of his skin that is not under his clothing. When
he notices you looking at him, he gives you a wink, smiles, and gets ready to
fight.

spw.name: On the Edge of a Battlefield

14203.l: Skarash is standing here, looking intimidating.
14203.d:
He is an ogre, and a large one with that, although he seems all muscle, you get
the feeling that he has a very cunning mind. All his clothing is black or red,
maybe he's part of some clan?

spw.name: On the Edge of a Battlefield

14204.l: Darklord is standing here, off adventuring in his own imagination.
14204.d:
A tall and powerfully built man, Darklord looks like he's fought many battles,
his tunic is hanging open and you see a massive palm-print imbedded into his
chest. When he sees you watching him, he snaps out of his daydream and begins
walking towards you.

spw.name: On the Edge of a Battlefield

14205.l: Infidel is standing here, his hand reaching for his weapon.
14205.d:
Supposedly the most powerful swordsman ever, this man has led a hard life, his
true love being killed by a vengeful assassin. He's tall and has a distinct air
of speed about him.

spw.name: In the Corner of a Battlefield

drp.name: a black silk set of sleeves

14206.l: Saint is standing here, looking around in awe.
14206.d:
He looks lost and somehow...new. You sense he is a student of the priestly arts
but you do not know whom he worships. When he notices you and your weapon, his
eyes grow large in fear.

spw.name: On the Edge of a Battlefield

14207.l: Nonesuch is here, being a waste.
14207.d:
This is the first half-orc you've ever seen, and it's not a pretty sight, he
isn't as fearsome-looking as an orc, he looks more pathetic than powerful.

14208.l: Caramon the barbarian is standing here, trying to look cool.
14208.d: He is your average barbarian, strong, sturdy, and dumb as a post.

14209.l: Eyspethar stands here, trying to think of a confusing idea.
14209.d:
He isn't like most ogres you've seen, he has tusks that grow from the bottom of
his mouth up, making it look like his jawbone is upside down. Although he's an
ogre, he seems to be a very learned one, and is dressed in fancy-looking
clothes.

14210.l: Tefnut is here, being a total bitch.
14210.d:
Although you can tell she used to be pretty, now she is barely even homely and
she makes her money selling herself. She was once the great MaYuan's concubine
but, as all things do, she got old and stopped trying to keep herself looking
good. Once that happened, MaYuan quickly discarded her like a used tissue.

spw.name: On the Edge of a Battlefield

14211.l: MaYuan, the Eater of Gods, stands here.
14211.d:
This ogre is definitely not just a simple warrior, you can tell by the catlike
way he moves and the faint glimmer of cunning intelligence behind his eyes.

spw.name: On the Edge of a Battlefield

14212.l: Dozois the swordsman is standing here.
14212.d:
Dozois is a great swordsman, bested in battle by only Infidel. He is tall and
thin and moves with the grace of a jungle cat, his muscles rippling underneath
his clothes as he walks towards you.

14213.l: Hardcase limps around in circles here.
14213.d:
The legends say he was once the most powerful mortal in the world, but he got
old, real old, and now can't fight his way out of a paper bag with a chainsaw.

14214.l: Shrike is standing here, trying to act cool.
14214.d:
A powerful swordsman, though not as powerful as Infidel or Dozois, he fights
like a bat out of hell. His clothes are all either gold or blue, perhaps this
means something? Nope.

spw.name: On the Edge of a Battlefield

14215.d:
Although he is normally nice and sincere, this monk can be worse than Zephyr
when he doesn't like you.

spw.name: On the Edge of a Battlefield

14216.l: Grunt is standing here, spouting out nonsense.
14216.d: He's as strong as a rock, and about as smart as one.

14217.l: Morathi is here, dressed as a woman.
14217.d:
This seems to be a weird sort of warrior, a man dressed in womans clothing, he's
not doing a very good job of it, either, maybe losing the facial hair would
help.

14218.l: Slay is here, trying to get your attention.
14218.d:
He looks like a complete idiot, though from what you can tell he's supposed to
be a warrior of some sort. Wearing all sorts of different clothing, he makes a
funny sight.

14219.l: Thor is here, trying to get revenge on you.
14219.d:
A tall, mystical-looking elf, wearing thick, light robes. He looks at you and
his eyes flash with anger, and he begins to chant an incantation.

spw.name: On the Edge of a Battlefield

14220.l: Chalkara is here, her raven-colored hair barely covering naked breasts.
14220.d:
A powerful maiden as a mortal; she now walks the heavens with the gifts of
immortality, luring men to their deaths with her lustful ways.

spw.name: In the Corner of a Battlefield

14221.l: Xavier is here, whining about something someone did to him.
14221.d: Although he is a powerful mage, he seems to actually be stupid...strange...

spw.name: On the Edge of a Battlefield

14222.l: Silk is here, trying to get other people in trouble.
14222.d:
He is real short, only a bit taller than a dwarf, but has the features of a
human, an ugly human, but a human nonetheless.

spw.name: On the Edge of a Battlefield

14223.l: Rogue is here, skulking around like a thief.
14223.d:
Rogue is your average thief, just a little bit more powerful. He's normally kind
to fellow humans, but sometimes he'll go schitzo and when that happens, you'd
better watch out.

spw.name: On the Edge of a Battlefield

14224.l: Tranquility is here, being a PAW.
14224.d:
The only reason this man is alive is because he somehow found out the god's
weaknesses and exploited them everytime something bad happened to him. He
is a short and ugly man, with thin, spindly limbs and a pale complexion.

spw.name: In the Corner of a Battlefield

14225.l: Ozymandias stands here, thinking he's wizinvis.
14225.d:
He's almost trasparent, currently in the form of an old man wearing some
gnomish spectacles.

spw.name: In the Corner of a Battlefield

14300.l: A large, mean-looking ogre lumbers towards you.
14300.d:
This ogre sure looks mean. He has a sickly violet hue to his skin and is
covered in black, warty bumps which are placed all over its hide. His eyes
are purple with white pupils. His teeth and talons are midnight black and
glisten in your lights presence. The ogre has long, greasy black hair which
is braided down the middle of its back. Its odor is so revolting you can't
help but want to retch.

14301.l: A massive, black ogre is here, keeping his slaves in line.
14301.d:
This ogre looks a bit bigger than most of the other ones you've seen in your
adventures. His pitch black skin and bright orange bumps identify him as part
of the current emperor's clan, a previously little-known group. He clearly
likes his job as slave-driver and you notice his evil grin every time he whips
one of his defenseless captives. Though he seems like an ordinary, if large,
ogre, you notice he moves with a feline grace uncommon to the ogrish race.

14302.l: A big, nasty ogre begins walking towards you.
14302.d:
This ogre is big! Even bigger than the slave-drivers you've seen, and you can
tell from his black skin with orange bumps that he's of the same tribe. He
seems much more calmed than the other ogres you've seen so far, but that
probably won't stop him from splitting you in two.

14303.l: The biggest ogre you've ever seen is standing here, ignoring your existence.
14303.d:
This ogre is the mac daddy of all ogres, he's the emperor, which means that he,
through whatever means necessary combined the might of all the ogre clans in
the land and now leads them as a legion of doom. You notice a strange glint
of intelligence in his beady purple and white eyes and you also see the same
feline grace of some of the other ogres in the stronghold.

14304.l: A slave toils here, doing whatever his masters say.
14304.d:
He's been through a lot, after the ogres had raided his village they made him
watch as the ogres raped his wife and daughter and slaughtered his sons in cold
blood. As his eyes meet yours you can't help but feel that killing him would
be putting him out of his misery.

14305.l: A large saber-toothed tiger prowls around here.
14305.d:
This is the Ogre Emperor's favorite pet, though normally saber-toothed tigers
are untrainable, it seems this one is an exeption. The Emperor uses the tiger
to rip his enemies to pieces, for entertainment purposes, of course.

14306.l: A huge mass of arms, tentacles, and feelers lurches towards you.
14306.d:
It's hideous! It seems to be made from only feathery antennae, wispy tendrils,
and long feelers. You know not where this alien beast has come from, only that
it does not belong in this place, and it seems to feel the same way about you.

14307.l: A big fire beetle scurries around here.
14307.d:
These fire beetles are breeded by the ogres to make lights for the walls of
their stronghold, and when they go out at night to raid the nearby villages.

14308.l: A carrion stalker jumps towards you, tentacles outstretched!
14308.d:
It's one of the most disgusting things you've ever seen. It looks like a
horseshoe crab except without the tail and instead of legs it has long,
slimy tentacles that squirm around each other. It lives in corpses and waits
for unsuspecting victims to disturb their rest, like you just have.

14309.l: A lizard man dressed in the robes of a priest is standing here, chanting.
14309.d:
He is the leader of the group of lizard men sent to the ogre stronghold to
negotiate a peace treaty. His king sent him because he was the most
intelligent of the lizard men in the tribe, soon the treaty will be signed
and the lizard men shall have free reign of some of the ogre territory, like
your home city.

14310.l: A lizard man is standing here, staying guard.
14310.d:
This lizard man was sent by the lizard king to guard the shaman, in case the
ogres had planned a trick. Although not the biggest of the rest of the lizard
men in his tribe, he looks like he can hold his own in a fight with someone
like...you.

14311.l: An intelligent-looking troll sits here, looking over some documents.
14311.d:
He must have been the runt of his litter, for he is much smaller than any
other troll you've ever seen. But it looks like what he is at a loss in
brawn, he makes up for in brains. Normally he'd be advising at the troll king's
side but after the ogre emperor asked him to come to make up a peace treaty,
he figured it was a good idea and took a leave for as long as the signing of
the treaties will last.

14312.l: A large, burly-looking troll stands here, drowsing off.
14312.d:
Originally one of the troll king's elite guards, this troll was releived of
his post when an envoy was sent to the ogre stronghold to make up a treaty of
some kind and now guards the troll ambassador from any harm anyone would
bring upon him.

14313.l: A giant rat charges at you, beady eyes flashing.
14313.d:
This is what the ogres use for entertainment when not raiding the nearby
villages. It's gotten used to the ogres and is more like a pet than a pest
and now obeys most of the orders it understands from the ogres.

14314.l: A dark-robed ogre glances at you bemusedly, before chanting an incantation...
14314.d:
This ogre is the emperor's right hand man and is basically the whole reason
that the emperor is what he is today. One day when the now emperor was training
with the other ogres of his tribe, this shaman that seemed to be of the same
clan walked up to him and offered him a proposal, no one knows exactly what
the proposal was but now it's assumed that it had something to do with becoming
emperor of the ogre clans. Ever since the emperor was in place, the shaman has
always been there to advise him.

14401.l: A tall, lanky demon stands here, guarding the gate.
14401.d:
Although his form is clumsy-looking, you get the feeling that if he doesn't
want you through the gate, you won't get through the gate until he changes his
mind. His angular, scaled face turns towards you as he notices you watching
him and he smiles, showing off a set of sharp, yellowed teeth.

14402.l: A tall, thin demon stands here, dressed like a butler.
14402.d:
Although he is a demon, he radiates the aura of a well-mannered butler. He seems
nice and politely asks you if you need anything, but as you get a good look at
his horned, red face, you get the feeling he could pop your head like a pimple,
if the order was given.

14403.l: A Grey Slayer stands here, wearing a huge suit of grey armor.
14403.d:
Although he is wearing grey full body armor, he doesn't seem to be encumbered
a bit. As you pass by his visor turns towards you and you see two crimson
pinpoints following your movements, seeming to dare you to do something you
probably won't live to regret.

drp.name: a huge suit of grey armor

14404.l: A beautiful, but deadly-looking Grey Slayer stands here.
14404.d:
Although normally females wouldn't be allowed to be one of the Grey Slayers,
Lady Amber's appearance at the Grey Keep changed that, herself training women
to become master warriors. The Grey Slayer is wearing light grey armor that
covers most of her body.

drp.name: a light suit of grey armor

14405.l: Gil-Glash the half-elf sits in his throne, planning his next conquest.
14405.d:
Although he looks like the average half-elf, you know from the legends that he
is actually one of the most powerful men in the world, if not the most. His
head turns towards you lazily as you gaze at him, smirks, and turns his thoughts
back to his plans for world domination, dismissing you as if you were nothing,
which to him, you are.
14405.noise: Waves of evil wash over you.

14406.l: Nimos is here, on his knees.
14406.d:
A strong, powerfully-built man with long, dark hair, Nimos isn't like many
other wizards you've seen, and him kneeling before Lady Amber makes him look
less like the most powerful warlock in the world, and more like a male concubine
faithfully obeying orders.

14407.l: Lady Amber stands here, shuddering in ecstacy.
14407.d:
Not only is she the most skilled swordsperson in the land, she also ranks up
there among the most beautiful.  Her finely toned body is covered in a thin
film of sweat, and you can see some long, jagged scars that mar her perfect 
form.
14407.noise: You hear a soft moan from nearby.

14408.l: Fiothas is here, getting food ready.
14408.d:
One of the egomaniacal drow, this one doesn't seem to mind its low position
in the Grey Keep. She was trained by the great cuisinarts of her own city and
is now a really good cook. Given a couple tries, she could make almost anything
taste great.

14409.s: Garbenaferthal, Sprite-slayer, Greatest of All Ice Mephits, Favorite of the Lower Planes
14409.l: Garbenaferthal the ice mephit is walking around the room, keeping it cold.
14409.d:
His body is angular, with translucent, ice-blue skin. Sharp icicles hang down
from his long, drooping nose and chin, and his pointed ears stick up as he sees
you looking at him. His pale blue eyes lock onto yours and he begins to giggle
insanely.

14410.l: Silk is standing here, guarding the door to his mistress's chamber.
14410.d:
A tall, well built man, he is Lady Amber's only servant and he obeys all of her
orders to his maximum capability. The eunuch does not seem to mind the dark
and gloomy Grey Keep, but he seems agitated about something at the moment.

14411.l: Master Vrixrig-Vimcuj is here, phasing in and out of this dimension.
14411.d:
You don't know what it is, but it sure looks odd. It stands it's snake-like body
on two long, thin legs. It's long, thin, flexible-looking arms each end in one
hook-like claw. It's head is bald and earless, with large round eyes that have
cat-like pupils. A ring of strange symbols is tattooed around it's head and down
it's back.

14412.l: The snake-like Hisczdrezzez is sitting here, thinking about the future.
14412.d:
His body is that of a giant snake, with a long, scaled tail instead of legs.
His arms and torso are covered with scales as well, but are more human-like.
His head is the only human part about him, but still retains some attributes
of a snake. He is the last of the yuan-ti, his race exterminated by the same
Dark One's army that attempted to destroy the great city Alaozar. Gil-Glash
too him under his wing and is willing to help restore his race to its former
glory.

14413.d:
Although it's made of pure shadow, due to your light you can see it's outline,
that of a large, thin, clawed and winged fiend.

14414.l: Alhazred the Chief Vivisector is here, getting ready for his next 'patient'.
14414.d:
One of the rare and extremely powerful alhoon, or illithilich, Alhazred was
exiled by his own kind, and Gil-Glash took him into the Grey Keep in exchange
for occasional services, which Alhazred figured was a good trade. He is about
six feet tall and has dry, wrinkled mauve-colored skin. His head resembles an
octopus, with white, pupil-less eyes, and four tentacles around his mouth,
which itself is a round, many-toothed orifice like that of a lamprey. He has
three fingers and a thumb on each hand.

drp.name: a pair of thin, white gloves

14415.l: A long, thin black snake slithers underneath a pillow as you approach.
14415.d:
Even though it seems black, when you get a closer look it looks more like it's
made from shadow! When it sees you it hisses, showing off long, needlelike
fangs that glisten with a dangerous poison.

14416.l: A member of the deadly taipan race is standing here.
14416.d:
Although his body is in humanoid shape, except for his long tail which whips
back and forth in anticipation of battle, it is covered in scales. When he sees
you, his slit-pupils seem to stab at you and it hisses, revealing long, sharp
fangs that drip with some glistening fluid which must be the legendary taipan
venom.

14417.l: A strange blade of grass sits here, swaying in the wind.
14417.d:
It looks like a normal blade of grass, but has the features of a humanoid and
small growths spurt out of its sides like arms and legs.

14418.l: A strong, but strangely pale-looking dwarf stands here, hammering on a sword.
14418.d:
He looks much like the other dwarves you've seen in your adventures, but has
a strange, sickly hue to his skin, and his pores seem larger than most peoples.
Although he does not acknowledge your presence, you get the feeling he knows
you're there, but he just doesn't care.
14418.noise: You hear a loud clanging sound from nearby.

14419.l: Raithir the dark elf is lounging in a comfortable chair here.
14419.d:
Fiothas' more intelligent twin, Raithir came upon his position in the Grey Keep
due to Fiothas' recommendation. Raithir was exiled from his home city miles
beneath the ground because he made too many enemies in too little time. He
looks like your normal drow elf, with dark skin and white hair, although his
eyes seem to glint with the cunningness only a highly trained thief could have.

14420.l: A brain with legs charges towards you.
14420.d:
It looks like a brain, except it has four legs that end in sharp claws. The
brain looks like it's covered with some sort of crusty shell. Alhazred keeps
intellect devourers as pets and sometimes, only on special occasions, eats
them.

14421.l: An evil-looking ebonstone golem is standing here, barring your path.
14421.d:
Even though the drow are the only ones who know how to make ebonstone golems,
and they very rarely use them out of their underground cities, Raithir was able
to bring this one to the surface and keep it active. It looks like a tall drow
elf with four arms and eyes that glow red.

14422.l: Zegeron the dungeon guard is sitting on a stool here.
14422.d:
She is a big, strong woman and also one of Lady Amber's top students. She is
a mistress of the axe and when she looks you in the eye, you get the feeling
she could split you in two without a second's thought.

spw.name: The Entrance to the First Dungeon

14423.l: Vair is here, sitting at his desk and filling out reports.
14423.d:
His is a big, burly man with hair all over the visible parts of his body. When
he sees you looking at him, he smiles, showing off remarkably lupine features.
He was the only one of the Grey Slayers willing to take the job as guard of
the deadly second dungeon.

spw.name: The Entrance to the Second Dungeon

14424.l: Amaristee is huddled in a corner here.
14424.d:
She looks like she hasn't been here that long, but that's too long for most
people. Her naked form would normally be appealing, but not now with all the
garbage and coagulated blood upon it. When she sees you looking at her, her
eyes seem to pierce into your soul, praying for an end to her misery.

14425.l: Yathruin is here, walking back and forth.
14425.d:
He looks like he's been here for a long time, his body is a pale hue, as if he
hasn't seen the light of the sun since he was captured by Gil-Glash's forces
while trying to break into the Keep, probably attempting to find out if the
rumors of vast treasure chambers were true.

14426.l: Rilithinn is lying here, almost dead.
14426.d:
He was just caught by the Grey Slayers and still bears all the scars from the
meeting. His eyes seem to stare right through you as if you weren't even there.
Once he is fully healed, he shall be taken to Alhazred the Chief Vivisector,
to see how much Rilithinn knows of Gil-Glash's keep.

14427.d:
Although this ninja has been here long, he doesn't seem to mind and considers
it a learning experience. Gil-Glash begrudgingly let Raithir lock him up here
due to a conflict the drow has had with him, Gil-Glash has refused to have him
tortured, though, and will let Aldegund out in a couple months.

14428.d:
Ratharr has not been here for a while, and just got done with his first 
appointment with Alhazred. He senses you looking at him and his face turns
towards the door, and you see his milky white, sightless eyes.

14429.l: Belaerzyn is tied across the pentagram, naked.
14429.d:
Her tall, thin form would normally seem attractive, if it wasn't covered in
dirt and coagulated blood. She stares up at the ceiling, not noticing you.
She seems to be mumbling something, but you cannot make it out.

14430.l: A strange-looking spider is clinging to the wall here.
14430.d:
It look like a spider, except it's abdomen looks like a brain with a hard,
chitinous shell. Raithir had the brain spider imported from another land where
spiders are very popular and are kept as pets. It took him a long time to train
them so that they'd attack anyone who entered his treasury.

14431.l: A skull with eight thin legs skitters around here.
14431.d:
It's your average human skull with eight legs protruding where the neck should
be. Skull riders are strong spiders that carry around skulls on their backs to
scare away predators. Raithir accidentally let some of the skull riders mate
and now they are roaming about the Grey Keep and no one seems to know where
their nest is, or where they get the skulls. Gil-Glash doesn't seem to mind
them, he thinks it gives the Keep a more healthy atmosphere.

14432.l: The neh-thalggu quickly scuttles towards you.
14432.d:
Summoned from another plane one day by Gil-Glash, after studying the neh-
thalggu for a few weeks, he became overjoyed at such an accidental find and
had it locked away so that he could unleash it when the time came. It has a
yellowish-orange, bloated, oily and amorphous body with dozens of short,
writhing tentacles. Half a dozen crablike legs allow it to scuttle about. Four
large, yellow, bulging eyes and a tooth-filled maw are set into its bulbous
head.

14433.l: A horrifying moonbeast jiggles in anticipation of it's next meal.
14433.d:
The moonbeast has a large octopoid body with at least ten tentacles. Within the
circle of tentacles lies its tooth-filled maw. Its bulbous body is covered with
dozens of eye stalks, each about a foot long. Its skin is a mottled grey and is
covered with a slimy secretion. This moonbeast burst into the Grey Keep one 
day, causing immense damage to the walls and ceilings. It went directly towards
Nimos' chamber but was incapacitated by the combined efforts of several of the
generals of the Keep and they managed to imprison it in the second dungeon.

14434.l: A flaming skull levitates here and begins floating towards you.
14434.d:
It is a normal humanoid skull, except it is immersed in flames. Through the
flames you can see into the black eye sockets and see red, glowing pinpoints.
It was once a very knowledgable sage who predicted the downfall of one of
Gil-Glash's greatest enemies, who knowing opportunity's unique knock, called
the sage to the Grey Keep and made him an advisor. When the sage eventually
died of old age, Gil-Glash had a huge ceremony in which he burned several of
his slaves on the sage's funeral pyre, which brought the flaming skull to
life.

14435.l: A yuk-shaar floats lazily towards you.
14435.d:
It appears to be a pair of floating eyeballs and a pair of floating, skeletal
hands. The eyeballs and the hands glow with a greenish color. Nimos was able
to catch the yuk-shaar one day when Gil-Glash wasn't in the Keep, one of
Raithir's enemies sent the yuk-shaar out to kill him and it would have
succeeded if it didn't trip one of Nimos' magickal alarms. When Nimos came
to Raithir's rescue a great battle ensued and Nimos barely had enough power
to capture the yuk-shaar by the end of the fight, but he managed to do it and
locked it up in the second dungeon, never to bother anyone again.

14436.l: The huge nightmare beast charges towards you.
14436.d:
It is at least twenty feet tall and must weigh a couple tons. It has four
legs, all which end in sharp claws. Its dark purple skin looks extremely
thick and tough. Its large, red eyes glow with an evil light. The beast's
teeth are very long, more than half a foot in length, and look sharp enough
to cut through solid stone with ease. Two pairs of its teeth are nearly twice
as long as the rest, one is set in the upper jaw, the other in the lower jaw.
It has two large, tusk-like horns on its head. The nightmare beast was set
against the Grey Keep by one of Gil-Glash's more powerful enemies, but Lady
Amber took it upon herself to defend the Keep against the horrid creature.
They fought for hours and hours, neither seeming to tire, but in the end Lady
Amber prevailed and she hath incapacitated the beast, and had Nimos teleport
its stunned form into the second dungeon.

14437.l: The rampager stomps towards you at an amazing speed.
14437.d:
The rampager is a huge, six-legged creature with grey scales covering its whole
body. Its four rear legs are large round pads, while the two front legs have
claws as long as dagger. Its face is out of a nightmare, with long, dirty fangs
and glowing red eyes. Its nose is similar to a vestigal horn, and it has small,
rounded ears. A druidic magickal spell gone awry created the rampager, and the
minute Gil-Glash heard of it's destructive capabilities, he sent Hisczdrezzez
to obtain it. The yuan-ti was overjoyed at finally having something to do other
than roam around the Grey Keep, and took his job very seriously. It took a 
year and a few months of tracking and several failed attempts at capture, but
Hisczdrezzez finally brought it back to his leige.

14438.l: A disgusting, garbage-covered gulguthydra crawls around here.
14438.d:
The mix between an otyugh and a hydra, this truly is a disgusting creature. Six
misshapen hydra heads perch in a circle atop the hulking body of the hybrid,
which also possesses an otyughs two rigid tentacles. Its skin looks hard,
almost rocklike, and its dusky brown coloration aids it in hiding within its
chosen domain. Nobody knows what brought it there, but the gulguthydra was
found in the sewers beneath the Grey Keep, it took a large group of Grey
Slayers to bring it back up, and when Gil-Glash saw it, he didn't want it to
be destroyed so he ordered that they herd it into a cell in the second dungeon.

14439.l: One of Gil-Glash's teenage concubines is here.
14439.d:
She can't be much over fifteen, but her body seems more mature than you'd think
for someone her age. Her ample breasts and pouting lips make her look like some
sort of harlot, which she is, basically.

14440.l: A young boy is here, waiting for Gil-Glash.
14440.d:
Gil-Glash sometimes gets tired of women, so he resorts to rutting with young
boys. The boy is not even ten, and pale skin makes him look sickly.

14500.l: A zookeeper is here, keeping a trained eye on everything.
14500.d:
He looks like a janitor, but you know that his job is very dangerous, keeping
the animals and monsters in control and the visitors from bothering them.

14501.l: A monkey shrieks loudly and throws excrement at you.
14501.d:
It's a small monkey, about the size of a young child. It sees you staring at
it, grabs a handful of dirt, and throws it at you, cackling insanely.
14501.noise: A large gob of feces flies in from the north and smacks against your face.

14502.l: A green lizard is here, running away from you.
14502.d:
It's a bright green lizard, about as long as your forearm. Its head bobs up
and down when it sees you, challenging you to battle.
14502.noise: You hear a soft hissing sound.

14503.d:
It's an ugly animal, about the size of a large dog. Where it hasn't been
ripped out due to a fight, the hyena's fur is a light brown, with dark markings
scattered along its form.
14503.noise: A high pitched howl pierces the air.

14504.l: A bear slowly lumbers towards you, carefully sniffing the air.
14504.d:
This is a black bear, one of the smaller of the species, although it is not
nearly as large as a grizzly or polar bear, it looks like it could rip a
not very experienced warrior to shreds with ease.
14504.noise: Something nearby lets out a deep roar.

14505.l: A large wolverine eyes you from a mound of snow.
14505.d:
It looks like a large, stocky weasel. It snarls at you, revealing a mouthful
of sharp, yellowed teeth. Its thick, brown fur shields it from the cold.

14506.l: A large rhinoceros watches you from under a tree.
14506.d:
A strange beast. Its worn, brown hide looks very thick, and the long horn
growing out of its snout looks awfully viscious. You don't want to get on this
things bad side.

14507.l: A badger is here, digging a burrow.
14507.d:
The badgers body is two feet long, and covered with stiff, grey and black fur.
It sees you looking at it and stops digging a burrow to growl at you.

14508.l: A tiger stalks you from amongst the greenery.
14508.d:
Not as large as some of the stories have talked about, the tiger is still a
fearsome, powerful-looking beast. Black stripes line the orange fur covering
the heavily muscled creature.
14508.noise: A deep, rumbling growl alerts you to predators.

14509.l: A huge elephant sprays water over its back.
14509.d:
A huge, lumbering beast, with a thick, baggy hide and a long trunk curled over
its back. It must be twice as tall as a fully grown human, and must weigh at
least three tons.

14510.l: A swan paddles through the water here.
14510.d:
Its feathers are pure white, and its long neck holds up a small head ending
in an orange beak. It looks like a glorified duck.
14510.noise: A loud honk gets on your nerves.

14511.l: A small bird chirps at you.
14511.d: It's no bigger than your fist.

14512.l: A black crow cocks its head to observe you.
14512.d:
The legends say these black feathered birds are used as spies and messengers
for evil wizards.
14512.noise: A forboding caw sends chills up your spine.

14513.l: An eagle swoops down to get a better look at you.
14513.d:
It's not much, if it wasn't so small, you would probably mistake it for a 
condor.

14514.l: An owl sits here, waiting for a mouse to appear.
14514.d:
When it sees you it decides to stretch out its toes, showing off sharp, black
talons.
14514.noise: Something nearby lets out a hoot.

14515.d:
It looks like a lion, but has large wings growing out of its back and two
horns from its head. Its long tail is covered in scales, and a barb hangs from
the end of it.
14515.noise: Something nearby lets out a roar.

14516.l: The Zoomaster stands here, urging you to look around.
14516.d:
He's an average looking guy, currently explaining how the zoo is set up,
apparently, the aviary is north of here, the wild animals are west, and the
dangerous, exotic creatures are east.
14516.noise: You hear someone yelling about the splendors of the zoo nearby.

14527.l: A maaralis stomps its feet and bangs its fists against its chest.
14527.d:
The maaralis is a large, four-armed monkeylike beast. Each arm ends in four,
blunt fingers. Its skin is a pale blue and it has beady eyes.

14529.l: A large, metallic slug slowly slides towards you.
14529.d:
It looks like a giant slug, except its skin seems to be made from steel. Two
glass eyeballs stare at you from the end of thin eyestalks. It opens a jaw
to show off sharp, metal teeth.

14530.l: The torewe floats here, tentacles flailing wildly.
14530.d:
It is a large sphere, about three feet in diameter, with two tentacles on
opposite sides of itself. You can't see a mouth or any noticable eyes.

14531.l: The nark is here, standing on two legs.
14531.d:
The nark looks like a spider, except with 16 legs and no head. It's just a
body and legs. Each leg has a spur sticking out at every joint.

14532.l: The huge, dark Sinzhe stands here, observing everything with cold eyes.
14532.d:
