Sinzhe stands six feet five, without an ounce of fat on him. All bone and
muscle, he moves like a cat, his slightest twitch pure liquid grace. He works
hard to stay hard but not to become overly muscled. He is very dark, but a
deep mahogany more than an ebony. He glows with conviction, an unshakable inner
strength. Gil-Glash recruited Sinzhe and his tribe, all superior warriors, as
a supplement to the Grey Slayers. Sinzhe leads the main garrison, rumors say
he was positions thus so Gil-Glash could keep him separated from Lady Volhm,
whom he often challenged to lengthy, destructive duels that always end in
draws. He can't fathom why his military genius isn't universally hailed.

15100.l: A quagga stands here grazing contentedly, eyes wary of predators.
15100.d:
A horse-like animal with zebra stripes on his forequarters and solid
colorings on his haunches, the quagga keeps a wary eye out for predators.
While he is an herbivore, his sharp hooves can be deadly to attackers.

spw.name: Immortal Map Room of the Plains

15101.l: A quagga stands here grazing contentedly, ears cocked listening for predators.
15101.d:
A horse-like animal with zebra stripes on her forequarters and solid
colorings on here haunches, the quagga stops often and listens intently 
for predators. While normally a peaceful creature, her sharp hooves can
be dangerous when defending herself.

spw.name: Immortal Map Room of the Plains

15102.l: A young quagga frolicks here, unaware of the dangers.
15102.d:
A horse-like animal with zebra stripes on her forequarters and solid
colorings on her haunches, the quagga has no idea how nasty the world
can be. If she's lucky, she will survive and learn.

spw.name: Immortal Map Room of the Plains

15103.l: A marmot is here, turning the plains into swiss cheese.
15103.d:
Short, squat, and furry, what more do you wanna see.  These burrowing little
rodents trust no one. As you approach they chitter endlessly until you go
away.

spw.name: Immortal Map Room of the Plains

15104.l: The oryx is here, munching placidly on the grassy plains.
15104.d:
A member of the antelope family, the oryx has a slim, sleek body built for
speed and long, sharp, curving horns that could run you through and extend
out the other side of your body. Good thing for you the orxy is a peaceful
creature.

spw.name: Immortal Map Room of the Plains

15105.l: The okapi stands here, munching on a nice cud of leaves.
15105.d:
A near cousin to a giraffe, the okapi is much shorter and is minus the extra
long neck. Gee, it looks kinda cute.

spw.name: Immortal Map Room of the Plains

15106.l: An ocelot crouches here, looking for a nice afternoon meal.
15106.d:
The ocelot appears to be feline, with a tawny-grayish or yellow coat with 
black spots. It looks like it is built for speed and as it hisses at you, 
it looks like they don't care to share their meal.

spw.name: Immortal Map Room of the Plains

15107.l: A giant land tortoise is here, mowing an inexorable path across the plains.
15107.d:
Huge, highly armored, and extremely ponderous. The word Dreadnought comes
to mind. You can't help but wonder how long it takes these things to cross
the plains.

spw.name: Immortal Map Room of the Plains

15108.l: The vulture sits here, obsidian eyes glittering at the prospect of dinner.
15108.d:
Lanky and un-coordinated, yet powerful in its own right, the vulture will
eat anything ... as long as it's dead. Its great hooked beak is capable of
rending large gobbits or flesh, alive or dead. Dying around one of these
guys probably wouldn't be a good idea.

spw.name: The Foothills Of The Grey Mountains

15109.l: A blesbok feeds here, ready to bolt at the first sign of danger.
15109.d:
Similar to an antelope, it has long curved horns and a white face. Somehow,
you get the impression this creature is an important part of the lower
food chain.

spw.name: The Foothills of the Grey Mountains

15110.l: An emu stands here, looking lost.
15110.d:
A tall thin-legged bird with a plump round upper body, the emu is a
relative of the ostrich.

15111.l: The peccary roots here, looking for truffles.
15111.d:
Short, squat, and covered with thick black bristles, the peccary is of a
porcine nature.

15112.l: A cacomistle searches through the grass, looking for baubles.
15112.d:
Sort of a cross between perhaps a possum and a raccoon, the cacomistle loves
shiny objects and will hoard them whenever found.

15113.l: A devil-dog prowls here, looking for an easy kill.
15113.d:
Covered in mangy yellow fur with a black face and snout, these dogs are 
wild and malicious, fearful of nothing. They have baleful red eyes, which
commoners took be be a sign of evil, hence their name devil dogs.

15114.l: An imposing pantaur stands here, leaning on a wicked-looking spear.
15114.d:
Wearing no clothes, this cat centaur has only a pouch slung across his back
and a wicked-looking spear with a worked metal head. His upper torso is
vaguely human, with the features of a panther's eyes, ears, and fur.
You get the feeling they like to run just for the feel of it.

15115.l: A cat centaur stands here, one hand on a hip, the other holding a spear.
15115.d:
Wearing no clothes, the cat centaur only has a satchel slung across one
shoulder and a wicked looking spear in one hand. A fully human upper torso, 
and emphatically female at that, with a lower torso of a great cat. She has
a twinkle in her eyes as you try not to stare at her assets.

15116.l: A dzur prowls here, surveying its domain.
15116.d:
A large feline of stately proportions, the dzur spends most of its time
lounging in the shade of the intermittent trees that dot the plains. The 
statement "Living a cat's life" comes from the observations of the scholar
Pliny, who study these great creatures for the better part of his life.

spw.name: The Foothills of the Grey Mountains

15117.l: A jhegaala crouches here, ready to pounce.
15117.d:
A long sleek feline, it can accelerate incredibly, taking down all sorts
of prey with long, sharp curving claws and razor-sharp teeth.

spw.name: The Foothills  of the Grey Mountains

15118.l: A yendi slithers through the grass here, looking to strike.
15118.d:
Mottled brown and quite long, the yendi is deadly poisonous. It paralyzes
and kills it's victims with its poison, and then eats them.

spw.name: The Foothills of the Grey Mountains

15119.l: A jhereg circles, reveling in the pleasures of flight, looking for dinner.
15119.d:
Commoners call them little dragons. Actually, they are distants cousins to
wyrverns. Possessing sharp claws, pointed beak, and large, wide, and leathery
wings, the jhereg prefers dead carcasses over fresh kills.

15120.l: A large kethna grazes here, trimming the grass to a few inches.
15120.d:
A large cow-like creature with backward sloping curly horns, the kethna
would provide you with many steaks, and roasts, and filets, and ...

15801.l: A ghostly looking figure stands before you.
15801.d:
There's not much to see except for the wall on the other side. This thing
is completely transparent and at times it is difficult to even see it.
15801.noise: Something nearby lets out a bone chilling scream.

15802.l: A skeletal guard stands in front of the door.
15802.d:
At one time, this creature could have been an actual guard but it has been
summoned from the world of the undead to guard entry into the room to the
south.

drp.name: a pair of chain mail leggings

15803.l: A deformed creature lies in a heap on the floor.
15803.d:
Surprisingly, this is the only creature that has not been restrained. It
is quite large and prefers to be left alone, hiding in the corner.
15803.noise: One of the prisoners pleads for help.

15804.l: The Necromancer turns her frosty gaze upon you.
15804.d:
Now you've done it...no one disturbs the work of the necromancer and gets
away with it. She has isolated herself from the world so that she may
practice magic that is forbidden, and you have disrupted that isolation.
15804.noise: A female voice bellows out, "Who dares to enter my domain!"

15805.l: A crazy looking man runs at you screaming.
15805.d:
Months of being imprisoned have left this poor soul completely insane, he
no longer has control over himself.

15806.l: An undead creature wanders around, focused solely on its work.
15806.d:
This creature must have done something during its mortal life to be trapped
in its present form. It ignores your gaze and continues with whatever
experiments it was performing.

15807.l: Tending to the light, a spectral figure turns his gaze upon you.
15807.d:
For his sins, Arborius has returned to this world to continue the job he
was chosen for during his mortal life. Although as a ghost, his presense
here no longer serves a purpose.

spw.name: At the Top of the Lighthouse

15808.l: A member of the ship's crew walks around the deck.
15808.d:
The smuggler is too occupied with his work to worry about you. Although, he
is well equipped to fight and will do anything to prevent the secret of the
operation to escape.

15809.l: Breathing heavily, a rough looking man moves casks around.
15809.d:
He looks rather nervous as he goes about his work, well aware that if caught
he would be killed for such smuggling activities.

15810.l: Barking orders, a rough looking man supervises the ongoing work.
15810.d:
In charge of the smuggling operation, this rough looking character is ready
to fight.
15810.noise: A rough looking man spots you and starts yelling for his comrades.

15811.l: The ship captain is quite angry at your intrusion.
15811.d:
Perhaps it's the patch over his right eye, but you get the feeling this guy
is well experienced in combat.

15812.l: A well-armed guard walks towards you pointing his weapon.
15812.d: Tall, lean and well muscled, the guard takes his job seriously.

15813.l: A pulsating pile of green slime creeps toward you.
15813.d: Kinda a snot-green, you can safely assume it is hostile.

15814.l: The master of this torture chamber grins evily at you.
15814.d:
This sick and twisted individual takes pleasure in his work and by the looks
of him, he's quite good at it too.

15815.l: What remains of a laboratory experiment crawls around the floor.
15815.d:
You're not quite sure what it is, because it is the combination of various
races. It has several legs, three arms and two heads...perhaps you should
put it out of its misery.

15816.l: Some type of creature, half human and half hawk stands before you.
15816.d:
It has the head of a hawk and the body of a human, both appear to have been
combined quite successfully to form the creature before you.

15817.l: A brutish troll wanders the halls, servant to the necromancer.
15817.d:
Responsible for the movement, sedation and control of prisoners, this servant
is loyal only to his master.

15818.l: A grotty little man cuts up some meat on the bench top.
15818.d:
Charbroil has given up his life at sea to remain here and prepare food for
future voyages. His time as a pirate and smuggler have taught him a trick or
two on how to fight.

16000.l: A stone giant lumbers about here.
16000.d:
Blocking out the sun before you is a gargantuan humanoid leering down
at you.  Crooked, sharp teeth grind together under a large unkept beard.
The pale, stone colored skin of this behemoth is pulled taught over bulky
muscles, and large hands capable of tearing an average person apart...
16000.noise: You hear the crunch of stone, and a low thudding sound nearby...

16001.l: A stone giant stalks about here.
16001.d:
This female stone giant, while still gargantuan in height, is much smaller
than it's mate.  This giant moves with a grace unexpected by something her
size.  For a huge monster, she is actually quite beautiful in appearance...

16002.l: A strange mist floats about here.
16002.d:
As you look at the clouds around you, one cloud in particular resembles
a long serpentine dragon.  You take pride in your moment of insight, until
you realize the dragon moves in order to get a better look at you as well!
This must be Windsheer, the legendary dragon of mist...

16003.l: A roc looms all about you.
16003.d:
The shadow this enormous beast casts is enough to place you in momentary
darkness.  Large enough to carry away a full sized elephant in it's grasp,
and capable of biting a tree in half with it's large powerful beak, you
shudder to think what this bird could do to a man...

16004.d:
Perched upon a rock before you is what appears to be a huge lion.  The
wings sprouting from the dragonne's shoulders are one thing, but the
bronze scales all over the beast's body in place of fur are another, and
are testaments to the wonder of this exotic beast.  Golden eyes look at you
inquisitively.

16005.l: An old climber pokes about here.
16005.d:
This old-timer looks flustered, and totally bewildered.  A long, 
furrowing beard trails down from the old man's chin, and craven eyes show
the desperation of this poor old fellow.  Ripped clothes and small injuries
cover the old man.  Evidently a climber who lost his way long ago...

16006.l: A stone spider crawls about here.
16006.d:
You swear your looking at a strange rock formation, when you notice it
move.  Eight legs carry this strange beast, sporting nasty looking mandibles
and cold stone-like eyes.  The creature's body seems made of the stone itself
and proves to be resilient against physical damage...

16007.l: A grey ooze gurgles about here.
16007.d:
Your looking at an animated stone-colored puddle of goo.  Merely looking
upon this strange beast is enough to disgust you, you don't even want to 
think how this creature consumes it's prey.

16008.d:
This goat has large nasty looking horns coming from it's head.  
Fortunately, the goat seems to pay you no mind...
16008.noise: You hear small stones clattering down the mountainside nearby.

16009.l: A stone golem lumbers mindlessly about here.
16009.d:
A brutish humanoid creature created directly from the stone.  The
creature's face is an expressionless slab of stone, and seemingly pays you
no mind, as it moves about without apparent aim.
16009.noise: You hear the crunching of stone nearby.

16010.d:
Flying through the sky with a graceful ease is one of the most beautiful
creatures you've ever seen.  This white winged horse appears to walk on the
air itself.  You have the feeling this winged horse is judging your 
character, as it glances your way with it's warm, purple eyes.

16100.d:
A winged human with golden skin and glowing golden eyes.  Your unsure if the
deva is a devine creature or a magical construct, considering it's unsual
appearance.  Then again, almost nothing in Elysium is exactly what one would
expect.  Regardless, the deva looks like it means business.

16101.d:
The naga appears as a twenty foot long snake with green gold scales and
a humanoid head.  Silver ridges line the spine of the naga, which shift in
dizzying motion as the naga looks at you with strange, yet beautiful golden
eyes.

16102.l: A faerie dragon flutters about here.
16102.d:
What first appeared as a flying cat is upon closer inspection actually a
tiny dragon.  The large, butterfly like wings of the faerie dragon keep it
aloft as it grins at you in a most upsurd way while making all sorts of
beeping and clicking sounds.

spw.name: A path around the Elysium Kingdom
A path around the Elysium Kingdom

16103.d:
With large violet, red, and orange colored wings spread out before you,
the phoenix is truly a sight to behold.  Ruby colored eyes look at you
nervously as the blue-violet beak and claws click together in apprehension.
The phoenix's plumage gives it the illusion of being aflame.  Or is it 
illusion?

16104.d:
Feathers cover the body of this snake, and end in a crop of tail feathers
at the tail of the coatyl.  Wings jut from the back of the creature, granting
it flight.  Aside from the serpent like appearance of this beast, it's eyes
tell of a divine goodness belittling it's evil visage.

spw.name: A path around the Elysium Kingdom

16105.l: A cockatrice lightly steps about here.
16105.d:
The cockatrice resembles a rooster with scales covering a large portion of
it's body and large, reptillian wings sprouting from it's back.  The tail of
the cockatrice is a long, snake-like tail which ends in a plume of feathers.

spw.name: A path around the Elysium Kingdom

16106.l: A golden horse floats in the air here.
16106.d:
Light dances across the golden hair of this marvelous horse like creature.
A long, flowing golden mane trails behind the ki-rin and whips about in the
air like a great cape.  A single spiraling horn juts from the beast's forehead
and seems to have an inner luminosity, much the same as the hooves that enable
him to hover in the air.

16107.d:
A two and half foot tall elven creature flies about supported by insect
like wings.  The strange grinning face gives you the impression this small
fellow can be a trouble maker...

spw.name: A path around the Elysium Kingdom

16108.d:
Standing before you is a large, winged feline with the head of a human male.
The hair on the beast's head is long, unkept, and pointing out in all 
directions, giving it's head the appearance of having a mane.

16109.d:
Small circle-shaped brass scales cover Arathorn, reflecting the light

shining upon him, and giving him the appearance of being aflame.  A curved
plate-like protrusion extends out of the base of Arathorn's skull, 
complimented by the two, scaley whiskers jutting from his grinning lower
jaw.  Twin, fan shaped fin-like wings protruding from his back, slowly flap
in apprehension.

16110.l: A copper dragon stomps about here.
16110.d:
Large, odd-shaped copper plates cover the back of Dracmus's back, while
his underbelly is lined with fine stone shaped copper plates.  Large, 
fin-like wings protrude from his back, somewhat resembling a large sailfish.
A single, curved horn juts from the back of his skull, and curves downward
adding to the regal appearance of this majestic dragon.

16111.l: A gold dragon glides through the air here.
16111.d:
Slinking through the air with an unnatural ease and grace is Goldscale.
Goldscale has no wings, yet flies as though his long serpentine body is held
aloft by the very air itself.  Resembling a 54 foot long snake with legs,

Goldscale is covered in beautiful golden scales, accentuated by hair-like
golden scales lining his spine.  Large golden eyes look down upon you as if
in judgement...

16112.l: A platinum dragon stands in majesty here.
16112.d:
Looming before you is the massive form of Bahamut, king of good dragons
and the ruler of the Elysium Castle.  All manner of exotic creatures of good
and neutral alignment pay homage to Bahamut, and in return have free access
to the divine kingdom.  Light dances across the 72 foot long body covered in
silvery gold scales.  Wispy, ethereal whiskers jut from several places on
Bahamut's face, and twin, spiraling horns jut from Bahamut's head.  As you
look into the large, lantern-like eyes, you feel more than know the awesome
power he wields...

16113.d:
Flitting about before you is a beautiful, naked female human with 
transparent wings sprouting from her shoulders.  A transparent weblike cloth
is wrapped around her, giving her a lightweight, wispy appearance.

spw.name: A path around the Elysium Kingdom

16114.d:
The haunches of a lion and the forelegs, wings and head of an eagle is the
griffon.  Stories of how traveller's have lost their horses to this creature
come to mind, and seem much more believable now, as the griffon looks large
enough to easily kill a horse and fly away with it.

16115.d:
Flapping it's wings above you is a creature with the body of a horse, yet
with the head and front legs of an eagle.  The hippogriff pays you no mind,
and seems to have an air of indifference about it.

spw.name: A path around the Elysium Kingdom

16116.d:
The pseudo dragon looks like a small, foot long red dragon.  The appearance
of being a red dragon of any size is unnerving giving the evil nature of red
dragons, there is also a scorpion's stinger at the end of the dragon's tail,
adding to your sense of paranoia...

16117.d:
The shedu resembles the winged horse, pegasus, but has a human head with
a long, well kept beard.  Though noble-looking, this powerfully strong
creature appears ready to assist those in need, and to battle evil.

16118.d:
The spinx appears as a winged lion with the head and upper torso of a naked
human female.  Strange yet wonderous to gaze upon, the seven foot tall spinx
returns your gaze rather inquisitively.

16119.d:
A golden brown camel with the wings of an eagle, the feet of a monkey, and
the head of a monkey at the end of a long, snake-like neck covered in fur.
An extremely bizarre looking creature, something about the opinicus instills
a sense of paranoia in you.

16120.d:
Forty-two foot long, and covered in bronze plates, Ridgeback is quite a 
sight to behold.  Spikes connected by scaley webbing protrude from his head
to his tail, going between the large, fin-like wings jutting from his
shoulders.  The smooth, benevolent looking face belittles the large, sinister
looking claws attached to the muscled feet of this dragon.

16121.l: Flax, the garden keeper, flitters about here.
16121.d:
Flax is a very intelligent, gold plated bird, no bigger than your head.
Flax looks at you in mild interest with small, emerald colored eyes.

16122.d:
A golden brown camel with the wings of an eagle, the feet of a monkey, and
the head of a monkey at the end of a long snake-like neck.  Foosa resembles
his other opinicus brethren in that he looks rather bizarre, and instills in
you a sense of paranoia.

16123.d:
Standing before you is a large, winged feline with the head of a human.
The hair on Kir-lan's head is long, unkept and pointing out in all directions,
giving his head the appearance of having a mane.

16124.l: A ki-rin stands here, glittering in the bright light.
16124.d:
Light dances across the golden hair of this marvelous horse like creature.
A long, flowing golden mane trails behind Lardran and whips about in the air
like a great cape.  A single spiraling horn juts from his forehead and seems
to have an inner luminosity, much the same as the hooves that enable him to
hover in the air.

16125.d:
Flitting about before you is what resembles a beautiful naked female human
with transparent wings sprouting from her shoulders.  A transparent web-like
cloth is wrapped around Shaldra giving her a lightweight, wispy appearance.

16200.l: A short green humanoid is here chanting before the altar.
16200.d:
It's about three feet tall, has large yellow eyes and lots of small sharp
teeth. A large human skull with the left side crushed in is emblazoned in
crude stitches across the back of it's robe.
16200.noise: A shrill gibbering chant breaks the silence.

16201.l: A little green runt runs around here spearing frogs.
16201.d:
It looks like a cross between a pig and a midget, standing about two feet
tall with a little pot belly and lots of nasty little teeth.

16202.l: A big chubby frog hops around here.
16202.d:
It's about a five pounder you figure, little yellow spots cover it's green
skin.

16203.s: a wriggling mass of carnivorous vines
16203.l: A large mass of vines rise from the ground here.
16203.d:
A mass of vines nearing ten feet in length and thick as your leg slurps
across the forest floor here.  Sharp cone-like spikes cover them making
strange sucking sounds.
16203.noise: You hear a very quiet sucking noise.

spw.name: In the Dense Undergrowth of Darkwood Forest

16204.l: An ugly fat scaled humanoid is here gnawing on a bone.
16204.d:
This squat green humanoid is barely over four feet tall, his belly
hanging slightly over his rough leather belt. His large yellow eyes
seem to display about as much intelligence as your average farm animal.
16204.noise: You think you hear a twig snap somewhere nearby.

16205.l: A scrawny little green goblin is sneaking around here.
16205.d:
This little goblin is dressed in soft stinky leathers and a long smelly
cloak. He looks like he's concentrating real hard to remember where he is.
16205.noise: You hear something rustle in the bushes.

16206.l: A wounded elven adventurer is lying here bleeding.
16206.d:
His armor is dented and cut in many places, blood covers most of his chest
and legs. Looks like whatever this elf went after had him for lunch.

spw.name: In the Dense Undergrowth of Darkwood Forest

16207.l: A tough green-scaled guard leans against the wall.
16207.d:
This smallish humanoid is about four feet tall, well muscled and
looks dumb as a post.  If not for the wicked little claws on it's fingers
and a face full of sharp teeth you'd dismiss it entirely.

16208.l: A burly goblin guard stands here glaring at you.
16208.d:
Well-muscled and standing about four and a half feet tall this goblin
looks ready to fight, in fact, from all the scars it looks as if
it's all this dim-witted creature does.
16208.noise: You hear a loud grunt nearby.

drp.name: a suit of rusty iron armor

16209.l: An evil little creature is here mixing stinking reagents in a bowl.
16209.d:
He looks like most of the other goblins you've seen here, this one may
seem a little more intelligent than the rest, but he also looks to be
totally insane.  He wears tattered leather robes and clothing covered in
messy written runes, bones, and what looks like decomposing hunks of flesh.
16209.noise: You hear strange guttural chanting coming from somewhere nearby.

16210.l: A big fat goblin female is wondering around aimlessly here.
16210.d:
Long black muddy hair, big yellow eyes, green skin, topped off
with a rotten little bone through her nose makes this one Uuugly goblin.

spw.name: NE Corner of a Large Open Chamber
SE Corner of a Large Open Chamber

16211.l: A chubby goblin female is sitting here tossing hunks of flesh into a cauldron.
16211.d:
It's a fat green female goblin with a bone through her nose and
lots of mud caked in her wiry black hair.

spw.name: SW Corner of a Large Open Chamber

16220.l: A large vicious wolf prowls around here.
16220.d:
It's a large wolf with long sharp fangs and charcoal grey hide. As it
turns it's glowing yellow eyes on you a low growl begins low in it's
throat.

spw.name: A Path in the Darkwood Forest

16221.s: a huge green and amber shelled tortoise
16221.l: A massive green and amber shelled tortoise is standing here.
16221.d:
This is one BIG tortoise, you guess it probably weighs over 200 pounds and
stands about five feet tall to the top of it's back.
The whole creature is dark mossy-green with large hexagon-shaped amber
spots across it's shell.

16222.l: A large black panther is stalking prey here.
16222.d:
It looks like a shadow with large yellow eyes, moving so fluidly and
silently through the undergrowth that it's hard to keep track of where
it is. Then it stops and looks directly at you, bares it's long 
deadly teeth at you and hisses loudly.
16222.noise: You feel like there is something watching you.

spw.name: On a Path Through Darkwood Forest

16223.l: A little catfish swims past your foot.
16223.d:
It's about six inches long and has a flat head with feelers sprouting
from the sides of it's wide mouth.

16224.l: A short green humanoid is leaning against the wall here.
16224.d:
This stocky humanoid is about four feet tall, well-muscled and
looks dumb as a post.  If not for the wicked little claws on it's fingers
and a face full of sharp teeth you'd dismiss it entirely.

16225.l: A short stocky humanoid is sitting here.
16225.d:
This stocky humanoid is about four feet tall, well muscled and looks
dumb as a post.  If not for the wicked little claws on it's fingers
and a face full of sharp teeth you'd dismiss it entirely.

16226.l: A short stocky humanoid is leaning against the wall here.
16226.d:
This stocky humanoid is about three feet tall, well muscled and looks
dumb as a post.  If not for the wicked little claws on it's fingers
and a face full of sharp teeth you'd dismiss it entirely.

16227.l: A burly goblin guard is gnawing on a hunk of flesh here.
16227.d:
It's about three and a half feet tall, has a muscular green 
covered body, and doesn't seem to be overly intelligent.  It's little
fat fingers end in short black claws, and it has a jaw full on nasty
little sharp pointed teeth.
16227.noise: Something lets out a loud belch.

spw.name: A Guard Post in the Passage

16228.l: A short fat humanoid is sleeping here.
16228.d:
This short little humanoid looks like most the other's you've seen
except for the fact he's extremely overweight, his green belly
hangs almost halfway down to his knees. He wears mostly furs,
including a large wolf head fashioned into a grotesque helmet.

spw.name: A Guard Post in the Passage

16229.l: A little green goblin is running around here.
16229.d:
He's a little green bastard about a foot and a half tall. You
wonder why he's running around in circles and drooling all over himself,
stopping only on occasion to run into a wall or trip over something.
16229.noise: You hear a loud idiotic giggle.

16230.l: A mean goblin guard is standing here.
16230.d:
This green goblin is covered in muscle, and looks like he has been
through quite a few battles. Though not intelligent by any means, this
mean guard looks a lot more aware than the others you've seen.

16231.l: An evil-looking old goblin lord is sitting on the throne here.
16231.d:
He is covered in brown and green scales, has large slanted yellow eyes
and three to four inch wicked ebony claws sprouting from his gnarled fingers 
and toes.

drp.name: the Goblin Lord's elven skin cloak

16290.l: An enormous Darkwood tree seems to move slightly.
16290.d:
This massive black trunked tree reaches over twenty feet into the sky.
Although it is not nearly as tall as most of the trees around it, it
is quiet a lot thicker, it resembles a huge barrel with thick limbs.
Staring up at the huge ancient tree you realize that if it can move
it could probably crush you like a bug.

spw.name: A Small Trail in Darkwood Forest

16291.l: A big fat slimy toad is sitting in the fountain here.
16291.d: It's a big one, probably a ten pounder.
16291.noise: You hear a strange croaking sound *RRrrriiibit*

16300.l: A tired old recruiter sits behind the desk here.
16300.d:
He looks like he's pushing fifty or so, has thin greying hair and a long
scar running down his left cheek.

16301.d:
Either his crops aren't doing so hot or this guy is just tired of working
in the dirt, what ever the reason he's come to try his luck at city service.

16302.l: A new recruit is wandering around here.
16302.d:
He looks like your average lower class citizen, hoping to make a career
in the Kir Drax'in city guard.

16303.l: A grey outfitted guard trainee is here.
16303.d:
Dressed in a simple grey jumpsuit, this trainee looks a little confused as
to what he's suppose to be doing.

spw.name: Kir Drax'in Guard Basic Training - Level One
Kir Drax'in Guard Basic Training - Level One
Kir Drax'in Guard Basic Training - Level One
Kir Drax'in Guard Basic Training - Level One

16304.l: A chubby instructor is here yelling at the trainees.
16304.d:
He's about five and a half feet tall, wearing a grey uniform with
"instructor" stenciled on a small white patch on his left shoulder.
Although he's about thirty or fourty pounds over weight he stands iron
straight and barks commands and instructions at the trainees with a grim
serious look on his face.

spw.name: Kir Drax'in Guard Basic Training - Level One

16305.l: A white outfitted guard trainee is here.
16305.d:
Dressed in a simple white jumpsuit, this trainee looks a little confused
about what he's supposed to be doing.

spw.name: Kir Drax'in Guard Basic Training - Level Two
Kir Drax'in Guard Basic Training - Level Two
Kir Drax'in Guard Basic Training - Level Two
Kir Drax'in Guard Basic Training - Level Two

16306.l: A green outfitted guard trainee is here.
16306.d:
This trainee looks a little bit tougher and skillful than those on
the previous levels. Maybe this training course does work.

spw.name: Kir Drax'in Guard Basic Training - Level Three
Kir Drax'in Guard Basic Training - Level Three
Kir Drax'in Guard Basic Training - Level Three
Kir Drax'in Guard Basic Training - Level Three

16307.l: A brown armored guard trainee stands here.
16307.d:
This man's time in the training centre has obviously been well spent.
He seems highly trained and no doubt deadly.

spw.name: Kir Drax'in Guard Basic Training - Level Four
Kir Drax'in Guard Basic Training - Level Four
Kir Drax'in Guard Basic Training - Level Four
Kir Drax'in Guard Basic Training - Level Four

16308.l: A big, burly guard dressed in all black guards the door.
16308.d: He looks big and mean. He regards you with a sneer and shakes his head.

16309.l: An initiate of the Kir Drax'in guard stands here.
16309.d:
He looks like every other guard you've ever seen, big, menacing
and a complete zombie.

16310.l: An old priest hands out equipment to the initiates.
16310.d:
This old cleric acts as a quartermaster for the church, insuring that
the church guard is kept in the best equipment.

16350.l: A fanatical priest gives the initates their holy orders.
16350.d:
He is a rather tall man with long wirey white hair and beady little black
eyes. A long black robe with a strange symbol resembling a burning heart
emblazoned in gold across the back.

16400.l: A massive Tyannosaurus Rex rears up before you.
16400.d:
It is a gigantic beast with dark scaly skin and huge claws. It look at you with
as he is about to chomp  you in one single bite.
16400.noise: The ground shakes under your feet.

16401.l: a gigantic brontosaurus is here chewing on some leaves.
16401.d:
this is a enormous beast probably the biggest living think you
have ever seen, he has a huge body with a long tail and a long
neck sorta like a griaffe.  I'd be careful thou woudn't want
him to not see you and step on you.

16402.l: An large velociraptor scans the area for it's next victim...
16402.d:
this is a menacing looking animal, it stand about 6 feet tall and has some
menacing looking claws on it's legs.  It moves with a swiftness unexpected of a animal of it's size. It almost looks like a giant scaled ostrage.

16403.l: A duck billed dinosaur is here, eating some small shrubs.
16403.d: This dinosaur looks sort of like a gorilla with a long head and a ducks beak.

16404.l: A large strange looking dinosaur is here, feeding on some ferns.
16404.d:
This is a strange looking dinosaur, it has large plates sticking out of it's
back and has some large spines at the end of it's tail.

16405.l: A rhinosourus looking dinosaur is here, mangeling some vegatation.
16405.d: It looks like a rhinosourus only with 3 horns and heavy armoring.

16406.l: A heavy muscular looking beast is here, chewing on some tree limbs.
16406.d:
This dinosaur looks very muscular and heavy, it's legs looking like pillars.
It glances at you then continues with feeding itself, you think to yourself
what a strange beast.

16407.l: A green and grey reptile is here, swinging it's clubbed tail around.
16407.d:
It has a green armored shell with spikes on it, with a grey body. It's tail
has a large boney club at the end. I'd watch out or it might pound you.

16408.l: A small thorny lizard is chasing after some small insects.
16408.d: It is a small green lizard, it's entire body is covered with tiny little thorns.

16409.l: A heavily armored reptile slowly lumbers around.
16409.d: This reptile sorta look like a aligator with small head.

16410.l: A gigantic dinosaur is lumbering around here, muching on treetops.
16410.d:
This is surely the largest beast you have ever seen with your own eyes.
This beast stand about forty feet tall, and is about seventy feet long, it
must weigh over sixty-five tones at least.  You would be incredibly foolish
to try to harm such a beast.

16498.d: it looks like a good mob to level on

16499.l: Striker is here, kicking some ass.
16499.d:
Striker is a enormous man, almost godlike, you feel that you have steped in
the wrong room, you better get the hell out of here!

18000.l: The sword appears to be made of a violet crystal, it glows with some hidden     power.

18001.l: A Waywatcher stands here, guarding the entrance to Athel Loren.
18001.d:
He is a Wood Elf Waywatcher they are masters of camoflauge, often hidden.
They will attack if they see you are a danger to the forest.

18002.d: His red nose and pungent odor leaves little to the imagination.

18003.l: An Irishwoman whistles merrily to herself.

18004.l: A guest stands here ready to get a room.

18005.l: Bono is here singing one of his new tunes.
18005.d: Hold me, thrill me, kiss me, kill me.

18006.l: An IRA member snarls at you.

18007.l: Kevin is here, waiting to get you a drink.
18007.d: Tell him all of your problem, he's a bartender, he's use to it.

18009.l: Father O' Malley is here, writing at his desk.
18009.d: I wouldn't let MY children near him.

18011.l: A little boy is crouched in the corner.
18011.d: He looks harmless, yet extremely frightened.

18040.l: Mrs. McCaskey is here to teach you some biology.
18040.d: Never get shot in the stomach, cause you could die from bacterial infection.

18075.l: St. Patrick is here, chasing away snakes.

18100.l: Murphy is here, chewing on anything he can get his mouth on.
18100.d: Don't make this mob over level 35

18101.l: A borogrove is sitting on a thorny branch here looking mimsy.
18101.d:
A borogrove is a thin and shabby looking bird with feathers sticking out
all around.  Borogroves look something like live mops; in general they
look mimsy -- flimsy and miserable.  The do not even sing well, in
fact their song has been found to ivoke violent reactions in most people.

18102.l: A slithy tove is sitting here looking confused.
18102.d:
Toves are small but fierce burrowing mammals; they are something like
badgers, something like lizards, and something like corkscrews.  They are,
indeed, strange creatures.  The best word to describe them is slithy which
means lithe and slimy.
It is common knowledge that the favorite food of a tove is tumtum fruit.

18103.l: A trimmer's helper is here, picking up clippings and tending the hedges.
18103.d:
The helper is dressed in thick, protective clothes so that the thorns do
not poke her.  She is walking around picking up hedge clippings but she
seems to be very nervious; she checks over her shoulder every now so
often.

18104.l: The Jabberwock, with eyes of flame, is whiffling through the air here.
18104.d:
The Jabberwock is a fearful bandersnatch; his bright eyes constantly glance
this way and that searching for prey to devour.  His large jaw is lined
with fearfully sharp teeth and long claws grow from his arms.  Two big,
leathery wings sprout from his back and his long, thrashing tail looks
dragon-like.  I hope he doesn't see you or you will become dinner!

18201.d: One of Kir-Oshi's citizens, out on errands no doubt.

18202.d:
One of the poorer denziens of the city, this commoner looks like he could use
a good meal.

18203.l: A wharf rat scurries around your feet.
18203.d:
This vermin has the lean look of pestilence and disease in his eye.
Wharf rats are an unfortunate side effect of Kir-Oshi's bustling port.

18204.l: Piyun the baker is here, taking a break from cooking to tend your needs.
18204.d: You see that he is a large and formidable man, probably from all the sweets.

18205.d: Definitely not one of the friendliest bartenders you've ever seen.

18206.l: Shonya the florist is here, tending a bonzai tree.
18206.d:
She's a petite little wisp of woman, with long silken black hair that
reaches almost to her knees.

18207.l: Kane the weaponsmith is here polishing his already glowing weapons.
18207.d:
You see a man who looks old but timeless.  Even without all of these weapons
you know he could hurt you real bad.

18208.l: Guiee is here, taking in all the smells that fish have to offer.
18208.d: You see a large man... the manager/owner of the famous Guiee's Sushi Bar.

18209.l: An old, steely-eyed receptionist is here, bitching at the world in general.
18209.d:
This is a fat, old man that hates the world we live in, and doesn't mind telling
you that over and over.

18210.l: A hip young clerk is showing off her goods.
18210.d:
You see a little blonde girl showing off the best of imported goods from
far away lands. She looks out of place amid all the dark haired citizens of
this town.

18211.l: A large attack guard looks at you with death in his eyes... your death.
18211.d:
This is a huge, burly attack guard with an attitude.
He really want to kick your ass.

18212.l: Tan Lee, the armorer, is here cleaning the metal that will save your life.
18212.d:
Tan lee is scarred from many a battle, but you believe the only reason he is
here to sell you anything at all is because he knows his armor.

drp.name: a pair of scale mail gloves
a pair of scale mail sleeves
a pair of scale mail boots

items_sold.name: a pair of scale mail gloves
a pair of scale mail sleeves

18213.l: A balding tattooist in a monk's garment stands here.
18213.d:
He's an aging bald man with a brown robe and gnarled fingers. Tattoos cover
him from head to toe.

18214.l: A cloaked man stands here, lost in thought.
18214.d:
You can't see his face, but the point of a goatee sticks out of the shadows
created by his hood. He looks quite muscular but not threatening.

18215.l: A Kir-Oshi guard defends the city walls.
18215.d:
He is a brave but simple warrior, trained from birth for this job
To be a guard for his city is his greatest joy, and he does the job
well.

18216.l: Lou Ching gives you an icy stare.
18216.d:
Lou Ching, master of nefarious and covert tactics.  Don't trust him
even if he is right in front of you.

18217.l: Ts'ao Ts'ao the Ancient Protector stands here.
18217.d:
Perhaps one of the greatest generals of his time, the gods saw fit
to have Ts'ao live on to protect his native land.
He exudes a great aura of physical power.

18218.d: Careful, these guys are slicker than grease.

18219.l: An ancient Zen master wanders about.
18219.d:
He walks about, aware of the world, but at the same time aware of
another reality completely.  He has found the inner peace.

18220.l: A shaolin monk is here, contemplating.
18220.d:
Though by no means a master, the shaolin monk is certainly
adept at contemplating higher realities.  He also looks like
he's pretty athletic.

18221.l: An assassin from the Liu'she Ch'uan tong sneaks about.
18221.d:
The tong assassin is the executioner of those who have gone against
the tong in some way.  Better hope he's not looking for you.

18222.l: A sailor walks around, stretching his sea-legs.
18222.d:
He's just out looking for a good time.
That, and some 2 dollar hookers.

18223.l: A harbor guard guards the port.
18223.d: He's nothing but a hired thug.

18224.l: The harbor master maintains order on the pier.
18224.d:
The harbor master is a big fat guy who smokes a long-stem pipe.
He looks pretty burly though, better not mess with him.

18225.l: Wu'Chien silently observes your every move.
18225.d:
Once a ninja for the Liu'she Ch'uan tong, he is now Ronin - but
none the less dangerous.

18226.d:
A ruthless, sinister, and dishonorable fighter. Tor Waki is blood thirsty and
is always looking for a good fight.  Too bad he's such a coward.

18227.l: An old, blind monk tries to reach Nirvana.
18227.d:
He sits in Samahdei, perfectly in tune with his environment. No
doubt he is aware of your presence, even though he cannot see you.

18228.l: A clerk shuffles some papers around and calls it work.
18228.d: He obviously works for the home office.

18301.l: A red checker piece tries to jump on you.
18301.d:
It looks just like a regular plstic red checker piece, only larger. Theres
is a small face with dark, beady eyes and a mouth rimmed with sharp teeth.

18302.l: A black checker piece tries to jump on you.
18302.d:
It looks just like a black checker pience, only much larger.  There is a small
face with dark beady eyes and a moth rimmed with sharp teeth.

18303.l: A red checker king attempts to crush you.
18303.d:
It looks like a checker king, no doubt about that except for the face with
those dark eyes and mouth with sharp teeth, you can imagine it playing a big
roll in a game of checkers.

18304.l: A black checker king attempts to crush you.
18304.d:
It looks like a checker king, no doubt about that except for the face with
those dark eyes and mouth with sharp teeth, you can imagine it playing a big
roll in a game of checkers.

18305.l: A very large, burly cleaner is cleaning up here.
18305.d:
What a nasty looking being.  It is just a lump of twisted flesh, that looks
somewhat humaniod, but still..  There are scars all over his fleshy body.
There is no way this could be a natural creature.

18306.l: A cute little striped cat is here.
18306.d:
This is a cute, but seemingly magical cat.  I wouldn't mess with her, she is
someones favorite pet.  She (you can tell it is a she by looking for, well,
let us just say that she has the 'parts' of a female cat) is smallish with
grey and black stripes and some well placed tuffs of white fur.  She is so
cute it makes you feel all warm and fuzzy just looking at her.

18400.l: The Conductor stands here collecting tickets.
18400.d:
He looks like a normal conductor... but as you look closer you see that
he is not normal... he has no flesh, just bones.

18401.l: The Black Undead Knight is here looking for a fight.

18402.l: The Red Undead Knight is here looking for a fight.

18403.l: A Grubby Scavenger Man is hear scrounging up what he can.

18404.l: A whisp of air, a shadow, then nothing...
18404.d:
You can't see it, not really see it anyway.  There is nothing to look
at, but you know it is there.

18601.l: A great horned beast walks toward you menacingly.
18601.d: A huge humanoid beast with dark leathery skin and huge ram-like horns.

18602.l: A swift running creature hisses as it rushes toward you.
18602.d:
Humanoid in appearance, it's eyes gleam with a feral intelligence. Mottled
grey skin and talon-like fingers end any resemblance to a human.

18603.l: An evil looking brown humanoid hisses as it sees you.
18603.d: It has an angry, evil countenance.

18604.l: The pale thing looks for prey.
18604.d: A tall, lean, pale, ugly thing.

18701.l: A small grazing cow is here.
18701.d: This is a small version of a normal milking cow.

18702.l: A small grazing bull is here.

18703.l: An ender gateguard is here keeping out the unwanted element.
18703.d:
He is a smallish humanoid but is well defined and looks very mean, when he
wants to be.

18704.l: An ender guard is here keeping out the unwanted element.
18704.d:
He is a smallish humanoid but is well defined and looks very mean, when he
wants to be.

18705.l: A royal ender guard is here protecting the king and queen.
18705.d:
This little humanoid looks quite tough, maybe that is why he is protecting the
king and queen.

18706.l: The ender king is here ruling over his small domain.
18706.d:
Though he looks a little old and maybe feeble, he did not get to be king by
being weak or inept with weapons.

18707.l: The ender queen is here helping her husband.
18707.d: She is a small humanoid, but looks strong, both with words and her blade.

18708.l: An adult male ender is slinking around here.
18708.d:
This smallish humanoid looks very sneaky.  It looks as though he could be a
great thief or maybe even an assassin.

18709.l: An adult female ender is slinking around here.
18709.d:
This smallish humanoid looks very sneaky.  It looks as though she could be as
great thief as any male in this village

18710.l: A little ender boy is here playing.
18710.d:
This tiny little humanoid has very quick hands as you see him playing here.
He does not seem to notice you, but you are sure he knows you are about.

18711.l: A little ender girl is here playing.
18711.d:
This tiny little humanoid has very quick hands as you see her playing here.
She seems quite oblivious to you but her movements seem to be reacting to your
own.

18712.l: A little dragoon is here looking with googly eyes.
18712.d: This is some kind of little dragon, actually it is more like a lizard.

18713.l: An ender cook is here cooking away.
18713.d:
This ender looks a little bulkier than a standard ender male.  He is heavily
powdered in flour.

18714.l: An ender smithy is here pounding away on some steel.
18714.d:
This ender is lot bigger than all the other enders, obviously from his work on
metal.   He is still not even average humanoid size.

18715.l: An ender tailor is here working on some sewing project.
18715.d:
This ender is smaller than average, but looks trim and strong.  Her fingers are
obviously very nimble as she works around a piece of cloth with her needle.

18716.l: Torak the Ender is here, ready to pounce.
18716.d:
Torak is a tough looking humanoid.  It looks as though he really wants to
kill you.

18717.l: The Ender King's Advisor frets here.
18717.d:
He looks like a seedy character, which is unusual for this race.  How
strange... maybe he is hiding something.

19100.l: A glowing Phantom Crewmember lurks here.
19100.d:
This ethereal being looming before you seems to pay you no mind as it goes 
about a seemingly predestined chore.

19101.l: Skullgrin, captain of the Ocean Fate looms before you.
19101.d:
Captain Skullgrin appears as a floating decomposing humanoid.  The tattered
clothing wrapped around his skeletal frame shows signs of freshly splattered
blood.  An eyepatch covers his left eye, and you are glad of that small
comfort considering the immense evil eminating from the dark eyeless 
socket where his right eye should be.  The evil surrounding the captain
chills you to the bone.  No wonder the permanent residents of the ship bow
to him...

19102.l: A Ghastly Sea Serpent lies in wait here...
19102.d:
Looming before you is a gargantuan rotting serpent.  Old dry flesh still
seems to stick to the bones of this behemoth monster in patches.  A dark
smoke eminates from it's mouth, and sends chills up and down your spine.
The glowing red eyes seems to transfix you as it prepares to make a meal
of you!

19103.l: A rotting Lookout stands watch here.
19103.d:
Hanging about before you is the ship's lookout.  This unnatural being's 
body has been ravaged by time and evil.  The rags barely concealing the
rotting corpse make you thankful there is a slight wind up here, 
otherwise the smell alone could probably be enough to do you in...

19104.d:
This flying apparition of a seagull looks like it missed one too many meals.
Half rotted flesh and dusty feathers do little to conceal the thin
skeletal frame of this former avian.

19105.l: A Ghostly Cabinboy stumbles about here.
19105.d:
This specter floating about before you resembles an animated shadow.  The
creature is a humanoid child in shape, with no apparent discernible 
features other than the pale white eyes set off by the dark form itself.

19106.d:
A half rotted canine stalks about you.  Flesh falls away from the beast
in chunks, revealing more and more of it's skeleton, and dried out 
intestines.  One side of the beast's face reveals a permanent hideous snarl.
As you listen in dismay to the low unearthly growl of the beast, you
notice its eyes watching your every move.

19107.d:
Lying before you is the remains of one of the ship's captives.  This lost
soul appears to be wearing what's left of some old imperial clothing,
hinting that in life they were sent to stop the captain.  Obviously they
failed...

19108.d:
This victim of the ages and evil has been here for a long time.  Dust 
collects on it's bones, giving it it's only true mass.  Wonder what this
person did to get thrown in the brig?

19109.d:
Another unfortunate victim of the captain's wrath, and time itself.  What
little remains of this apparition's garb suggests this was once a squire.
Hollow eyesockets look up at you pleadingly...

19110.d:
The empty eyesockets give you a creepy feeling that this being wishes to
share it's eternal misery with you.  The strange grin of the skeleton's
skull gives you a scare, as the moaning of the background walls helps to
entice your feelings of fright.

19111.l: An Undead Chef plods about here.
19111.d:
A grotesquely bloated quivering cadaver is all that remains of a former
chef.  The undead chef approaches you as if to offer you something to eat.
The mere sight of this phantasm is enough to frighten you and at the same
time make you lose your appetite...

19112.l: A Lost Soul shuffles about here.
19112.d:
Another hapless victim of an ancient tragedy that is this vessel.  Even
as you look upon the specter before you, you notice that you are also 
pearing through it as well.  The transparent, dim white glow of this 
figure gives you an eerie fright.

19113.l: The ship's Navigator looks around here.
19113.d:
Gripping the wheel firmly, this nightmarish corpse appears to be steering
the vessel for all eternity.  You wonder where those piercing, sinister,
decayed eyes are looking off to...

19114.d:
This creature from beyond looks very sturdy and seems confident in it's
rusted, hole-ridden armor.  Bone fragments and blood stains are sprinkled
about the floor in front of it.  The eyeless stare of this sentinel is
very unnerving.

19115.d:
Lingering before you is the apparition known as Dread, the first mate to
the captain.  This horrendous figure before you drips a spinetingling
mysterious glowing matter.  Dread's body is glowing in a rotting decay.
All semblages of flesh mix with what you guess is what's left of his garb,
and form an amorphous spotting all over the broken bones of the corpse
that is animated before you.

19116.d:
Stalking before you is a bloated disfigured humanoid corpse, atrophied
by evil.  It peers at you suspiciously with eyesockets emitting a dark
mist.

19117.d:
Hovering above you is Ravenwing, the captain's pet parrot.  Ravenwing
appears to not actually fly, but unnaturally hover in a semi-corporeal
nature.  How odd that a parrot have such dark plumage....

19118.l: A rotting Deckhand meanders about here.
19118.d:
The unfortunate soul before you  is forever damned to sail this cursed
vessel.  The ages have ravaged it's undead corpse to a point where it
can only be described as humanoid in apperance.

19119.l: A Bitter Wind wisps about here.

19400.l: Li Ting is here sitting upon his throne.
19400.d:
The master of the Fire Pagoda regards you with contempt in his smouldering
eyes.  A flaming aura surrounds him and seems to become more intense as
his rage grows stronger with each passing moment.

19401.d:
Jubei Kebogami is a Ronin assassin and mercenary for hire.
He looks like he could cut you to pieces without breaking a sweat.

19402.l: A shaolin monk walks around chanting.
19402.d:
A shaolin monk is chanting in some unknown language. He seems to ignore you
and your intrusion here.

19403.l: A shaolin monk wanders around here.
19403.d:
A shaolin monk is here experiencing himself subjectively.
It would be wise not to disturb him.

19404.l: A shaolin pupil is here seeking inner enlightenment.
19404.d:
A shaolin pupil looks like he's trying to find something. He constantly rubs
his bald head as if he's not yet used to being bald. Occasionally he trips
over his robe.

19405.l: The shaolin master is here, in perfect harmony with the Universe.
19405.d:
Quan Lo continues to chant softly as you look him over. Like the other monks
his head is clean shaved and wears only simple clothes and a robe. A long
beard hangs low from his chin.

19406.l: An old hermit sits here humming softly.
19406.d:
The hermit looks very old and smells like it too. His hair is very long and
is a dirty grey color. His beard comes down below his chest and small bits
of who-knows-what lie stuck within it.
19406.noise: You hear a soft humming coming from the cave to the west.

19407.l: A small flaming bird is here.
19407.d: A beautiful copper coloured bird that radiates a firey aura.

19408.l: A flame spirit dances about wildly.
19408.d:
This beings body is made completely of living flame, and it
dances wildly around the column of flame in the centre of the
room.

19409.l: A monk dressed in crimson robes tends the flame.
19409.d:
His crimson robes cover him from head to toe, making him appear
a bulky, amorphous parody of humanity.
19409.noise: You hear a low, steady chanting.

19410.l: An acolyte of the Flame stands in silence.
19410.d:
A young man, in crimson robes.  He is being trained to carry
on the mission of the Servants.
19410.noise: You hear a low, steady chanting.

19411.l: A ninja dressed in black tries to blend in with the scenery.

19412.l: A mysterious woman in dark robes stands here.
19412.d:
She is the wizard of this pagoda, a master of fire magic -
skilled and deadly.

drp.name: a necklace with little silver bells

19413.l: A monastic guard protects the temple from intruders.
19413.d:
He is a tall monk that wears armor and gets a kick out of
beating up heathens.

19500.l: A tall, well built avian floats here, guarding the temple.
19500.d:
The avian standing before you looks extremely well built, he stands about 
seven feet tall and is clad in a leather skirt lined with steel plates and no 
shirt.  This avian looks like he can handle himself extremely well in a fight.
He stands in front of you seemingly looking you over for something important.

spw.name: High Temple of the Avian Sun God

19501.s: Tylethal the Avian Prince of Order
19501.l: A tall, regal avian prince floats here, watching your movements.
19501.d:
The avian before you looks at the near physical peak of perfection for any 
man.  His body is covered with powerful, rippling muscles. He has a very 
confident stride in his walk which also reveals his expertise with nearly 
all forms of combat.  At his side is a beautifully gilded hilt with a fairly
large and imposing looking sword.

19502.s: Tarn'lothal the Avian Prince of Life
19502.l: A tall, majestic avian prince floats here contently.
19502.d:
Flowing almost like water from his back are a pair of majestic golden wings.  
He looks to be the most gorgeous man you have ever laid your eyes on.
You could even go so far as to call him angelic.

19503.l: An avian mummy shuffles around here.
19503.d:
The mummy standing before you reeks of death and decay.  It's covered from
head to toe in loose rotting bandages which seem to drag along the floor.  The
gaps between the bandages seem to show an almost birdlike or angelic build.

19504.l: An insane monk paces around here ranting incoherently.
19504.d:
This poor soul in front of you seems to have seen so much sun it's affected
his brain, he rants like a madman in your presence.  He's covered completely
in a very tattered brown monks habit.  When your eyes meet his you realize a
powerful aura radiating from his being.

19505.l: A winged templar is here guarding the ceremonies.
19505.d:
The soldier standing before you looks like he could handle himself
quite well in a rough situation.  He quickly bows his head and
mutters a solemn prayer when there is a new announcement from the
priest.  As you approach he looks you over rather quickly as if
deciding whether or not you are a threat.

19506.l: A guardian of the fallen sun god stands here defiantly.
19506.d: An extremely well built soldier stands here, he looks to be in his mid 30's and seems impossibly strong and fast.  He looks to be an extremely capable fighter.

19507.s: Jel'Tarina the Avian Princess of Desire
19507.l: A beautiful, regal avian princess floats here.
19507.d:
The beautiful creature hovering before you is clad in an almost transparent 
gown that flows around her supple body in a majestic way.  She has the 
most gorgeous set of silver wings you've ever seen, her eyes seem to 
be like pools of sapphires.

19508.s: Cel'Torina the Avian Princess of Prosperity
19508.l: A beautiful, noble avian princess floats here.
19508.d:
The beautiful woman floating before you is clad in a regal looking gown.
Sitting upon her head is a majestic diadem with a brilliant star sapphire in
the center.  She has a presence about her that draws people to her, and
in return she bestows upon the needy great prosperity.

19509.l: An elven soldier is hiding here watching you.
19509.d:
A tall, slender, well built soldier stands here in what looks to be camouflaged
chainmail.  He disappears and reappears as you watch him, moving with ease
through the woods.

19510.l: An elven sentinel stands here imposingly.
19510.d:
An powerful looking, well built individual stands here blocking your path.
He steps purposely in your way as you advance towards the gates leading 
into the camp.

19511.l: Tenelar the elven general, is here glaring at you.
19511.d:
Standing before you is a well seasoned elven general.  His armor is impeccably
polished, and scars cover his body from battles long forgotten.  At his waist
is a very ornate scabbard; in his hands is a radiant sword with a silvery sheen.

19515.l: A old quartermaster stands here waiting patiently.
19515.d:
A very old elf stands here before you, his face covered with scars from battles
over the long centuries of his life.  He looks quite content in retirement,
regaling the younger generation with tales of past heroics.

19516.l: A old quartermaster stands here patiently waiting.
19516.d:
A very old elf stands here before you, his face covered with scars from battles
over the long centuries of his life.  He looks quite content in retirement,
regaling the younger generation with tales of past heroics.

19520.l: A tall, well built avian floats here, guarding the temple.
19520.d:
The avian standing before you looks extremely well built, he stands about 
seven feet tall and is clad in a leather skirt lined with steel plates and no 
shirt.  This avian looks like he can handle himself extremely well in a fight.
He stands in front of you seemingly looking you over for something important.

spw.name: The Tomb of the Fallen Sun God

19521.l: A tall, well built avian floats here, guarding the temple.
19521.d:
The avian standing before you looks extremely well built, he stands about 
seven feet tall and is clad in a leather skirt lined with steel plates and no 
shirt.  This avian looks like he can handle himself extremely well in a fight.
He stands in front of you seemingly looking you over for something important.

19522.l: A tall, well built avian floats here, guarding the temple.
19522.d:
The avian standing before you looks extremely well built, he stands about 
seven feet tall and is clad in a leather skirt lined with steel plates and no 
shirt.  This avian looks like he can handle himself extremely well in a fight.
He stands in front of you seemingly looking you over for something important.

19523.l: A tall, well built avian floats here, guarding the temple.
19523.d:
It looks, err, unfinished.
The avian standing before you looks extremely well built, he stands about 
seven feet tall and is clad in a leather skirt lined with steel plates and no 
shirt.  This avian looks like he can handle himself extremely well in a fight.
He stands in front of you seemingly looking you over for something important.

19524.l: A tall, well built avian floats here, guarding the temple.
19524.d:
The avian standing before you looks extremely well built, he stands about 
seven feet tall and is clad in a leather skirt lined with steel plates and no 
shirt.  This avian looks like he can handle himself extremely well in a fight.
He stands in front of you seemingly looking you over for something important.

19601.l: A martial artist jumps out of the shadows, and into you.
19601.d:
Clothed entirely in black, the ninja is hard to see in the shadows.  She
appears to be coming towards you.

19602.l: Hovering a few feet above the ground meditates a NeoSunZ priest.
19602.d:
Known among his fellows as "Da-Leung" or big dragon, this ordained priest
of NeoSunZ ranks among the best fighters in the world. Six dots burned into
his shaven head represent his allegiance to his companions and his clan. He
wears a bright red and yellow robe made from a material similar to silk.
Enormous meditation beads hang around his neck as he repeats "Ah mi Nat
foh," over and over again.

19603.l: A homeless bum dreams of a new pair of underwear.
19603.d:
This poor fellow has made a cardboard box his residence. He seems to live off
selling water from pickle jars in a nearby cart. With one look at them,
however, you question whether or not they are sanitary. Unfortunately for the
bum, however, people seem to be stealing his water while he rests his
eyes. One word can describe this man, stinky like old cheese that smells really
bad.

19604.l: A gorgeous babe is lounging here by the jacuzzi side.
19604.d:
Long slender legs and a great smile too, Francine is all you ever dreamed of.
Her short brown hair and big brown eyes gives her an appearance of innocence.

19605.l: A resplendent maiden is here washing herself.
19605.d:
Anne looks very much like Francine, enough that they probably are even
sisters. A faint smile crosses her face as she glances in your direction.
You've never been in the company of such beautiful women before and you
are awe struck.

19606.l: The legendary Takeshi, Shiatsu Master is sweating from the heat.
19606.d:
Takeshi is a master of Shiatsu. He doesn't look very physically built, but you
can see the strength in his hands. His body glistens from sweat that drips down
his body like raindrops on a window. Slightly grayed hair reveals his possible
age to you, and covering his back is a somewhat faded tattoo of a sun coming up
over a horizon.

19607.l: A wobbly old man stands here leaning on a cane.
19607.d:
This doddering old fool is known only as grandpa to the men of NeoSunZ.
His once mighty sword arm now feebly grasps his white cane used to sturdy
his self on his wobbling legs.  WHITE CANE!  My God, he is blind too.  The
arrogance of NeoSunZ leadership leaving this artifact as the last guard to
their vast fortune.  What were they thinking?!?!

spw.name: A Grand View of the Skies

19608.l: A furry looking rabbit/cat cross breed is here looking for carrots.
19608.d:
This animal is fascinating and so CUTE! Its big eyes stare at you with it's
goofy happy grin as you ponder in amazement. You wonder what type of people
could own such a rare and cuddly "cabbit".

19610.l: The red-robed castle servant hovers before you.
19610.d:
The servant is an otherworldly spectre clad head to toe in a blood-red
robe.  He is a fixture of the castle, serving the needs of its owners for
all time.

The servant glows with a soft aura and seems to emit a faint humming noise.

spw.name: The Second Floor of a Tall Tower

19611.l: A red-skinned guardian genie bars your path.
19611.d:
The guardian genie has one face which watches forward and another which watches
backward. He has dark red skin as thick as rhinoceros hide and is completely
bald. His four, powerfully muscled arms makes him look like he'd be a formidable
warrior in combat. He stands ten feet tall and must weigh at least a ton.

19612.l: A gaunt-looking gladiator stands here in full battle armor.
19612.d:
This contagium was put here by his former master after attempting to
overthrow him. He has been brushed by the wings of all four apocalyptic
horsemen. This poor soul is now forced to fight his former comrades.

19626.l: A huge, deadly-looking genie stands here glaring at you.
19626.d:
Habib is a massive genie with four arms and dark, polished skin. He is naked
to the waist. Two of his hands are human; the other two resembles lion's paws
with ivory claws. His red eyes sparkle with flame. Above and between his two
eyes lies a third eye, which is green and resembles that of a panther. On his
back are two huge wings.

19627.l: A red-skinned guardian genie bars your path.
19627.d:
The guardian genie has one face which watches forward and another which watches
backward. He has dark red skin as thick as rhinoceros hide and is completely
bald. His four, powerfully muscled arms makes him look like he'd be a
formidable warrior in combat. He stands ten feet tall and must weigh at least
a ton.

19628.l: A gaunt-looking gladiator stands here in full battle armor.
19628.d:
This contagium was put here by his former master after attempting to
overthrow him. He has been brushed by the wings of all four apocalyptic
horsemen. This poor soul is now forced to fight his former comrades.

19629.l: Akasha, the Guardian Vampire bares her fangs as you approach.
19629.d:
Akasha's bright blue eyes and delicate silken eye lashes grace her apparition-
like complexion. She is wearing a frayed black cloak in which the hood is down
revealing long blonde hair tied in the back with a black ribbon. Her thin,
childlike mouth and delicate nose disclose the beauty she once had centuries
ago. Upon closer inspection, you notice glassy fingernails on limp hands at
her side. Standing stock still, this visionary nightmare is unlike anything
you've seen throughout the other rooms of the Pyramid.

19630.l: A sickly slave girl sits here, awaiting your command.
19630.d:
A thick iron collar is around her neck, attached to a bulky chain fastened
securely into the ground. Her skin is very pale, almost grey, and covered
with bruises and past scars, apparently from her misbehaviour. She has
stringy, matted black hair and deep black eyes.

19637.l: A beautiful woman lies playfully on the bed, kicking her legs in the air.
19637.d:
This playful woman exudes an air of confidence as she knows she is the master's
primary obsession.  The soft kicks of her legs in the air reveal the astounding
beauty of her slender body.  She twirls a strand of hair with her finger and
gently bites her bottom lip in anticipation of her master's return.

19638.l: A petite blonde lies naked in the bed, covering herself with a silk pillow.
19638.d:
While most of her body is covered by a large pillow, her sensuous smile and
soft green eyes seem extremely inviting.  Her short, blonde hair blows gently
with the breeze, giving her a truly heavenly appearance.  Her innocent
appearance, however, is mocked by her true passionate desires.

19639.l: A tall, slender brunette massages her naked body with lotion.
19639.d:
Long, brown hair flows down past the shoulders of this young girl's body, 
extending down to the small of her back.  With the body of a goddess and the 
face of an angel, this beautiful maiden can steal the heart of any man she 
pleases.  Her steel blue eyes pierce into your soul with a surreal intimacy 
about them.

19640.l: A large, peaceful monk stands watch at the gate.
19640.d:
Hiding behind the faade of a peaceful monk wearing a long brown robe, this
natural-born killer is not one to be quarreled with.  While his intentions
remain peaceful, his masterful training in judo and jiu-jitsu provide him with
the skills necessary to kill any mortal with one swing of his fist.

19641.l: A well-groomed friar rests here, awaiting your next transaction.
19641.d:
Dressed in a long, flowing brown robe and holding a donations bowl, this bald 
friar seems friendly and ready to assist you with all of your financial needs.

19642.l: A dainty sylph flaunts around aimlessly approaching all within the club.
19642.d:
This call girl was brought here to entertain the men of the club. Although
she is not the swiftest with a tray or drinks from the bar, she does strike
up a good conversation. As noticeable by the appearance of her siblings,
Phuong and her family were not blessed with the most beautiful of looks.

19650.l: A pair of glowing eyes watch you intently.
19650.d:
You see nothing but two red cat-like eyes floating in space. They follow your
every move, but always remain between you and the stairs leading up to the
next level.

spw.name: The Ground floor of a Tall Tower

19651.l: A heavily-armored knight challenges you as you attempt to pass by.
19651.d:
Dressed in a highly polished suit of armor, the knight has a sworn duty to
prevent guests from travelling any further into the upper levels of the
tower. If you are not invited above, you can proceed no further.

19665.l: Standing perfectly still, you almost miss the ninja guarding the gate.
19665.d:
His lack of movement provides the best camoflauge possible..you wouldn't
even know he was there apart from the fact that you almost run into him.

19675.l: Sidious, the leader of the Titans stands before you.
19675.d:
This white bearded man is quite old which you can tell by looking at his
scared face. He has white eyes which gives him the appearance of a vicious
man, but he is very gentle unless provoked.

19676.l: Brakus, the holy Titan watches you carefully as you approach.
19676.d:
Brakus is a heavy-set man, following and obeying the wishes of his master
Sidious. Together, it is their duty to protect the entrance to the castle
beyond.

19677.l: A giant ape stands before you, returning your gaze.
19677.d:
He's an 8 foot ape with the strength of 10 men but the intelligence of a mere
worm. You could consider him the clan's mascot or pet and is as friendly
as can be, provided you don't turn your back on him...

19688.l: Annias, one of the mythical guardian genies, blocks your path.
19688.d:
Annias doesn't have to move much to prevent you passing - he's as wide as the
tunnel itself but it knows which members to allow entry and which to stop.

19689.l: Azash, one of the mythical guardian genies, blocks your path.
19689.d:
Azash doesn't have to move much to prevent you passing - he's as wide as the
tunnel itself but it knows which members to allow entry and which to stop.

19690.l: A Dark Demon is here, guarding the door against intruders.
19690.d:
Several feet taller than you and quite a bit stronger, the dark demon has
been summoned to this world to fulfill one role...prevent entry to those not
of his master's clan.

19691.l: A Red Baron, summoned from Hell, eyes you warily.
19691.d:
One of the demi-gods of Hell, the Red Baron is a huge, winged demon that
serves his role until death.

19696.l: The legendary Xu Zhu stands guard, monitoring all who pass by.
19696.d:
A giant man with Herulean strength. He is usually very quiet and calm, but
once he starts fighting , nothing can stop him. This trait has earned him
the nickname, Tiger Butcher.

19697.l: A brave young officer nods as you approach.
19697.d:
A brave officer who gallantly speeds into battle carrying his long spear.
No one can rival his bravery, especially when he rides out alone into the
midst of the enemy.

19698.l: An battle-hardened warrior slowly sharpens his sword.
19698.d:
This valliant warrior is an incredible fighter. It is said he could make
enemy troops cower with just a loud shout; his nickname, Everyone's Enemy.

19700.l: A small rat is here munching on something.
19700.d: This small rat is about as disgusting as a rat can get.

19701.l: A large rat glares at you with its beady little eyes.
19701.d: What sewer did this thing crawl up from?

19702.l: A huge rat lumbers in your direction.
19702.d: Good God!  This damn things been on steroids!

19703.l: The small bat squeaks and flitters about.
19703.d: How cute, a mouse with wings!

19704.l: A bat is here trying to tangle itself in your hair.
19704.d: How cute, a fox with wings!

19705.l: An enormous bat somehow manages to stay aloft.
19705.d: How cute, a hippo with wings!

19706.l: A full suit of armor stands here, shining as if it were brand new.
19706.d: Bonanza time!  This armor looks better than any you have ever seen!

19707.l: You see a large chest filled to the bursting with gold and jewels.
19707.d: Your eyes are bedazzled by the riches displayed here.

19708.l:
On a small pedestal sits an old book with arcane symbols written in gold
leaf upon the binding.
19708.d: The book is quite old, and you wonder what wisdom is contained therein.

19709.l: Hanging from the wall is a portrait of a beautiful woman.
19709.d: The painting looks familiar, though you can't quite remember who painted it.

19710.l: A rack of swords stands against one wall.
19710.d:
The finest works of destructive technology are so beautiful, you almost
forget that their main purpose in life is to hack at people and mutilate
their bodies, possibly even kill them by puncturing vital organs or slicing
through many layers of flesh and releasing large amounts of blood thereby
dramatically dropping the blood pressure to the point where all activity ceases.

19711.l: The head of a deceased red dragon is mounted and displayed here.
19711.d:
You'd hate to have had to face that thing when it was still connected to the
rest of its body!

19712.l:
Old King Seilon glares at you.  You have invaded his space and trespassed where
you should not have.  He looks kind of pissed.
19712.d:
King Seilon is an OLD man, you wonder how he's managed to live this long!  Even
though he's so old, however, he looks tougher than shoe leather.

19713.d: This warrior is also looking for the lost treasures of King Seilon.

drp.name: a slip of paper with some words on it

19714.l: A pasty old mage is here looking very hungry.
19714.d:
It appears that this poor old man has been trapped down here for a LONG time.
He has probably survived so long by eating rats!

drp.name: a slip of paper with some words on it

19715.l: An undead guard stands at attention at his post.
19715.d:
This guard was once a living member of King Seilon's court, but the spell cast
over him years ago by King Seilon to hold his loyalty was even more powerful
than death itself!

drp.name: a slip of paper with "30-19-45" written upon it

19716.l: A corpse dressed in chamberlain's garb is rotting away here.
19716.d:
Once King Seilon's most trusted advisor, the chamberlain was kept animated even
after death by some very strong magic indeed!

19900.l: A rough-skinned troll stalks around angrily.
19900.d: Covered in mottled green flesh, it smells your blood and begins to drool.

19901.l: The king of all trolls stands here amid piles of humanoid bones.
19901.d:
Almost a head taller than other trolls, he bears an unmistakable air of
authority.. and animality.

19902.l: A minor rock wight floats about ethereally.
19902.d: A long dead soul, it searches the depths of this cave.. its place of death.

20000.l: An invisible stalker is here, thinking that you can't see him.
20000.d:
The nasty creature looks like something conjured up from another          
dimension.  His deformed, demonic body is covered in ugly scales and
wrapped in a dark cloak.  He moves silently and skillfully.

spw.name: The world spins for a moment, then the feeling passes.
You feel yourself yanked by a powerful magic force!

20001.l: A wicked little demon imp is here, playing in the shadows.
20001.d:
This wicked little creature ugly and foul smelling.  He has a glimmer
of intelligence in his gleaming red eyes but the hatred in those eyes
is very apparent also.  He moves rapidly in and out of the shadows like
a piece of the night.

20002.s: the knight of the forgotten clan
20002.l: Tall and handsome, a statue of a knight stands here.
20002.d:
His armour is battered and well-worn, he grips a longsword in one hand and
wears the insignia of a long forgotten clan upon his shield. The knight is
strikingly handsome, and seems to look at you with almost life-like eyes.

spw.name: The Eastern Side of the Statue Gardens

20003.l: Wrapped in a white robe, a statue of a powerful sorcerer stands here.
20003.d:
The ripples in his robe are just too perfect, whoever sculpted this one
must have been a true master.  Upon the sorcerer's face is an odd mixture
of disappointment and pity, he looks very pious.  It looks like this statue
has been here for quite a while now.

spw.name: Northern End of the Statue Gardens

20004.l: With a look of rage on her face, a statue of an assassin stands here.
20004.d:
The statue is of a very famous assassin of old who vanished during a mission
long ago.  Legends say she was the most talented killer money could buy, and
she had reputedly knifed many powerful people when she disappeared.
