spw.name: The Center of the Statue Gardens

20005.k: holy man old priest cleric statue
20005.l: A statue of a holy old man stands here, his eyes raised to heaven.
20005.d:
The holy old man seems to be some kind of a high ranking cleric.  The holy
symbols on his robes are the marks of a long dead god, clearly this statue
has been standing here for ages.  The old man's eyes are a mixture of
expectation and disappointment.

spw.name: The Southern Edge of the Statue Garden

20006.l: A deformed servant of the Dark Mage is here, busily cleaning the tower.
20006.d:
You wonder why anyone would want to serve the Dark Mage... This man is
certainly very strange looking.  He is grossly misshapen and is not
remarkably intelligent.  The bruises on his face and body are evidence
his overseer beats him often.  You feel very sorry for the freaky servant.

20007.l: A demonic overseer is here, cracking a whip and barking orders.
20007.d:
The overseer is not of this world, he is a demon summoned and enslaved by
the Dark Mage to supervise the servants and inflict punishments on them
when they are out of line.  He seems to enjoy his job very much and, judging
by how he skillfully wields his whip you estimate he is a very worthy
opponent.

20008.l: The Demon k'Chz is here, slipping in and out of the darkness.
20008.d:
The Demon Lord is covered in hard, black scales.  His head is very
lizardlike and clear, undisguised hatred burns in his red eyes.  Long,
sharp claws grow from his fingers, thick, pointed spikes run down his
back and twin, razor-sharp fangs shine in his mouth.  I think you are
about to die.

20009.l: An improved Yellow Dopsodod looks at you in disbelief and rage.
20009.d:
The Dopsodods were an accidental byproduct of dark magic gone awry.  The
creator of the Dopsodods, a good-natured wizard who regretted bringing such
evil creatures into the world, used his considerable powers to trap them in
a subterranean cave.  When the Dark Mage heard of these creatures, she
summoned them from their prison and began to experiment on them.  Before you
is the result: a leaner, meaner Dopsodod.

20010.l: An improved Bastard Dopsodod looks at you in disbelief and anger.
20010.d:
The Dopsodods are creations of pure dark magic.  Ages ago the dark mage
created them to overrun the world and enslave everyone.  He may have
succeeded, too, were it not for the angered gods who intervened and
destroyed most of the mage's minions.  However he has been hard at
work over the ages and this dop is surely much leaner and meaner than
his ancestors.

spw.name: Southern End of the Great Library

20011.l: An improved Father Dopsodod looks at you in disbelief and fury.
20011.d:
The Dopsodods were an accidental byproduct of dark magic gone awry.  The
creator of the Dopsodods, a good-natured wizard who regretted bringing such
evil creatures into the world, used his considerable powers to trap them in
a subterranean cave.  When the Dark Mage heard of these creatures, she
summoned them from their prison and began to experiment on them.  Before you
is the result: a leaner, meaner Dopsodod.

spw.name: Northern End of the Great Library

20012.l: A mighty guardian spirit stands here guarding the way into the labyrinth.
20012.d:
The creature before you is a nearly invisible wraith wrapped in a black,
tattered cloak and holding a wicked looking black longsword.  He moves
in and out of the shadows without a sound; as he sees you approach he
lets out an evil scream of anger and sadness and rushes you.

20013.l: An evil banshee is here, floating in the darkness and wailing ruefully.
20013.d:
This creature is a nightmare.  Hideously ugly with a terrible voice and
a mean temper.  The banshee is not happy to see you, she lets out an
unearthly wail and attacks.
20013.noise: You hear a steady wailing that echos all around you.

20014.l: A stately black raven sits on a branch here, his eyes full of hatred.
20014.d:
As you look closely at the raven, you notice a small strip of red silk tied
to his foot.  He is sitting on a branch here, just above your head, and
staring at you intently; his gaze seems very detached.  You have heard
stories about powerful magicians using pets to spy on people, perhaps this
is the case with this bird?

spw.name: The Eastern Side of the Statue Gardens
Northern End of the Statue Gardens
The Center of the Statue Gardens

20015.l: A black crow is in a tree here, watching your every move.
20015.d:
You look up at the crow sitting in a treebranch overhead and notice a bit
of colorful silk tied around his foot.  He seems very interested in what you
are doing... maybe he will be reporting back to the Dark Mage soon...

spw.name: The Eastern Side of the Statue Gardens
The Southern Edge of the Statue Garden
The Center of the Statue Gardens

20016.l: A fearsome creature of water and mist rises up from the pool.
20016.d:
The creature seems to be the merger of a magically created elemental and a
powerful evil spirit.  It glows brightly and causes the water in the pool
to churn and roll.  Torrents of misty air encircle the creature and a mouth
of cruel fangs hisses at you from a snake-like head.  I think you'd have
been better off not disturbing the pool.

spw.name: The Center of the Reflecting Pool

20017.l: A big, thick tentacle slips up from the water and grabs your ankle.
20017.d:
The tentacle is about as thick as a tree in the pine forest... it is slimy
and stings your leg as it touches you.  Little suckers, with small, razor
sharp teeth line one side of the massive arm and on the other a set of
large spikes protrude every which way.
20017.noise: You hear the sound of something moving through water.

spw.name: The Center of the Reflecting Pool
The Western Side of the Reflecting Pool
The Southern Side of the Reflecting Pool
The Northern Side of the Reflecting Pool

20018.l: Graak the Torture Master is here, cleaning his strangely shaped knife.
20018.d:
Graak is a very strange human. He would almost be handsome if it were not
for a strange growth on his face.  He is tall and moves gracefully... he
also seems to be talking to himself.

20019.l: A heavily armoured trollish guard is here, patrolling the dungeon.
20019.d:
The troll is fat and ugly, his green face has an oversized nose and two
beady little yellow eyes.  Although he isn't very intelligent, he is big
and incredibly strong.

drp.name: a breastplate made of blackened crystal

20020.l: An off-duty trollish guard is here, I think you disturbed his sleep!
20020.d:
The troll is fat and ugly, his green face has an oversized nose and two
beady little yellow eyes.  Although he isn't very intelligent, he is big 
incredibly strong.

20021.l: Fat and ugly, a trollish cook is here, stirring a pot of gruel.
20021.d:
This female troll must weigh at least 800 lbs.  Her face is covered with
warts and her arms are the size of tree trunks.  You are told the guards
find her very attractive.

20022.l: Near death, a weak, insane prisoner lays here on the floor.
20022.d:
This guy is in sad shape... he is very hungry and seems somewhat insane,
he mumbles to himself and drools on the floor.  When he sees you he screams
out in alarm then mumbles curses and insults your family line.

20023.l: An imprisoned mage is here, searching for a weak point in the wall.
20023.d:
The mage laughs at you as you walk through the door... "There is no way
back out, you stupid oaf!"  He is dressed in greyish robes but looks haggard
and weary.  he has, most likely, spent much of his considerable power
trying to escape from the bondage of the Dark Mage.

20024.l: A wicked, fat, old warden is here, thinking of ways to punish the prisoners.
20024.d:
The warden is a huge, fat old troll who seems lost in thought and does not
see you.  He looks as if he would tear you in half if he did...

20025.l: The Apprentice Mage stands here, wrapped in a dark cowl.
20025.d:
The Apprentice Mage's life has been dedicated to the service of his master,
the Dark Mage.  He is clad in a fine, black robe of silk, he looks timeless
and confident in his powers.  As he sees you, he smiles and begins to chant...
20025.noise: An eerie chanting fills the room...

20026.l: The Dark Mage stops his work, points a hand at you, and begins to chant.
20026.d:
The Dark Mage is very tall and looks quite young, though you have heard many stories 
about him and the deeds he supposedly did hundreds of years ago.  You realize he has mastered
the secrets of youth and wonder what other deadly magic he commands.  I think you are about
to find out...
20026.noise: An eerie chanting fills the room...

20027.l: Strabo, the grandfather of all Dragons, has been trapped here by the Mage.
20027.d:
Strabo is an ancient dragon.  His entire serpent-like body is covered with
sharp, hard black scales and along his back wicked black spikes protrude
from his spine.  His tail moves slowly back and forth and his bright eyes
focus on you as you watch him.  Strabo opens his huge maw to reveal rows of
long, sharp teeth.  His forked tongue flicks out as he sniffs the air,
dripping a large spool of saliva from his mouth.

20028.l: An ugly Thrall is here, grunting at you in revulsion.
20028.d:
The Thrall looks much like an Orc; he has a pig-like nose and cloven feet.
But he is much larger than a normal orc and is covered by some strange kind
of scales, almost like a fish.  Tufts of fur protrude from the scaled skin
and grow thick on his back, head and chest.  His eyes are bloodshot and
yellow in color.  He has two, large, sharp teeth and massive claws on his
fingers.

This particular Thrall, like most, you assume, smells revolting.

20029.l: A Thrall Priest is here, grunting a prayer to the Thrall gods.
20029.d:
The Thrall looks much like an Orc; he has a pig-like nose and cloven feet.
But he is much larger than a normal orc and is covered by some strange kind
of scales, almost like a fish.  Tufts of fur protrude from the scaled skin
and grow thick on his back, head and chest.  His eyes are bloodshot and
yellow in color.  He has two, large, sharp teeth and massive claws on his
fingers.

This particular Thrall, like most, you assume, smells revolting.

20030.l: A Thrall Guru is here contemplating matters of magic, existence and life.
20030.d:
The Thrall looks much like an Orc; he has a pig-like nose and cloven feet.
But he is much larger than a normal orc and is covered by some strange kind
of scales, almost like a fish.  Tufts of fur protrude from the scaled skin
and grow thick on his back, head and chest.  His eyes are bloodshot and
yellow in color.  He has two, large, sharp teeth and massive claws on his
fingers.

This particular Thrall, like most, you assume, smells revolting.

20031.l: A Thrall Woman is here, running a bone through her tangled hair.
20031.d:
The Trall is a heavy, orc-like creature.  She has patches of long, amber
hair on her head that looks (and smells) like it has never been washed.
Her bloodshot yellow eyes are large but stupid.  Two razor sharp teeth
protrude from her large mouth and sit just below her pig-like snout.

She smells and looks revolting.

20032.l: A grotesquely carved stong gargoyle sits here staring off the balcony.
20032.d:
The gargoyle's features are grotesque; its face is cat-like and powerful
claws protrude from its oversized forearms.  Two small, scaled wings
sprout from its lizard-like back and the creature's long tail is wrapped
up in a long coil.  The eyes of this statue are made of flickering gem-
stones and the teeth that line its hideous mouth... look like they have
blood on them!

20033.l: The Black King stands here, commanding his forces.
20033.d:
A black, gnarled old man with an insane look in his eyes, he's gone crazy
with powerlust and wants nothing more than to destroy all his enemies, one of
which is you.

20034.l: The Black Queen stands here, the real power behind her side.
20034.d:
A tall, beautiful yet powerful looking woman, she is the true power behind
the Black Army and has The Black King wrapped around her finger.

20035.l: A Black Bishop stands here, summoning evil powers to aid the Black Army.
20035.d:
One of the most powerful clerics in his world, the Black Bishop is a strong
force for the Black Army.

20036.l: A Black Knight stands here, calling for his steed.
20036.d:
The Black Knight stares at you with his bloodshot eyes and a growl begins to
sound from the back of his throat before he walks towards you, cracking his
knuckles.

20037.l: A Black Rook stands here, in a huge suit of armor.
20037.d:
What stands before you seems nothing more than a huge, black suit of armor,
but you can tell from the ominous sounds of breathing inside that there is
some type of life-form in it.

20038.l: A Black Pawn stands here, looking for a fight.
20038.d:
The sons of The Black King, the Black Pawns have had the best trainers
in their world teaching them how to fight, and now they have only one wish
to become the new Black King when their father dies.

20039.l: The White King stands here, commanding his forces.
20039.d:
Dressed in all white armor, the White King stands as the power behind his
White Army. In the world where he comes from, he is one of the purest souls
alive, and now he's defending himself from the attacks of the Black Army.

20040.l: The White Queen stands here, thinking out strategies.
20040.d:
The White Queen is, obviously, the White King's faithful, and intelligent
wife, she is also a major strategist for the White Army, and a very beautiful
woman.

20041.l: A White Bishop is standing here, healing his comrades.
20041.d:
One of the White Army's only clerics, the White Bishop is an essential member
of the Army.

20042.l: The White Knight is standing here, calling for his steed.
20042.d:
A paladin of the purest kind, the White Knight is one of the few great warriors
of his world that serve the forces of good.

20043.l: The White Rook stands here, pondering his next movement.
20043.d:
A giant earth elemental that seems to be made of white marble, the White Rook
is an awesome sight to behold.

20044.l: A White Pawn is standing here, ever vigilant.
20044.d:
Trained by the best warriors their father, the White King, could find, the
White Pawns are a group of swordsmen ever ready to fight for the cause of good.

20301.k: bakhna rakhna goblin albino humanoid creature
20301.l: A small, white, goblin-like creature skulks around here.
20301.d:
He looks like a goblin, except he is pale white in color and his ratty hair is
a light shade of yellow. He has a flat face and sloping forehead, with a broad
nose and pointed ears, his wide mouth is filled with sharp fangs. He is short,
but lanky and his long arms hang to his knees.

20302.l: One of the strange, reptilian olab stands here.
20302.d:
Olab are essentially reptilian but with feathery crests and neck wattles,
though their faces are almost human. Their forelegs are like the arms and
hands of men, but their hindlegs are incredibly long and storklike. Balanced
on these legs, it's body towers over you.

20303.l: A giant mist creature is here, waiting for it's next victim.
20303.d:
It's white, like mist, yet somehow darker. It stretches high above your head.
It is nearly eight feet tall and almost as broad. Two eyes, the color of thin,
yellow wine, are set high in the creature's body, though it has no separate
head. A mouthing, obscene slit, filled with fangs lie just beneath the eyes.
It has no nose or ears that you can see. Four appendages spring from it's
upper parts and it's lower body slithers along the ground, unsupported by any
limbs.

20304.s: a hunting dog of the Dharzi
20304.l: A hunting dog of the Dharzi is sniffing a tree here.
20304.d:
It first appears to be a dog, but this is no dog, it is half dog and half
bird, with a lean, shaggy body and legs but also possessing birdlike
talons in place of paws and savagely curved beaks which snap where muzzles
should be.  These strange creatures have been domesticated by the Dharzi
orcs, the only thing that the dogs won't attack. Unfortunately, you don't
appear to be a Dharzi orc.

20501.l: An orc scout hides in some brush here.
20501.d:
He is a pig headed humanoid that looks about as intelligent as one of your
boots.  Blood stained tusks jut out around his vile pink snout.

20502.l: A pig-headed orc stands here, peering through the trees.
20502.d:
His hairy face is painted with crude war paint, and he looks like he's been
trained for battle all his life.

20503.l: A tall, well-muscled orc stands here.
20503.d:
His garb shows him to be of a commander's rank; you suppose this mean he has
an intellegence greater than his orcish comrades, yet much less than your
average humanoid.  He does appear strong however, and there is the look
of blood lust and death in his eyes.

20701.l: A strange-looking bird flies around you here.
20701.d:
It looks like a bird, but instead of a head, it's face seems to grow out of
the front of its body, and instead of a beak, it has a mouth full of sharp,
razor-like teeth. Its body is covered in an entire spectrum of different
colored feathers.

20702.l: A scaled and winged darkwing dives towards you.
20702.d:
It has a scaly green body and leathery black wings. Its claws are long and
sharp, and its mouth is filled with vicious, sharp teeth.

20703.l: A short, green-skinned imp circles you in anticipation.
20703.d:
It stands about two feet tall and seems to have numerous twigs and leaves
tangled in its wild, wood-brown hair. Its little face is almost perfectly
round and bears a gaping slit of a mouth filled with needle-like teeth.

20704.d:
The origins of this creature are unknown, but it is assumed that it is the
result of some mad wizards experiments. It is a nightmarish creature, the size
of a large bull, with the head of a giant snake, the feet of a tortoise, thick
green fur, and a horses tail.

2100.l: A short, nimble looking orc snarls at you before charging.
2100.d:
The orc before you is a vhati, a junior member in the great Dharzi army
whose job it is to scout ahead and locate prey for the remainder of the
hoarde. It's blood-stained tusks jut out from it's wart-covered snout and
it grins evilly at you, glad to have achieved its mission.

2101.l: A hefty orc worker spots you and lumbers towards you with an evil grin.
2101.d:
Not the brightest race of creatures, the worker before you lacks even the
simple intelligence his brethren are endowed with. He does, however, make up
for his shortcomings with sheer strength and judging by the blood dripping
from his mouth, he enjoys a hearty meal.

2102.l: A hefty orc worker spots you and lumbers towards you with an evil grin.
2102.d:
Not the brightest race of creatures, the worker before you lacks even the
simple intelligence her brethren are endowed with. She does, however, make up
for her shortcomings with sheer strength and judging by the blood dripping
from her mouth, she enjoys a hearty meal.

2103.l: An orc raider runs at you screaming.
2103.d:
Very ugly and aggressive, the sole purpose of the creature in front of you is
to go forth and pillage. What he cannot take with him, he destroys or eats!
Upon seeing you, he screams loudly and runs at you.

2104.l: A tall, dominant orc lets out a blood-curdling scream before attacking you.
2104.d:
What little she is wearing indicates the orc before you is a Kolo-Vhati, a
commander of the Dharzi legion. The blood lust and sheer rage in her eyes
are reason enough not to remain here. She barks an order to any of her minions
before coming at you.
2104.noise: You hear a blood-curdling scream followed by a loud chorus of cheers.

drp.name: a pair of tanned leather boots

2105.k: orc leader dharzi kil thar kilthar leader
2105.l: Kil'thar, leader of the Dharzi orcs stands before you.
2105.d:
Renowned for his utter contempt for life, Kil'that is a giant amongst his
clan. The mere mention of his name brings fear upon many within the forest
of Noirwood and few have managed to meet him and survive.

2106.l: An orc guard is angered by your intrusion.
2106.d:
Normally a large race, the Lamra-Vhati before you is huge in comparison. It
has been raised as a sentry and easily fits within the doorway blocking all
access. It snarls at you, bearing razor sharp teeth before stepping towards
you.

2107.l: A short-haired creature senses your presense and continues to dig.
2107.d:
The creature before you is in fact a mole, albeit five times the size of its
cousins. It posesses a the natural ability to dig without the aid of light
and has probably aided the orcs in the construction of this place.

2108.l: An orc witch stares at you coldly, mumbling an incantation.
2108.d:
Although not intelligent as other species, the orc witch before you has
certainly mastered the art of spell casting.

2109.l: One of the orc workers sleeps nearby.
2109.d:
Fatigued with having to continually repair their home, the orc worker sleeps
the majority of the time but occassionally staggers around if awakened.

2110.l: One of the Dharzi hunting dogs growls at your presense.
2110.d:
It first appears to be a dog, but this is no dog...it is half dog and half
bird with a lean, shaggy body and legs but also possessing birdlike talons in
place of paws and savagely curved beaks which snap where muzzles should be.
These strange creatures have been domesticated by the Dharzi orcs, the only
things the dogs won't attack. Unfortunately, you don't appear to be a Dharzi
orc.
2110.noise: You can hear a low growl nearby.

2111.l: A huge warrior grunts in displeasure and bears his tusks.
2111.d:
The orc before you is a Lomba-Dharzi, a small clan of warriors that spend
the vast majority of their life training for battle. Usually found in raiding
parties, the one before you is still a formidable opponent by himself.

21200.l: A cityguard stands here, patrolling the streets and looking for trouble.
21200.d:
The cityguard is a large, neatly dressed man. His hair is shaved and he
wears the navy and grey uniform of a sergeant. He looks brave and trustworthy.

21201.l: A cityguard is here, searching the town for wrongdoers.
21201.d:
The cityguard is a strong, tall woman in the grey and blue uniform of a
sergeant. She has short, dark hair. She looks brave and trustworthy.

21202.s: Kharzed, the Captain of the Guard
21202.l: The Captain of the Guard is here, patrolling the streets.
21202.d:
Kharzed is a huge man, he stands over seven feet tall. His hair is a bit longer
than his troops' and he wears a neatly trimmed beard. His uniform has the navy
and gold of a Captain. He looks a bit older than his troops but he is still
very young to be an officer. He must have a bright future indeed.

21203.l: A gate guard stands here, vigilantly watching the gate.
21203.d:
The gate guard is a large, neatly dressed man. His hair is shaved and he wears
the navy and grey uniform of a sergeant. He looks brave and trustworthy.

21204.l: Zaebos the alchemist stands here, carefully mixing some sort of potion.
21204.d:
The alchemist is an older man with a greyish white beard and a bald head. He
wears a dirty white robe that has a few stains and burn marks on it. He seems
to be in good shape, though.

21205.l: The owner of this bookstore stands here, looking over a new arrival.
21205.d:
The bookstore owner is a younger man with a love for books. He wears thick
glasses on his face and his clothes are neat and dapper.

drp.name: the Isle of the Necromancer Kings

items_sold.name: the Isle of the Necromancer Kings

21206.l: Abernathanorial, the retired mage is here, writing his spellbook and thinking of the old days.
21206.d:
The retired mage is very old and can barely see anymore.  People say he is
one of the Old Age Masters and has opened a shop in town so that he can relax
and write the definative spellbook in his spare time.  He wears a long purple
cloak and a funny looking hat.

21207.l: Al the bartender stands here, whistling a tune while he cleans glasses.
21207.d:
Al is a happy young man who inherited this establishment from his father.
He always has something nice to say to his patrons and keeps the bar very
clean and neat.  Although he is not very big, he looks like he has come
through some rough situations and can hold his own in a brawl.

21208.l: Zeb the baker is here, wiping flour off her hands while the bread bakes.
21208.d:
Zeb is a fat, young woman with rose red cheeks and a happy laugh. She wears
a puffy white hat and a big smile. She also keeps a long sword in the corner
of the room and looks like she knows how to use it.

21209.l: Amantis the librarian is here, reading a book at her desk.
21209.d:
You look upon a beautiful young woman.  Educated at some university far
away, she took this job so she could spend time continuing her studies.
Her bright, intelligent eyes regard you with a welcome and her lovely
smile fills you with a warmth of self-assurance.

21210.l: Hashkar the blacksmith is here, hammering a glowing hot bit of iron.
21210.d:
Hashkar is a huge, strong man with a deep and powerful voice.  His large
hands are very tough and his arms bear scars where he has accidentally burned
himself in the past.  He is tall and barrel chested -- someone you would be
wise not to mess with.

21211.l: Mirissa the waitress is here, walking around smiling at customers.
21211.d:
Mirissa is an old woman with grey hair and a thick order pad. She has been
working here most of her life and still does not own the tavern. She is a
very good-looking woman now; when she was in her prime she must have had to
fight off all the over-friendly customers. Now she has worn out eyes and
looks very tired of her job.

21212.l: The receptionist gazes at you like you were the center of the universe.
21212.d:
The receptionist looks lean and mean.  Her long, painted fingernails remind
you of claws and the arcane gleam in her eye reminds you of a powerful mage.
She is rumored to be the keeper of the rentfiles and defender of the inn's
vault.  Surely she is a powerful and dangerous woman to offend.

21213.l: Wonkots, the walkin' cane man, is here, looking over his merchandise.
21213.d:
Wonkots is a big old walkin' cane man! He was raised far away and his poor
father apprenticed him to a walking cane maker.  Eventually his mentor died
and Wonkots took to adventuring.  When he found he was not cut out to be an
outdoorsman, he set up shop in Alaozar and now trades canes, staves and
wands.  Although he is not too hearty looking, surely he has mastered some
kind of magic needed to craft these fine wands.

21214.l: Tiberius the mage guildmaster is here, looking over an old spellbook.
21214.d:
Tiberius is a true master of magic. His powerful mind, like a vault, contains
all the secrets of the ancient magicians. Lost secrets are known to this old
mage who, ever the patient teacher, passed his knowledge along to the next
generations.

21215.l: Jrevis, the cleric guildmaster is here, communing with the gods.
21215.d:
Jrevis is a pious, holy man with a long white robe and a look of inner
peace broadcasted on his face. Although surely he is as powerful as the
High Priests and Archbishops who tend the temples around the land, his
calling was to teach the holy ways to others and, ever obedient, he
patiently instructs at this guild.

21216.l: Gorad Drummerhaven the warrior guildmaster is here, honing his weapon skills.
21216.d:
A veteran of many wars, you suspect that despite his age the guildmaster
could easily slay a powerful dragon or massacre legions of enemy troops..
He is large-framed and his arms look almost as thick as a normal man's legs!
He moves with a grace and confidence not many other fighters possess.

21217.l: Shadow the thief guildmaster is here, hiding in the shadows.
21217.d:
Shadow is a slender, handsome woman with fine features and a mysterious glimmer
in her eyes. You notice how smoothly and silently she moves about and are
amazed at her skills. Once a master robber, she now has retired and teaches her
ways to the next generations.

21218.l: Rackhir the cobbler stands here, hammering the soles into a new pair of boots.
21218.d:
Rackhir set up shop here soon after the first cobbler died during the Dark 
One's attack upon Alaozar, since then he has made a good living and made many
friends among the population of the Holy City.

21219.l: A huge guardian naga is here, wrapped around the automatic teller machine.
21219.d:
Surrounded with a flowery sweet scent, the guardian naga is marked by
green-gold scales, silvery spines, and flashing golden eyes. It was summoned
by the High Priest to guard the bank from would-be theives.

21220.l: The tailor is standing here, waiting for the next customer.
21220.d:
He's an average looking man, in fact you wouldn't notice him if he walked by
you in a crowd.

drp.name: a high collared shirt of black silk
a cloak of rustling green velvet
a checkered jerkin of blue and white linen

21221.l: The High Priest of Alaozar is here, preparing his next sermon.
21221.d:
He's been around for a long, long time, and rumor has it that he was the one
that summoned the allies needed to destroy the Dark One's forces during the
Great War, since then he's been here, waiting for something that even he does
not understand.

21222.l: Ab the grocer stands at the counter, with a slightly impatient look on his face.
21222.d:
Ab moves two 200 pound bags of flour around on his huge shoulders. He looks at
you while checking off his inventory list as if to ask "What do you want?"

21223.l: Galt is standing here, eager to sell you his newest, finest weapons.
21223.d: He's a young weaponsmith, who still has lots to learn.

drp.name: a silver chain with razor-sharp links

21224.l: Beldam the armorer stands here, displaying his shiny new armors.
21224.d:
An old but very strong armorer.  He has made more armors in his life than you
have ever seen.

21225.l: The head Postmaster is standing here, waiting to help you with your mail.
21225.d:
The Postmaster seems like a happy old man, though a bit sluggish.  He worries
about the reputation of the Mail Service, as many people seem to think that
it's slow.  Perhaps if he were to brush the cobwebs from his uniform it'd help
to make a better impression.

21226.l: The bartender watches you calmly, while he skillfully mixes a drink.
21226.d: He's just a tired-looking bartender who hates trouble in his bar.

21227.l: A Peacekeeper is hovering around here, keeping the ruffians in line.
21227.d: Just seeing the large, silver sphere triples your sense of security.

21228.l: A watchman is here, watching for signs of trouble.
21228.d:
You see a strong young man who is ready to leap into action at the smallest
sign of trouble.

21229.l: A janitor is walking around, cleaning up.

21230.l: A stray dog is here mucking through the garbage looking for food.
21230.d:
The dog is small and has a foul smell and pieces of rotted meat hanging
around his ugly teeth.

21231.l: A tall, tiger-like creature stands here, studying the crowd.
21231.d: One of the many rakshasa that seem to finally be integrating into society.

21232.l: A messenger is running along here, delivering a message.
21232.d: He's a young man with a good honest job, his mother would be proud.

21233.l: An over-worked lackey passes by here, doing things for his master.
21233.d:
This young man has a hard job but makes the best of it and works real hard
and gets paid very well.

21234.l: A small loyal kitten is here.
21234.d: The kitten looks like a cute, little, fierce fighter.

21235.l: A small loyal puppy is here.
21235.d: The puppy looks like a cute, little, fierce fighter.

21236.l: A small, quick, loyal beagle is here.
21236.d: The beagle looks like a fierce fighter.

21237.l: A large, loyal rottweiler is here.
21237.d: The rottweiler looks like a strong, fierce fighter.

21238.l: A large, trained wolf is here.
21238.d: The wolf looks like a strong, fearless fighter.

21239.l: A grubby little kid is here, playing in the dirty street.
21239.d:
The kid is very dirty and his parents are nowhere to be found. He has a little
stick in his hand and is pretending it is a sword. He goes running around the
streets whapping horses and buildings all the while mumbling magic words, he
is quite annoying.

21240.l: A hill giant is here, minding his shop.
21240.d:
This hill giant is very tall and large. He stands well over ten feet tall and
must weigh over six-hundred stones. He wears the tattered robes of a mage,
although you suspect he did not progress too far in his studies for he does
not seem to be very intelligent...

21241.l: A large man is here, checking out the town.
21241.d: He's just come in and is looking for a place to have a good time.

21242.l: A sneaky thief is here, hiding in the shadows and skulking around.
21242.d: The thief is sneaky and cunning... he enjoys his work.

21243.l: An Alaozarian nobleman walks by here, looking at you in disgust.
21243.d:
He was born with a silver spoon in his mouth and was raised hating
your kind.

21244.l: A well-dressed tattoo artist stands here.
21244.d:
His fine clothes and demeanor seem stark contrast to his tattooed body. An
aura of magic radiates from many of his tattoos.

21245.l: A lovely store attendant stands here, feeding a small kitten.
21245.d:
She's rather pretty, even in her common garb. Long brown hair is streaked
with blonde, seeming to glitter in the meager light.

21246.l: The shadowmage is here, practicing forbidden arts.
21246.d:
He is a tall, somewhat young man. His face appears distorted as if some
magical spell was hiding his true appearance from you.

21300.l: A pike flashes by, trying to find a way out of this dirty water.
21300.d:
You can barely make out it's midnight blue body under the surface of what
must be the worst filth in all of the lands, what a saddening sight.

21301.l: A bass swims by, clearly sickened by all the filth in this water.
21301.d:
All you can see is the vauge silvery body under the slime and sludge, maybe
you should put it out of it's misery.

21302.l: A big old oscar looks at you wondering how you would taste.
21302.d:
This is a huge tiger oscar which was probibly someone's pet once, now it
roams the sewers looking for food.

21303.l: Papa gator is here, munching on some kind of carcass and looking at you.
21303.d:
Papa gator is not your ordinary gator. He looks like to product of some
experiment gone wrong. Not only is he bigger than you, but he looks pissed.

21304.l: Mama gator is here guarding her eggs.
21304.d:
She's not just a mama, she's a BIG mama. She looks about 8 feet long and
looks very disturbed by your presence, perhaps you should leave... NOW.

21305.l: A baby gator is here learning how to swim and hunt.
21305.d:
Isn't it adorable? It's a feisty little gator, though, and it snaps at you
when you get too close.

21306.l: A sewer rat scampers in, sees you, and hisses.
21306.d:
It's a scruffy little black fleabag... Better stay away, who knows what
diseases it carries.

21307.l: A mole is here, burrowing away at the concrete.
21307.d:
It's a short black rodent. It has little red eyes that almost seem to glow
in the dark. It stares at you for a moment, and then goes back to what it was
doing.

21308.l: A giant leech is here looking from some fresh blood to suck on!
21308.d: It's fat, black, and hungry. Apparently this is one happy leech.

21309.l: You think you see some sort of serpent under the water here.
21309.d:
It is a long, slender snake. There's not much significant about it except
it's enormous fangs and lightning speed in water.

21310.l: A turtle is here, slowly making it's way across the tunnel.
21310.d:
It's large and green-black, with a shell as solid as stone. It looks
peaceful, in it's own way.

21311.l: A puddle of purple ooze slithers across your path, dissolving everything.
21311.d:
It's body is always changing, a lump of purple gel with no constant shape
and no remorse.

21312.l: A huge, green toad is here, foaming at the mouth.
21312.d: My god! It's rabid!! Mad Toad!! Mad Toad!!

21313.l: A large green reptile is here, looking for some lettuce.
21313.d:
It's green, it's happy, and it's got what looks like a small leather
harness on it's back...

21314.l: A tiny little cricket is here, making beautiful music.
21314.d:
Awwww, look at the cute little cricket? If they weren't so damn annoying
they might replace teddy bears.

21315.l: A small pile of gooey flesh is here, sliming everything.
21315.d:
EWWWW! This nasty creature is leaking something all over the place! Don't
touch it.

21316.l: The biggest grouper you've ever seen is here, swimming at your feet!
21316.d: Wow, is it big! It has to be at least 50 pounds! If only you could catch it...
21316.noise: You hear something splashing around playfully near you.

21317.l: A scruffly blackbird is perched here, surveying the tunnel.
21317.d:
It's black feathers look dirty and rough, not like the birds outside that're
all pretty and clean looking. It's glare looks hollow and cold as it sees
food in your eyes.

21400.l: A dark shadow passes beneath the surface.
21400.d:
You can't quite get a good look at it, but it has very mammalian features
and appears to have extremely sharp teeth. Should it get close enough to you,
you'll find out exactly how sharp...

21401.l: A large fin sticks out of the water with a large shadow underneath.
21401.d:
This great beast of the ocean is around twenty feet in length with a
mouthful of mean looking dagger-like teeth.  It's belly is the color
of snow and it seems to be looking at you with a fierce hunger in its
eyes.

21402.l: A massive serpentine creature swims here, leaving destruction in its wake.
21402.d:
The Leviathan's skin is like a double coat of chainmail, with overlapping
scales as large as shields on its back, and as sharp and hard as jagged steel
on its under-parts. It breathes smoke from its nostrils and flames from its
mouth which is rimmed with teeth. Its fins radiate a brilliant light and its
eyes are like the glimmerings of dawn.
21402.noise: The sea begins to boil underneath you with an intense heat.

drp.name: a scale of the sea dragon

2500.l: A priest walks by, mumbling blessings only he would understand.
2500.d:
At one time, this priest would have been a devoted follower of the one true
faith. He has chosen to ignore the teachings from the mainland, and as such,
has been banished to this place. The priest is covered in a number of sores,
and he coughs repeatedly, obviously very sick.

2501.l: A crazed-looking man screams with glee before running towards you.
2501.d:
Having spent many years imprisoned on this island, any semblance of humanity
has left this poor individual, and it now knows nothing but its own survival.
Apparently, you look good enough to eat...
2501.noise: You hear a wild scream nearby.

2502.l: A small armadillo-type creature scuttles along.
2502.d:
The grannit is about the size of a coconut, with a hard shell and sharp teeth.
It is a viscious little creature, and enjoys the taste of flesh... it is the
only indigenous life form to this island.

2503.l: An imposing man passes by without even a glance.
2503.d:
Trelian is something of a leader on the island, having been here almost from
the beginning. He believes that since you too are on this island, you are
nothing more than a prisoner here, so he disregards you completely.

2504.l: An island prisoner scrounges around madly for food.
2504.d:
For committing a crime against the church, this individual has been sent to
the island as punishment - almost certainly a life sentence. He spends most of
his day looking for food. Rusted shackles hang from his wrists and ankles, and
the crazed look in his eye is enough to convince you this guy is truly insane.

2505.l: A strange humanoid creature grins as it rushes towards you.
2505.d:
With a roughly humanoid body, and the head and legs of some twisted bird, the
awkmute is a mutation most likely produced in the depths of a mage's
laboratory. Scavenging mainly insects and fruits, the awkmute has no problem
eating meat, if its hunger grows strong enough.

2506.l: A shady looking man returns your gaze.
2506.d:
Firos was once a thief but unfortunately for him, he was caught by a church
guard and sentenced to spend his remaining years here. He rejects all
teachings of the church and has chosen to live away from the main island
complex. He rallies as many supporters as he can for his own cause.

2507.d:
It's rather exquisite with its red, blue, green and yellow feathers. It makes
a shrill call as it flies overhead.

2508.l: A man in tattered robes sits here meditating.
2508.d:
This man has rejected society, and chosen the isolation of the island to pursue
his basic magickal ability. The islanders know him as the shaman, and seek him
out in time of sickness.

2509.l: A strange, snake-like creature with sharp teeth strikes at you.
2509.d:
This creature has but one purpose, and that is to kill. Although it resembles
a snake, the razorjaw is incapable of movement and, therefore, waits silently
for prey to come within range before striking.

2510.l: A mean-looking troll stalks around angrily.
2510.d:
This poor creature probably wandered too close to the city of Kir Drax'in and
ended up here, preventing his return. With little intelligence, and an 
increasing hunger, you look like a tempting target.
2510.noise: Something is making a terrible noise close by.

2511.l: A jungle cat attempts to conceal itself in the foliage.
2511.d:
You're not really sure what type of cat this creature is... It's more of a
cross between a few different species. It was introduced onto the island as a
deterrent against escape.

2512.l: A half-starved lunatic runs at you screaming.
2512.d:
Ejected from the relative safety of "civilization" on the island, Cyrano lives
off whatever he can find. Despite his ribs showing quite clearly, do not
underestimate his strength or determination.

2513.l: A flesh-eating serpent coils around your legs.
2513.d:
Grossly distorted, and having an extremely unkind temperament, the elverine has
a distinct taste for flesh. Your odor has driven it into a frenzy!

2514.l: A two-headed lizard man eyes you as his next meal.
2514.d:
Because it has two heads, this mutated creature is able to think twice as
fast, and almost predicts your attacks. He also strikes twice as often, making
him difficult to beat... especially if you don't want to be his next meal.

2515.l: A gaunt looking prisoner sits here, acting as a lookout.
2515.d:
Weak and insane from a lack of food, Kazan was placed up here to keep him
occupied. While no one travels to this island anymore, he maintains a lookout
for the ship that will never arrive. He looks at you and licks his lips...

spw.name: The Top of the Bell Tower

2516.l: A cleverly-disguised serpent slithers towards you.
2516.d:
The tropical serpent is well suited to the intense heat, humidity and foliage
in this jungle terrain. It's natural camoflauge make it difficult to hit and
given it's silent approach, you're lucky to see it before it strikes!

2517.l: An overly-large bear with blood driping from its fangs charges at you.
2517.d:
This creature is certainly not natural, and to have arrived on this island
is no accident. It was placed here, and it certainly looks more than capable
of taking care of itself.

2518.l: A strange wooden creature encircles your body with its hand.
2518.d:
This thing is huge! Your match only half of its height although the kalamite
is almost as thin as a small sapling. It doesn't see too well, relying on
smell and movement to find its prey.

2519.l: A large rat, soaked in blood and hungry, spots you.
2519.d:
Having just feasted on some unfortunate soul, the rat is still rather hungry.
Even from here, it looks very diseased, and you'd hate to have it bite you!

2520.l: A savage barbarian, enraged at being locked in here, attacks you.
2520.d:
Confined for the protection of the other prisoners on the island, the
barbarian possesses a vast amount of strength, and the prison cell is the
only thing equal to the task of containing him. You are nothing but an object 
upon which to vent his anger...

2521.l: A large, mean-looking ogre lumbers towards you.
2521.d:
With little to no intelligence, the ogre is a danger to the remainder of the
island population, and has been confined to the prison. It knows nothing but
hatred, and you have just stepped into his line of sight.

2522.l: A decomposed corpse shakily gets to its feet and strikes.
2522.d:
It's dead, yet it just stood up, and now it's coming at you. There was a good
reason that the corpse was locked in here, and you've just found it.

2523.l: A starved-looking prisoner attempts to guard the gate.
2523.d:
Thin and weak from lack of food, the prisoner has the task of protecting the
compound occupants from whatever lies outside... anything from wild animals
to rival prisoners.

2716.l: Mandor is here, observing everything around him.
2716.d:
Mandor is Merlin's half-brother and visits him in Amber frequently. He has
sharp blue eyes and hard, angular features beneath a mass of pure white hair.
He is dressed all in black, except for a bit of white collar and sleeves 
showing beneath his glossy, tight-fitting jacket.

2717.l: An accountant is here working on the books.
2717.d: An elderly monk who seems absorbed by his work.

2718.l: A castle servant is hard at work here.
2718.d: She looks like she'll do anything to serve you.

spw.name: The Northwest Corner Of The Great Hall

2719.l: A castle servant is hard at work here.
2719.d: This guy might be only a servant but he's a real hunk.

2720.l: Some sort of mechanism is spinning in the air here.
2720.d:
It's difficult for you to understand what you see. It looks like
a ghostly wheel spinning in mid-air.

2721.l: Luke Rinaldo is here, looking for his bud Merlin.
2721.d: The newly crowned king of Kashfa, Rinaldo is a son of Brand.

drp.name: a dark black cloak with a silvery rose clasp

2722.l: Flora is hurrying by on some business.
2722.d: Flora is a striking young woman with clear blue eyes and fiery red hair.

2723.l: A young, blind girl sits here... sculpturing!
2723.d:
She is the young and beautiful Vialle, the Queen of Amber and--an
even greater accomplishment--the woman who convinced Random to
settle down.

2724.d:
The King of Amber is a wiry fellow with a twinkle in his eyes and
mischievious grin on his face.

2725.l: A haunting ghost is floating here!
2725.d:
The ghost of Eric, former king of Amber, with hair and beard so black
that it's almost blue. You can tell that he has a real cruel streak
running through him.

2726.l: Bleys is pacing around here, looking a little drunk.
2726.d:
Bleys, the son of Oberon and Clarissa, has bright red hair and a
sunny disposition.

2727.l: A dashing figure of a ghost is here.
2727.d:
Caine, swarthy and dark-eyed, looks at you jealously from the other
side of death.

2728.l: Llewella is here, looking for Random.
2728.d: Princess Llewella has jade-colored eyes and hair.

2729.l: Martin appears surprised that you're here.
2729.d: The son of Random looks to be in his twenties and sports a mohawk.

2730.l: A fleeting, transparent image of a young woman is here.
2730.d:
She appears to be a young woman with dark hair, blue eyes, and a
determined and courageous expression on her face. She doesn't seem
to be a ghost but rather someone who is trying to appear here but
just can't quite make it.

2731.l: Corwin is standing here, deep in thought.
2731.d: Corwin has black hair and green eyes. He looks like a powerful fighter.

drp.name: a small black and silver key

2732.l: Fiona is here, looking for someone...
2732.d:
Lovely Fiona has fiery red hair, green eyes and a white complexion. Although
she is short at five feet, two inches, she has a very forceful presence and
carries herself with great charm.

2733.l: A horrifying ghost flows in the air here.
2733.d:
Mad Brand, prince and betrayer of Amber, screams at you as you
disturb the privacy of his quarters.

2734.l: Merlin is here, looking for his father Corwin.
2734.d:
Merlin is a young man with dark hair and green eyes. His is a unique
heritage, being the son of a prince of Amber and Lady Dara of Chaos.
Just now he seems to be muttering something about (or maybe TO)
someone called Frakir.

2735.l: A strong, serious guard stands here.
2735.d:
A member of the Elite King's Guards. He's serious, he's powerful, he's 
dedicated, and he's not happy to see you here.

2736.l: A castleguard is here, guarding the castle.
2736.d: A young, dedicated guard of the castle. He looks you over.

2737.l: Benedict is here, tending his garden.
2737.d: Benedict is tall and thin. He looks very fast and powerful.

2738.l: A huge, fierce horse snorts and rears at you!
2738.d:
The biggest horse you've ever seen. He's jet black with fiery red
eyes. It looks like hellfire in his mouth and there's smoke rising
from his hooves!

2739.d: This horse looks strong and healthy.

2740.l: A humble monk tends the grove.

2741.l: A growling hellhound charges at you!
2741.d: A huge, black hound with fiery eyes and long, long teeth.

2742.d:
Julian is one of the princes of Amber and he has taken Arden as
his own. There is neither passion nor compassion in his eyes.

2743.l: An old, old manticore is here.
2743.d: This old fellow looks like he's been around a while.

spw.name: A Precarious Path Along The Precipice of Mount Kolvir

2744.l: A stealthy hunter is here, hunting everything that moves.
2744.d: A crafty looking guy with an evil gleam in his eye.

2745.l: A beautiful, young pegasus is here.
2745.d: It looks like a young colt with wings. It is brilliantly white.

2746.l: A small griffin is nibbling on something here.
2746.d:
It has the head and wings of an eagle on the body of a lion. This one
looks quite young.

2747.l: An amber cityguard is here, looking for troublemakers like you.
2747.d:
This is a very big fellow. Even though he's smiling, you feel that
he takes his job very seriously.

2748.s: Cecil the High Sheriff of Amber
2748.l: The High Sheriff of Amber wonders what you want.
2748.d:
This fat cat local politico looks like he knows his way around. He's
probably as good in a scrap in a back alley as he is at getting himself
elected.

2749.l: A citizen of Amber is strolling along here.
2749.d:
This guy looks like an average enough fellow. He's bopping along,
apparently having a wonderful time.

2750.l: A citizen of Amber is strolling along here.
2750.d: She's quite lovely. She seems to be looking for something.

2751.l: A child of Amber is playing here.
2751.d:
There's nothing like the joyous sound of children's laughter, is
there?

2752.l: A gentleman of Amber is relaxing here.
2752.d:
This fellow looks pretty affluent and important. He might be worth
rolling.

2753.l: An expensive callgirl is here looking very appealing.
2753.d: She looks expensive and worth every cent.

2754.l: A beautiful showgirl is dancing here.
2754.d:
This absolutely gorgeous young lady is almost naked. She's a good
dancer, too.

2755.l: The Hotel Manager is here doing paperwork.
2755.d:
The Hotel Manager sorts through her paperwork in a cool,
professional manner. She looks up at you with a question forming
on her lips...

2756.s: a waiter at the Grand Hotel
2756.l: A waiter is here to take your order.
2756.d:
This waiter will do his best to fulfill your every need; and he
accepts tips.

2757.l: A bellhop is here, ready to take your luggage.
2757.d:
The bellhop looks capable of grabbing your bags and doing the 100
in four flat.

2758.l: The Chef looks like he doesn't like visitors in his kitchen.
2758.d: The Chef looks very capable in a kitchen or a prize-fighting ring.

2759.l: Droppa, the court jester, is here and is drunk as usual.
2759.d: Droppa looks like some kind of clown or something.

2760.l: Benjamin, the new owner, is ready to take your order.
2760.d:
Ben is a somber, tall man who looks exactly like someone
you don't want to mess with.

drp.name: a plate of delicious blackened snapper

items_sold.name: a plate of delicious blackened snapper

2761.l: A chaos demon is here, looking for a sacrifice.
2761.d: The chaos demon is big and ugly. It has huge tusks.

2762.l: Dalt is here, going through the Captain's pockets.
2762.d:
Dalt, bastard son of Oberon and Deela, hates Amber and everyone in it.
He is tall and muscular, and looks like he would make a formidable foe.

2763.l: Gerard is here and seems to be in a bad mood.
2763.d:
Gerard is a big and powerful man with a fringe beard and a light
moustache. He is a Prince of Amber and his strength is legendary.

drp.name: a blue and gray dressing gown

2764.l: A sailor with the Royal Fleet of Amber is here.
2764.d:
The sailor is a nimble-looking fellow that looks like he has been
in a scrap or two.

2765.d: He looks like a prisoner of war or something.

2766.l: There is a man here leering at you.
2766.d: This scum looks as though he belongs here. Sleazy.

2767.l: The desk clerk of the hotel greets you with a friendly smile.
2767.d: She has dark-brown, curly hair and a cheerful disposition.

2768.l: Megan the armorer is here, selling her wares.
2768.d:
Megan is an athletic woman with beautiful brown hair and a
winning smile.

2769.l: Stven the weaponer is here, selling his wares.
2769.d:
Stven is a brown-eyed redhead, a giant of a man with a very
expressive face.

2770.l: Killis is here, ready to buy and sell junk.
2770.d:
Killis looks like a typical blacksmith with a long ponytail and a 
cheerful twinkle in his eyes. There's a pair of drum sticks sticking
out of his pocket. He looks like he could ROCK THE HOUSE!!!

2771.l: A spark rises from the Pattern.

2772.l: A cloud of sparks rises from the Pattern.

2773.l: A flurry of sparks rises from the Pattern.

2774.l: A storm of sparks rises from the Pattern.

3005.l: The receptionist stands here in boredom.
3005.d: She's the innkeeper's wife... She looks rather worn out.

3010.l: The postman is here, shuffling through his mail.
3010.d: He's liable to go postal on you at any moment.

spw.name: The Board Room Of The Immortals

3022.l: A black-clothed assassin sits and watches your every move.
3022.d:
She's nearly invisible in the near darkness, but you make out a very 
feminine form beneath the tight clothes she wears.

3063.l: A mercenary sits around, waiting to be hired.
3063.d:
He's dressed in ragged leather armor and carries a well-honed sword.  
He sees you eyeing him and says, 'Give me 100 coins and I'll be
loyal to the end.'

3094.d:
It has dark brown fur and four huge paws that house razor sharp claws. It's
muzzle growls open to reveal pointed canines that could rip you to shreds.

30000.s: a long legged nordic beauty with big hooters
30000.l: A long legged nordic beauty with big hooters is standing here.
30000.d: Wow!  Blonde, beautiful, busty, and dumb as a brick.

30101.l: A huge condor stares at you, protecting her young.
30101.d: You see a huge bird's red eyes staring at you.

30102.l: A small blue bird chirps, as it passes by.
30102.d: You watch a small bird fly in circles, until it gracefully lands.

30103.l: You see a giant baby condor staring at you hungrily.

30104.l: A tiny pixie hides here behind a rock.
30104.d: You see a pixie stare at you, with a tiny dagger drawn.

30105.l: An impressive pixie guard stands before you.
30105.d: A well armed and armored pixie guard stands before you.

30107.l: You see a swaying old pine tree.
30107.d: As you stare you see the tree begin to uproot itself.
30107.noise: You hear the creaking of old tree limbs.

30108.l: A flower with blue and green petals snaps its teeth at you.
30108.d: A bizzare looking flower with blue and green petals stands here.

30109.l: A flower with red and yellow petals snaps its teeth at you.
30109.d: A bizzare looking flower with red and yellow petals stands here.

30110.l: A purple flower stares at you with a single eye and licks its teeth.
30110.d: A very bizzare flower stands here staring at you.

30111.l: An algea covered bird soars toward you.
30111.d: You can see parts of his bird has become gangrenous.
30111.noise: You hear an unearthly bird screech.

30112.l: A bee flies around your head.
30112.d: You listen to the bees' gentle buzz.
30112.noise: You hear the buzzing of bees.

30113.l: A drone bee hovers near your face.
30113.d: This bee is getting awfully close.
30113.noise: You hear the buzzing of bees.

30114.l: The queen bee hovers near the beehive.
30114.d: You see the queen stareing back at you.
30114.noise: You hear the buzzing of bees.

30115.l: A huge catepillar is here eating the mushrooms.
30115.d: You watch the catepillar is amazement.

30116.l: A phantom cloaked in darkness floats passed carrying a scythe.
30116.d: You stare into its hood and see a faceless empty void.

30117.l: A pixie prince is here drinking from a small glass.

30118.l: A beautiful pixie princess dances here.
30118.d: A pixie in flowing silken gown dances not noticing you.

30119.l: An armored pixie guardian stands before his prince.
30119.d: This looks like a vicious pixie.

30301.l: A blob of plastic rests upon the plastic couch.
30301.d:
It sits there on the couch and cheeps at you, staring intently with plastic
antennae that remind you of snails and crabs.
30301.noise: A massive farting sound comes from nearby.

30303.l: You can't see the hidden mob in the room.
30303.d: It's hiding, you cant see it.
30303.noise: You bonk your head into the clear glass sphere - DOH! Watch out, man!

3100.l: Sinnach ap Paedrig hurries by on some mysterious errand for the resistance.
3100.d:
Sinnach, like all the bandits, is dressed in utilitarian clothes designed
for guerilla warfare.  He has some of the gaunt, sparse, large frame of his 
father Paedrig, but his eyes twinkle with the merriment of youth.

3101.l: Paedrig Cullain, leader of the resistance, glares at you.
3101.d:
Paedrig Cullain, leader of the resistance and son of the former lord of Ironwood
Forest, is dressed in shades of green and brown which make him all but invisible
in the brush.  Gaunt and tall, with a haunted bitter look in his eye, you wonder
what devastating forces drives this man.

3102.l: Brioch the Lame growls at you menacingly.
3102.d:
Black-bearded and beetle-browed, Brioch is a large and imposing figure despite
his lame leg, which was reportedly hacked off in a battle with Paedrig.

3103.l: A wizard in midnight blue robes grins at you evilly.
3103.d:
Bradoch, brother to Brioch and wizard of the court, is attired in the
traditional garb of wizards. He is reputed to be the true power behind the
Duchy of Glyndwr.

3104.d: Looking at his face, you have no problems deducing how he earned his name.

spw.name: At the Bottom of a Hill

3105.l: An armored figure patrols the area.
3105.d:
One of Brioch's minions, he has a perpetual sneer on his face, and he looks like
he's itching for a fight.

3106.l: Shadow lies along the ground, following your every move.
3106.d: He looks like a ninja, when you perchance to see him...

spw.name: At the Bottom of a Hill

3107.l: Mikel screams his agony to the heavens.
3107.d:
You barely recognize the former lord of Glyndwr, Mikel the Just. But this
formerly handsome man has been twisted by foul magics, his form is bent and
twisted, and his face is disfigured by numerous scars. With horror, you
realize that his body is rotting... he is one of the undead!

3108.l: A lanky figure blends in the surroundings.
3108.d:
As you peer at him more closely, you recognize Brinnach the Tall, Master
Huntsman of the old lord, Mikel the Just.

spw.name: At the Bottom of a Hill

3109.l: A giant vine crosses the path.

3110.l: A madman runs around, frothing at the mouth.
3110.d:
He looks like a dirty old beggar who's been bitten one too many times by
the wargs that run the city streets.

3111.l: One of Mikel's old liegemen is here.
3111.d: Oh, its only Dinas, he's a bit elderly, but in his prime was a feared fighter.

spw.name: At the Bottom of a Hill

3112.l: One of Brioch's Blackguard frowns as you pass by.
3112.d:
Dressed in black armor and wearing a scowl, these are the enforcers of 
Brioch's will.

3113.l: An incredibly beautiful woman dressed in a sky blue robe scowls as you enter.
3113.d:
Breathtakingly beautiful, but with a petulant, even arrogant look on her face,
Meredydd is a sorceress of great power, as many who have underestimated her
because of her beauty have learned.

3114.l: A lithe vine dangles over the path.

spw.name: A Dirt Road through the Forest

3115.l: The innkeeper is here, making his bed.
3115.d:
He looks like he's seen many hard days. The beaten look in his eyes, however,
is overshadowed by the girth of his shoulders.

3116.l: A brown-robed monk chants Latin while banging his forehead with a board.
3116.d: He's a plain man in a brown cowl.

3117.l: Something brushes against your face in the darkness.
3117.d: Tell me what to look at and I'll tell you what it looks like...

3118.l: Kyllikki, the mysterious hermit-like woman looks at you proudly.
3118.d: You can't see much, but the figure is definitely female.

3119.l: A skulking cutthroat jumps you from behind.
3119.d:
He's a greedy, unshaven ruffian with no morals. A lot like yourself,
actually.

3120.l: A serving wench bustles about, seeing to her customers.
3120.d: She's pretty, though a bit young and a bit on the thin side.  Still, she gives you a warm smiles as you meet her eyes.

3121.l: You interrupt a witch in the middle of brewing a potion.
3121.d: An old hag, dressed in soft brown robes, she seems very intent on her work.

3122.l: A towering figure with a gaunt, skull-like face stands here.
3122.d:
Standing almost 7 feet tall, this massive figure looks like an animated
cadaver.

3500.l: A sleek, scaly anthropoid stands here with an offensive bearing.
3500.d:
The creature's face is elongated and fishlike, with thin, protective
layers of skin that cover its elongated eyes. It moves with swift
precision, and carries a vicious air.

3501.l: A sinewy, fishlike creature is sheathed here in biotic armor.
3501.d:
This massive hybrid seems to be more muscular than the average kuo-toa.
Its marked, organic gear seems to signify the warrior class. This is an
obvious veteran, for its body is marred and disfigured from many battles.

3502.l: An abnormal, crablike creature scurries about, minding its duties.
3502.d:
With abnormally extended legs, and a tough, barbed shell, this crablike
creature strikes you as being both mysterious and lethal.

3503.l: A seemingly laggard, yet stout humanoid stands here.
3503.d:
This short, stalky, humanoid resembles a dwarf. Its features are round
and plump, yet its arms are massive and out of proportion with the rest
of its body.

3504.l: Kuo-Mythus, the unrelenting combatant, is protecting his species.
3504.d:
This tall, stealthy humanoid is marked as a warrior by his dull, organic
armor. The makeshift blades that are fastened to the beast's forearms,
and its sharp, capped teeth add to the already sinister presence of the
militant kuo-toa.
3504.noise: You hear a faint groan in the distance.

3505.l: A morbid, large-jawed larva is awaiting its prey.
3505.d:
This creature resemlbes an oversized ant-lion with thick tentacles used
for trapping its victims. The creature seems to be placed here for the
purpouse of consuming the crablike creatures and then depositing their
glowing fluids back into the earth via defecation.

3506.k: kuo toan toa kuo-toa kuo-toan mother
3506.l: A livid, bulbous kuo-toan is guarding its eggs.
3506.d:
This strange female creature is somehow appealing in an odd,
lustful way.  She is naked, revealing her alien, manifold entries,
apparently designed for pleasure.

3507.l: An enormous black man-snake lashes about here.
3507.d:
Until now, you though that yuan-ti existed only in books and the nightmares
of children.  Indeed, Ssyzyil appears to be a living, breathing nightmare,
his thirteen foot black-bloated body raising up before you.  His humanoid
body from his torso up is equally black and bloated and covered in a
mixture of skin and scales.  The abomination's face is dominated by black,
lidless eyes which cannot conceal the rage that burns within him.
Ssyzyil smiles at you, his mouth full of sharp fangs as well as more
human looking teeth.

3568.noise: The column to the south hums faintly.

3569.noise: Steam is vented from a small hole above your head.

3570.noise: A reflection dances on the column to the north.

3572.noise: Waves crash into the fringe to the south.

3573.d: You can see nothing, but can hear sounds of crashing waves.
3573.noise: Violent waves bang into the fringe.

3574.noise: A school of fish flows by the observatory.

4101.l: Zylarthana is here, having a mug with her friends.
4101.d:
With beautiful, long, flowing black hair and dark, gleaming eyes, Zylarthana
is the essence of beauty.

4102.l: Sostratos is here, warming his hands at the fire.
4102.d: He's a cleric with an attitude.

4103.l: Wintermute is practicing with his sword, ready for some action.
4103.d: This daring samurai looks like he's just waiting for an excuse to kill you.

4104.l: Slash is sitting at a table, sharpening his sword.

drp.name: a pair of scale mail gloves
a pair of scale mail leggings
a pair of scale mail sleeves

4105.l: Sky is sitting here, wolfing down a meal.
4105.d: He's big, he's mean, he's a fighting machine.

4106.l: Gertrude the dwarf is here, cooking up your favorite foods.
4106.d: There's something strangely exciting about women with beards.

spw.name: The Kitchen of the Lakeshore Tavern

4107.l: A barmaid wanders around, serving the customers.
4107.d: She's one of the meanest little old ladies you've ever seen.

4201.l: Shartu, Chieftain of the Bhyroga, looks towards you for help.
4201.d:
A stocky man with blonde hair and deep blue eyes, Shartu looks as if he's
seen more of the world than his fellow villagers.  His face holds a pained
look as he thinks of all the tragedies happening now.  His eyes plead
for your help in freeing him from the terrible ice giants.

4202.l: The Shaman of Bhyroga looks at you oddly.
4202.d:
An elderly man, he seems to be stirring something in a cauldron. The stuff
looks so disgusting, you're almost afraid to ask what it is. He stares at you
and you wonder if maybe you should leave.

4203.l: A fisherman from Bhyroga is carrying a basket full of fish.
4203.d:
A scrawny fisherman is moving about on his daily work. You notice that in
addition to carrying a fishing pole and a basket full of fish, he also has a
small saw with a sharp tip. There seems to be something fishy about him.

4204.l: A woman of Bhyroga is wandering around.
4204.d:
A blonde haired blue eyed lady, she wanders about doing her daily tasks.
She seems to have a bag full of all sorts of things, but what they are is 
anyone's guess.

4205.l: A vendor is here, selling fish.
4205.d:
One of the people of Bhyroga has apparently decided that fishing isn't
his lot in life, so here he is, SELLING fish.  The poor guy, you can
almost feel sorry for him - almost.
4205.noise: You hear the harsh voice of a fishmonger hawking his wares.

4206.l: A vendor is here, selling his wares.
4206.d:
One of the fishsellers has apparantly moved up in the world and become a
genuine vendor. Heck, he might actually have something you want!

4207.l: A warrior of the Bhyroga is here, defending his town.
4207.d:
This guy's armed to the teeth!!! He looks as if he is going to single-
handedly take on all the giants by himself. You doubt this is true, but he
does look pumped up and ready for action.

4208.l: A small child is wandering about.
4208.d: Awwwww, such a cute little thing...

4209.l: A dragon as white and clear as ice rises up before you.
4209.d:
This dragon, known as Kaerdein is the ice dragon that has terrorized this
region in times past. He's not old, only heard of within the last 100 years,
and he has been hibernating for the last 30, so little is known about him. The
younger people in Bhyroga think of him as a myth now, but their elders know
he is out here somewhere, and dread his return.

4210.l: A small rabbit scurries through the snow.
4210.d:
This rabbit has completely white fur, brown eyes, and a pink nose. It
looks scared as it sees you, at dashes for cover.

4211.l: A vendor is here, selling fish.
4211.d:
One of the people of Bhyroga has apparantly decided that fishing isn't his
lot in life, so here he is, SELLING fish. The poor guy, you can almost feel
sorry for him.... almost.

4212.l: A vendor is here, selling his wares.
4212.d:
One of the fishsellers has apparantly moved up in the world and become a
genuine vendor. Heck, he might actually have something you want!

4213.l: A menacing ice giant glares at you.
4213.d: He's huge! He's made of ice! He's an ice giant!

4214.l: A huge ice giant towers over you.
4214.d:
This ice giant brings a whole new definition to the word giant. He's 30 feet
tall and looks ready to pound you into a pulp.

4300.l: The Superfreak stands here, licking your groin with glittery hair.
4300.d: His nose is covered in white powder and he intimidates and arouses you with a furious groin pumpin dance in your general direction.
4300.noise: You hear a man exclaim, "I'm Rick James, Bitch!" and smack a ho.

4301.l: Dolkvin staggers about, smacking random soil with a filthy old hoe.
4301.d:
Dolkvin is drunk again, which is no surprise.  His red nose protrudes
from a jolly, wasted face, destroyed by years of drinking fermented onions.
Dolkvin emits a putrescent cloud of filth and stench.
4301.noise: You hear a drunkard farting in the wind.

4302.l: A serf girl toils about, encrusted in dirt.
4302.d:
This poor peasant girl has been set to plowing the earth and
carrying heavy baskets back and forth.  Although young, she is
stonefaced as her bony, muscular frame does her day's work.

4303.l: Haggard the oaf lumbers about, working the fields.
4303.d:
Haggard is a large man with red hair and long mutton chop sideburns.
His legs are freakishly long, causing him to take enormous tragicomic
steps.  Haggard is rather oafish but has a simple charm to him.
4303.noise: You hear the sound of a scythe cutting through wheat nearby.

drp.name: a pair of dirty denim overalls

4304.l: Old Crazy Pete is here, stomping grapes and punching himself in the head.
4304.d:
Old Crazy Pete is hairy, smelly, and disgusting.  His liquorous mouth
lies open, singing a song about easy women as he beats his head in
an unknown rhythm whilst stomping grapes with mad fervor.  A urine
stain runs down his overalls, and a melted ice cream cone rests on
his head.  They just don't come much stranger than Old Crazy Pete.
4304.noise: You hear a madman singing about tavern whores and stomping grapes in the distance.

4305.l: Hagatha the hulking idiot pulls several plows behind her sinewy, bulbous frame.
4305.d:
You feel stupid merely being in the presence of this amazing idiot.
The woman is gigantic, hulking over even you, but her brain is the size
and composition of a moose knuckle.  She looks like a solid worker, though,
dragging along several plows behind her gargantuan back.
She grunts like a wild beast fat on butter, beans, and dainty delights.
4305.noise: A grunting woman is heard nearby.

drp.name: a pair of dirty denim overalls

4306.l: A dirty hog snorts happily, eating up its feed with ecstatic devotion.
4306.d:
A filthy hog sits here in its own slop, feeding on the slim
portions allowed by the parsimonious Cedric.  It snorts in
oblivious contentment, devouring the trough in mindless devotion.
4306.noise: You hear the snorting of a hungry pig nearby.

4307.l: Galoot is here, tending to the livestock with disturbing delight.
4307.d:
Galoot has only one tooth, extending from his face in horrific
backwoods protrusion.  His eyes are nearly blank, hiding only
a feeble mind capable of grasping childhood truths at best.
The way this man's lonely eyes light up at the sight of a healthy
steer rump is sure to give you nightmares.

drp.name: a dirty kilt with a "happy hole" in front
a pair of dirty denim overalls

4308.l: A tiny man is here, quivering in terror.
4308.d:
This man is just a tiny little dwarf, frail and sickly to boot.  He
looks at you with abject terror in his eyes.  For failing his lord in
courage on the field of battle, William has been placed here to serve
as the first line of defense against any who might wish to pay his
lord a rude visit.

spw.name: At the gate of a feudal manor

4309.l: Anna stands here, singing a pretty tune while picking apples.
4309.d:
Anna is a pretty young peasant girl.  She has flowing red hair, pale white skin
and an ass to write home about.  Poor Anna was sold into serfdom by her father,
Dolkvin, before his debts forced he himself to work Cedric's fields.
The young girl appears unfazed, seeming to actually enjoy her unpaid labor.
4309.noise: You hear a girl singing a pretty tune from the orchard.

4310.l: An angry man of Xixieqi stands here, harvesting turnips with outward fury.
4310.d:
Cao Xiezhe was captured in a recent war, as a prisoner of Xixieqi, and
forced into sordid labor on the lands of Cedric the Saxon.  He works here,
obeying orders, but is clearly peeved at his lowly status.  Cao has the
appearance of a man working for today, but plotting for tomorrow.
4310.noise: A man curses Cedric in an unknown eastern tongue.

drp.name: a pair of dirty denim overalls

4311.l: A funky chicken sits in its cage, emitting a terrible stench.
4311.d:
This chicken is incredibly funky, both for its rhythmic head bobbing
and the disgusting funk its filthy feathers breathe into the air.
The chicken catches you staring at it, and you both look away in
an awkward moment.
4311.noise: A chicken clucks a funky tune nearby.

4312.l: Al-Pupalot the flatulent Arab stands here, with brown-stained trousers.
4312.d:
This man, whose true name is Abdul Aziz, was forced into serfdom
upon the defeat of his sultan by the thanes of Cedric.  His face,
which resembled a camel, and his nervous, goofy manner ended up
sparing Abdul's life, as the men redubbed him "Al-Pupalot" due to
his violent digestive problems.  Fed only bran fiber and whiskey,
without the aid of a doctor, Al-Pupalot's condition is certain to
keep him alive as an endless source of humor.
4312.noise: You hear a flatulent Arab cursing his fate in the wind.

4313.s: Bahamut the Platinum Dragon of Heaven
4313.l: A regal dragon of platinum presides here in supreme majesty.
4313.d:
Bahamut is among the noblest creatures of the realm.  His steady, kind mien
bespeaks the wisdom of eons.  Summoned from heaven by the God of War to serve
as his steed, Bahamut is a fierce and loyal companion to mighty Mars.
4313.noise: The ground trembles from the weight of a massive beast nearby.

4314.l: Paddy O'Hooligan is here, drunk and sleeping on the job again.
4314.d:
Paddy's face is fat and bloated, and his nose is inflamed with crimson from
years of imbibing fermented yak juice.  His eyes droop from intoxication, and
his orange sideburns protrude so greatly as to offend your personal dignity.
He's supposed to be guarding the gate, but he couldn't stop a child.
4314.noise: An intoxicated oaf snoars loudly somewhere nearby.

drp.name: a dirty kilt with a "happy hole" in front

4316.l: A big brute of a man is here, beating helpless peasants with an iron switch.
4316.d:
Scar is a hulking brute of a man, named for a scar he received from
mercenary work years ago.  Scar retired from the warrior life to spend
his days as a brutish enforcer on Cedric's estate.  His role is
basically to beat the peasants into submission so pathetic that the
thought of escape or rebellion becomes unspeakable.
4316.noise: Peasants scream for mercy from a savage beating.

4318.l: An angry man walks back and forth, glaring at you.
4318.d:
Aethelred is a testy character, and cracks his knuckles.  He was
demoted from a man of arms in Cedric's service to a commoner
on account of stealing and spreading lies.  He resents his new
status and wouldn't mind taking it out of your hide.

4319.l: Horsefaced Hamish is here, trying to look mad but making you laugh.
4319.d:
Hamish has a long, drooping mouth and tired eyes.  His
freckly, balding head closely resembles a rotten pumpkin.
He wields a chicken with deadly proficiency, ready to teach
you a lesson if you want to get past him.

4320.l: Friar Dominic is here, speaking the word of the Lord.
4320.d:
Dominic's face is aglow with the calm aura of a man at true peace with himself.
His voice is soft and soothing, speaking reasonable truths of the world while
placing the miseries of life into a context of harmony.  The congregation
listens in rapt attention, hypnotized by the transcendent wisdom of this true
holy man.

spw.name: The chapel of Our Lady Saint Torres

drp.name: the brown habit of a sagely teacher

4321.l: A true believer is here, swaying in harmony to the Friar's sermon.
4321.d:
This person is truly committed to the faith, eyes closed and body
swaying to and fro in rhythmic harmony with the diction of the holy
Friar.  It is both disarming and awe-inspiring to see a person so
utterly dedicated to the truth of abstract mythology.

spw.name: The chapel of Our Lady Saint Torres

4322.l: Brother Aedelbert whimpers and struggles to pull a plow.
4322.d:
This bald monk was recently in the service of Lord Cedric, until
he made one too many remarks about the stupidity of violence.  The
lord, taking gentle Aedelbert's remarks as a personal slight, threw
him out of the manor in a drunken rage and consigned him to pay for
his insolence with heavy labor.

4323.l: Clarissa the scullery girl gives you a sexy look.
4323.d:
Although unwashed and with tangled black hair, you can see that
Clarissa is a beauty with dark green eyes.  Unused to strangers,
she is clearly excited at your presence, as she shakes her lovely
rump in your direction with a coy smile.

4324.l: Chef Henri, chief saucerer, stirs a boiling vat with a screaming heretic.
4324.d:
Henri, a proud Creole, is exalted at his seemingly modest title as 
Chief Saucerer.  He thinks himself a virtuoso, lauded by crowds of
admiring patrons.  Henri sings his own praises with a silly dance,
shaking back and forth with the high notes of the song.  The reality is
 that he is a dirty man in a damp cellar stirring a bowl of sauce with a 
writhing prisoner.  Henri has a long handlebar moustache and greasy 
hands.
4324.noise: You hear a jaunty melody being sung nearby.

drp.name: a totally fantastic pair of pea green slacks

4325.l: Seamus stands here in a bloody apron, lopping off chicken heads.
4325.d:
Seamus is a kindly looking man, but rather frail.  He wears an apron and
works at a table, gutting chickens, cutting off their heads, and cleaning
up the waste while keeping the area neat and orderly.

4326.s: Old Sam Baker the candlestick maker
4326.l: Old Sam Baker the candlestick maker rests on a stool, making a candle.
4326.d:
Despite his surname, Old Sam was never destined to be a baker
of pastries.  From watching the flickering candles at night as
a youth, Sam became enchanted with the magic of flame and light.
He's spent all his years since in this very chandlery, serving
as Chandler for Cedric and those before him, ever content.

4327.l: Freyja is here, dipped in hot boiling sauce for her sins.
4327.d:
She has a hurt but vengeful look to her features, beaten
and scarred as she is.  This woman has endured many savage
tortures and beatings for her heresy of disbelief.  She
continues to refuse to acknowledge the One God, and will
live a horrible life until she chooses otherwise.
Her muscles and sinews ripple with quaking fury.
4327.noise: A woman screams in pain from her skin burning off.

drp.name: the tattered rags of a Holy Martyr
the Holy Lance of the Savior

4328.l: A slack jawed peasant walks about doing odd jobs on the farm.
4328.d:
This man is the product of incest or one plus one doesn't equal
two. He grins at you as wide as the great sky, without a glimmer
of thought behind his vacant eyes.  This man has not received
