the education of even a toddler, and speaks to himself in
bizarre barnyard limericks, giggling crazily.

drp.name: a pair of dirty denim overalls

4329.l: A monkey boy stands here, helping the butcher in various menial tasks.
4329.d:
The monkey boy is short and slender, wiry and starving with a
servile demeanor.  He is well muscled, from years of hard tasks,
but is content in his current role as a monkey boy to be whipped
and slapped about for common laughter.  He bears many marks
from past whippings for trivial offenses.

4331.l: A drunken ogre butcher is here, swinging a crazy cleaver.
4331.d:
Elmer clearly has a problem with the booze.  He reeks of corn mash
liquor, and can barely stand on his own two feet.  He curses loudly
and swings a crazy cleaver, endangering everyone. Elmer's left
arm is lopped off at the elbow, and he has a meat cleaver sticking
out of his head, permanently imbedded, along with many other wounds
from years of crazy drunken butchering. He sees you staring at
him, raises a bottle of Grandpa's Old Cough Medicine to his lips,
and cuts the head off a massive pig with a singular chop.
4331.noise: You hear loud cursing, and the gurgling screams of dying cattle.

drp.name: a shot of wheat grass juice

4332.l: A giant woman is here, slicing up herbs with a mighty axe.
4332.d:
This old heifer is intimidating, with a bulging brow ridge and
thighs the size of oxen.  She wears a smelly, smeared sort of
barnyard lipstick and sings an old sea chanty while slicing
up some silly sassafras seed.  The earth quakes as she bounces
up and down with great glee.
4332.noise: The earth quakes with the joyful singing and dancing of a rare female Bohweemoth.

drp.name: a bottle of fine red Merlot

4333.l: Deacon Jones is passed out in a sticky pool of spilt liquor.
4333.d:
Deacon Edward Jones is a well respected clergyman from a
neighboring community.  Clearly, that respect is undeserved
as the churchman has stolen away to the cellar to drink up
all of his host's wine.  His face and head are unshaven,
and an enormous belly sways up and down with his heaving
breaths.  His clothes are absolutely drenched in liquor.
4333.noise: A snoring buffoon fills the air with stupidity.

4334.s: a granite statue of a lion
4334.l: A granite statue of a lion flanks the gate in a rearing pose.
4334.d:
This lion is the symbol of Rotherwood, derived from the myth
of the founder of the house taming a wild lion with his bare
hands to spare a suffering village.  Although stuck in place,
there seems to be a certain magic working on the statue
which allows for rudimentary sentience and movement.

4335.l: Fat Hammy sits here, devouring pig grease and boiled hogs' feet.
4335.d:
Fat Hammy is just quite a disgrace, indeed!  He works as Cedric's Chief
Larderer, in charge of the safekeeping of the many goods stored in the
larder.  In utter contradiction of his profession, Fat Hammy apparently
indulges himself regularly on the foodstuffs stored here.  He reeks of
pig fat and befouled apple juice.  Hammy is of the race of giants,
and has all their characteristic size and stupidity.
4335.noise: You hear an obese giant slurping up gallons of pig fat.

4336.l: A young girl cavorts about to please the deacon.
4336.d:
This poor teenage girl was forced by the hand of Deacon Jones
to this damp and dark place to amuse him while he would drink
and be entertained.  She is dressed in tattered rags, and her
cheeks are purple with bruises.  She performs a pathetic dance,
unaware that the deacon is long since befuddled by drink.

drp.name: the tattered rags of a Holy Martyr

4337.l: A peasant boy scurries about, helping in food preparation.
4337.d:
He's in a frantic state, eager to please his overlord and
earn a name for himself as a grade A slave.  The peasant
boy runs back and forth, carrying several heavy sacks of
grains, spices, and meat between the food preparation
rooms and to the kitchen.  He's strained and just about
to break, but this boy can't be faulted for laziness.

4338.l: The head cook stands here, ordering people about with a cold sneer.
4338.d:
This man is completely full of himself.  He speaks with perfect
diction and flies around the kitchen, whacking his underlings on
the head for always getting in his way.  Although bold, Pierre
can certainly cook a great meal, and won't tolerate anyone
getting in the way of his perfection.

4339.l: Stammerin' Suzy is here, blurting out nonsense and harvesting mushrooms.
4339.d:
Stammerin' Suzy is a fine looker of a woman, to be sure, but
suffers from a nervous tic which causes her to blather out
nonsense in a fractured, frightened manner.  The people of
Rotherwood mostly leave her alone, afraid that she might be
possessed by a demon.
4339.noise: You hear a woman speaking nonsense to herself and laughing.

drp.name: a pair of dirty denim overalls

4340.l: Beautiful Francisca collects garlic cloves in a basket.
4340.d:
Francisca has gorgeous green eyes, and a pleasing olive complexion
from so much time in the sun.  Her figure is well tight and well
proportioned, her lips full and juicy.  She carries a short sword
to fend off the countless lecherous fiends who would have their
way with this peasant woman.

4341.l: Lascivious Larry sneaks around, looking for someone to goose.
4341.d:
There's something wrong with this man.  His face and body are
broken and bruised from beatings for his past misconduct.  The
man's mouth is stuck in a perpetually frightening grin, barely
hiding the disgusting thoughts in his mind.  Larry reeks poorly
of horse flop and eastern moose grease, but is done for the
day and roaming the fields looking to indulge his sick appetites.

drp.name: a dirty kilt with a "happy hole" in front

4342.l: A drugged up chef is here, frantically running between dishes.
4342.d:
This man has clearly been given some northern devil ginseng powder,
and labors with ecstatic fervor.  This is a pot stirring, sack
lifting, haughty dynamo of cooking excellence and awful manners.
In his race to distinguish himself in the head chef's eyes, the man
elbows and knocks over kitchen hands and even the other chefs
as he whirls about the kitchen.
4342.noise: You hear yelling, and the clanging of pots and pans from the kitchen.

4500.l: A giant rat stares at you with beady red eyes.
4500.d:
The rat is covered in dirty grey fur, infested with lice. It's about 2 
feet long not counting its foot-long tail.

spw.name: A Dead End In The Labyrinth

4501.l: A corner of the wall here is covered in a heap of green mold.
4501.d: It looks like a patch of green carpet.. that moves and wants to eat you.

spw.name: A Dead End in the Labyrinth
A Dead End in the Labyrinth

4502.l: A gigantic minotaur stands before you, snorting angrily.
4502.d:
The minotaur looks like a muscled warrior with the head of a bull. Horns the 
size of your dagger sprout from its head, and its breath steams in the cold
air of the labyrinth.

spw.name: A Furnished Room In The Labyrinth

4503.l: A huge black bat claws at your eyes.
4503.d: It looks like a ferocious black rat with wings.

spw.name: A Wet Corridor in the Labyrinth

4504.l: A skeletal figure rags rises from its grave and points at you wordlessly.
4504.d:
The figure looks like an animated skeleton.. An undead with too much will to 
stay in the grave!

spw.name: A Large Room in the Labyrinth

4505.l: A giant rat drips saliva from its mouth as it peers at you.
4505.d:
The rat is covered in dirty grey fur, infested with lice. It's about 2 feet
long not counting its foot-long tail.

spw.name: A Dead End in the Labyrinth

4506.l: A rock harpy screeches at you as it lunges for your throat.
4506.d:
The rock harpy is a close kin to the normal harpy, but its vestigal wings have
left it earthbound and ashamed.. So it hides here below the ground, waiting for 
whatever food comes its way.

4600.l: Spandaramet glides through the swamp in search of lost souls.
4600.d:
A fallen godess of the eath as well as the underworld. Ancient texts
refer to her as the patroness of the dead. In some cultures, her name
is a synonym for "Hell".

spw.name: Lost In The Swamp of Sadness

4601.d:
Half man and half snake, the nagas are thought to bring both fertility and
disaster.

spw.name: Lost In The Swamp of Sadness

4602.d:
Half man and half snake, the nagas are thought to bring both fertility and
disaster.

spw.name: Lost In The Swamp of Sadness

4603.d:
Daevas are demons who cause plagues and diseases and who fight every form of
religion.

spw.name: Lost In The Swamp of Sadness

4604.d:
Daevas are demons who cause plagues and diseases and who fight every form of
religion.

spw.name: Lost In The Swamp of Sadness

4605.l: A strange entity made of water rises up from the muck!
4605.d:
Gandarewa is the good-devouring water weird that your mother warned
you about.

spw.name: Lost In The Swamp of Sadness

4606.d: Cao Guo-jiu is one of the Ba Xian.. an immortal saint and sage.

spw.name: Lost In The Swamp of Sadness

4607.d: He-Xian-gu is one of the Ba Xian.. an immortal saint and sage.

spw.name: Lost In The Swamp of Sadness

4608.d: Lan Cai-he is one of the Ba Xian.. an immortal saint and sage.

spw.name: Lost In The Swamp of Sadness

4609.d: Zhong-Li-Quan is one of the Ba Xian.. an immortal saint and sage.

spw.name: Lost In The Swamp of Sadness

4610.d: Aatxe is half man, half bull, all mean.

spw.name: Lost In The Swamp of Sadness

4611.d: The Xindhi are elves or elfish creatures in there descent, though long removed.

spw.name: Lost In The Swamp of Sadness

4612.d: The Xindhi are elves or elfish creatures in there descent, though long removed.

spw.name: Lost In The Swamp of Sadness
Lost In The Swamp of Sadness

4614.l: A vicious Chimera rears its heads towards you.
4614.d:
The chimera is an animal with the head of a lion, the body of a she-goat, and
the tail of a dragon.
4614.noise: You hear a ferocious snarling nearby.

spw.name: Lost In The Swamp of Sadness

4615.d:
Bolla is a snake-like creature that sleeps for an entire year, only to wake up
and devour whatever it looks upon. Fortunately this one seems blind.
4615.noise: Something slithers through the swamp water.

spw.name: Lost In The Swamp of Sadness

4616.l: Kulshedra scowers the swamp in search of its next meal.
4616.d: Kulshedra is a dragonesque creature with nine tongues and big, pointy fangs.

4617.noise: The wind seems to get stronger here.

spw.name: Lost In The Swamp of Sadness

4701.l: A snow-white mountain cat rests here, staring coldly at you.
4701.d:
This mountain cat stands as high as your waist and boasts a snowy white
pelt.  Faint rings and stripes mar its otherwise flawless coat.

4702.l: An enormous, carnivorous mountain gorilla stands here, watching you.
4702.d:
This snow-white gorilla (often confused with the fabled abominable snowman)
stands near seven feet in height and is covered with fur.  The intense cold
around you is not enough to suppress the stench of rotting meat that comes
from its unkempt, ungroomed body.

4703.l: A living snowman stands here, magically animated, watching you.
4703.d:
This creature of snow glides closer to you, occasionally scraping the bare
ground beneath him to add to his snowy body.  A single eye of bark rests
tilted in its head while two mobile arms of fallen oak branches swing
wildly at you.

4704.l: A mage with a frosty-white beard is here conducting a ritual.
4704.d:
This old man appears to be the patron saint and guardian for the
village.  Dressed in furs and the skins of wild elk, this mage
screams incantations, conjuring the snow to pile up and secure 
his village from outside attack.

4705.s: Khal'mast, the dragon of the northlands
4705.l: An enormous snow-scaled dragon is here, curled against the screaming winds.
4705.d:
Khal'mast is known as the Bane of the North.  Her transparent-white
scales allow her to blend in with the surrounding ice and snow.  Her
long teeth and whiskers are stained red and yellow with the decay of
past meals, betraying her nearly perfect snowy camoflauge.
4705.noise: You hear a hollow breathing close by.

4706.l: An enormous tiger stands here, licking its jowls.
4706.d:
This mountain cat boasts great grey stripes over its white coat.  Feline
fangs protrude slightly from its maw, while its thickly padded feet 
show the tips of sharp claws.

4707.l: A well-muscled warrior stands here, pointing his bow at you.
4707.d:
This warrior is of the Antali tribe, one of the few remaining clans that
opted to stay in the Valley of the Sulfur Fur and not migrate to the warmer
climates in lower elevations.  His black mustache and beard seems to join
neatly with the cut of his fur vest and skins while his elkskin leggings
fit precisely to the tip of his boots.

4708.l: A marmot is here, scavenging exposed grasses from beneath the snow.
4708.d:
This mountain-dwelling groundhog is the principal source of food and
fur in these mountains.  At almost a stone in weight, one of these
rodents can provide enough food for a full day's meals and enough
fur for a pair of gloves.

4709.l: A gigantic worm plows through the snow here.
4709.d:
This glacial annelid stands almost eight feet in height and easily three
times that in length.  A single tooth-rimmed orifice on its front surface
devours snow and clears a path for the rest of its ringed body.

4710.l: A white leopard is here, devouring a marmot.
4710.d:
This cat stands slightly larger than a typical hunting dog.  Spots of
grey and black form a marbled pattern over the leopard's white pelt.

4800.l: A tired sailor stands here, leaning wearily on a crate.
4800.d:
From the lines and wind scars on his sunburnt face, you can see that
this man has clearly spent most of his adult life on the deck of a ship.

4801.l: A waiter is here, carrying a tray full of food.
4801.d:
This yellow-skinned man rushes with the energy, though not the enthusiasm,
of a child, delivering food and drinks to those who dine and gamble here.

4802.l: A common citizen is here, walking down the street.
4802.d:
This man is little more than a common laborer.  Adjusting his torn,
cloth shirt, he ignores you and continues walking down the street.

4804.l: A muscled dockworker is here, carrying crates around.
4804.d:
Tanned and rippling with muscles, this native Xixieqian seems to earn
his living by carrying heavy crates from the dockyard onto the ships
for export.

4805.l: A lodger has rented this room and is resting here.
4805.d:
Road-weary, this wanderer has decided to take advantage of the comforts
of this inn.  He appears to be unarmed, but his muscles and scars tell
of many adventures on the open road.

4806.l: A haggard woman, perhaps the mother of a young child, stands here.
4806.d:
She looks very, very tired, this poor woman.  Lines of fatigue and toil
mar her face as she stands, leaning against a wall of a building for a 
rest.

4807.d:
This child appears to be no more than seven and runs in circles here,
apparently chasing an invisible dog.

4808.l: Soo Lin Tao stands here, tapping a cork into a cask of wine.
4808.d:
This middle-aged man smiles at you as you enter the store.  Perhaps,
he thinks, you may buy something from him.

4809.l: Hrenchao sits here, mixing a poultice.
4809.d:
Hrenchao is an old, old man.  His tanned, yellow skin is mottled with
spots of age while his face bears the wrinkles and scars of the
adventures of many decades.

4811.l: Lin Chao stands here, tending the bar.
4811.d:
A portly, yellow-skinned man, Lin Chao appears to be in his midlife with
slightly greying hair amidst the black strands.

4812.l: A sage sits here, reading a book.
4812.d:
This wrinkled old man appears to be little more than a scholarly prune.
Age spots and fold of skin hang from his gaunt face, giving the appearance
that his flesh is trying to escape his bones.

4813.l: A channeler of spirits and ghosts is here, casting his eyes upward.
4813.d:
This man appears to be in a daze.  He whispers quiet mutterings to the
air, apparently receiving answers to his words, as his eyes are glazed,
but his expressions are lucid.

4814.l: The constable stands here, surrounded by parchments and scribes.
4814.d:
This tall man appears to be a well-trained warrior.  His biceps and
pectorals bulge though his silken shirt while his abdominals muscles
appear to be trying to thrust his belt dagger through its scabbard
within his waistband.

4815.l: A scribe sits here, scribbling out passes and permits.
4815.d:
This young, yellow-skinned man appears to be well-suited for the life of
a scribe.  His long, dextrous fingers quickly scribble down orders and
requisitions for those who pay the necessary fees.  His hawkish nose is
windburned and peeling, while sweat pours off his lithe frame, drenching
his stained white scribe's robes.

4816.l: A yellow-skinned cook stands here, boiling water.
4816.d:
Dripping with sweat, this overworked man fries something in a giant
wok.  His hair is wet with steam from the boiling water around him,
and you notice a burn on one of his slender hands.

4817.l: A middle-aged man is here, polishing a snuff bottle.
4817.d:
This man appears to be intoxicated, or perhaps under the influence of
some substance.  His eyes are glazed, but there can be no question as
to his skill in glassworking, as is evident by the flawless crystal
earring on his right earlobe and the snuff bottles which line the
shelves along the wall.

4818.l: A gate guard stands here, monitoring the passers-by.
4818.d:
Lean and tense, this yellow-skinned man seems hypervigilant and well-
suited to guard the gate against suspicious intruders.

4819.l: Ping Xiao stands here, overseeing the gaming, gambling, and bartending.
4819.d:
Marred with pockmarks from oversampling of his stock, this slender man
leans over a game of bones, wary of any cheaters.

4820.l: Ta'lon Chao sits here, mixing reagents.
4820.d:
This woman appears to me in late-middle age, her yellow skin has grown
brown as the years have passed, leading you to believe that she is much
older than she appears.

4821.l: A master warrior stands here, training those of lesser skills.
4821.d:
This is easily the largest man you have seen in Xixieqi.  At nearly
seven feet tall, this giant wears his hair in a singular braid which
flows down the length of this back.  His arms are scarred and bruised,
evidence of his daily work with those who choose to spar with him to
improve their skills.

4822.l: Moo Shi, the armourer, stands here, hammering metal on an anvil.
4822.d:
Powerfully built, this man appears to be working on fashioning a new
set of scale armour.  His face is hairless, as are his muscled arms,
evidence of many hours working with hot steel and iron.

spw.name: Moo Shi's Banded Scales and Armours

4823.l: Yui Gui Pan, the tanner, sits here, poking holes into a yak skin.
4823.d:
Apparently the best tanner in the city, this yellow-skinned man has the
regal, almost arrogant bearing of a man who knows he is an expert at his
trade.  He gestures to you and then you his wares, offering you his fine
leathers.

spw.name: Yui Gui Pan's Hides and Tanning

4824.l: The weaponer stands here, chiseling a whetstone from granite.
4824.d:
Lean and obviously skilled with blades, this merchant gestures you to
examine his wares.

4825.l: A lithe, almost cat-like woman stands here, examining documents.
4825.d:
If it weren't for her yellow skin - that of a native - you would think this
slender woman was an elf.  With feline movements and grace, she looks you 
over, apparently not in approval.

4826.l: Yuang Li Tao, the seamstress, is here, mending a hole in a silk shirt.
4826.d:
An older woman, Yuang Li Tao appears to just want to sew as the last days of
her life pass.  The work she appears to do is exquisite however, as fine
silken shirts hang from rails around her.

spw.name: Yuang Li Tao's Fine Silks and Yarns

4827.l: A priest of the cult bows low, welcoming you.
4827.d:
Cloaked in thick white robes, you can make out no facial features.  His
hands are smooth, with long tapered fingers however, betraying the man's
age to be young.

4828.l: Meng stand here, trying to interest you in provisions.
4828.d:
This man appears to be the classic Xixieqian.  Yellow skin, brown eyes,
short black hair, and almond-shaped eyes clearly show his heritage and
race.

4836.l: A wealthy merchant stands here, smoking a pipe.
4836.d:
Dressed in fine clothes and slippers, this stately man appears to have
all the necessities of his life fulfilled, as is evident by the plush
fur carpets and the leather furniture around him.

4900.l: A hideous horned daemon scrapes rime from his scales here.
4900.d:
A ghastly creature, this daemon appears to be a larger, slower version
of conventional demons typically conjured by mad necromancers.  Standing
at nearly eight feet in height, its leathery scaled hide radiates a 
stagnant chill which appears to whiten its greyish flesh.

4901.l: A strange smoke coalesces into a humanoid elemental form here.
4901.d:
This beast appears to be a magical conjuration derived from the smoke of
the volcano.  Its stands nearly nine feet tall and its glowing yellow
eyes seem to float in an incorporeal mass of ether.
4901.noise: A loud hissing erupts from an unseen orifice.

4902.l: An elemental beast of fire burns here.
4902.d:
Borne from living flames, this beast stands nearly eight feet tall and
sports two cylindrical appendages of fire that maintain their form even
when moving.
4902.noise: A crackling noise can be heard from somewhere nearby.

4903.l: A winged, leather-skinned beast stands here, its sword drawn.
4903.d:
Over eight feel tall, this beast flicks a reptilian tongue across its
exposed sword.  Its yellow eyes regard you carefully, intelligently.
Clearly, this is no brute, but rather a calculating being.
4903.noise: You hear a low hissing sound.

4904.l: A sickening ooze elemental stands here.
4904.d:
Borne from Earth and Water, this extra-dimensional creature shambles
slowly toward you, perhaps to get a better look at a lesser being.
4904.noise: You can hear the sound of someone walking through mud.

4905.l: A gaunt being in robes stands here.
4905.d:
Through the hood of the cloak, you can see leather skin pulled over a
masculine skull.  This being has strange, reddish eyes that seem to glow.

4906.l: A fleshless undead daemon stands motionless here.
4906.d:
Just looking at this skinless beast makes you nauseous.  Ichor oozes
from broken membranes in the beast's torso and legs while a venomous
fluid drips from its mouth.
4906.noise: You think you hear blood drops hitting the stone floor.

4907.l: A daemon smith hammers studs into dead flesh here.
4907.d:
A fire daemon, this smith uses his nimble fingers to sew and hammer metal
studs into daemon-leather armor.
4907.noise: You can hear metal being hammered.

4908.d:
It's a ghastly beast, cloaked in midnight robes. The stench of death
surrounds him.
4908.noise: You can hear the crackling of magical energy.

4909.l: A small daemon pushes a cart here.
4909.d:
Smaller than other daemons, this little horned beast is little more than
a quasit, but seems capable of enough thought to take orders correctly.

4910.d:
This poor daemon obviously gave its life for his Lord as it evident by
the vicious scars and rents in its body.

4911.d:
An ice daemon, this articulate beast sounds like he speaks several
languages from across the planes.

4912.l: A smoke elemental stands here, haggling with other races.
4912.d:
This non-corporeal elemental chitters quietly as it negotiates a fair
price for a vial of extradimensional mist.
4912.noise: You hear the rushing of air.

4913.l: A lich stands here, demanding a higher price for his bone dust.
4913.d: He's a lich of the lowest form, barely animated enough to have sentience.

4914.l: The daemon lord of the Fortress stands before you.
4914.d:
A mighty ice daemon, this beast's white flesh and horns are barely
concealed under his metallic plate armor and visor.  A longsword
whose blade is nearly as long as your leg rests casually in his 
six-fingered hand.
4914.noise: You can hear a deep, throaty chuckling.

4915.l: An overseer of the gaming house watches you closely.
4915.d:
This fire daemon seems ready to toss out anyone who no longer has the
funding to play.  Everyone here is engaged in gambling, with no one
observing from the background.

4916.l: A daemon warlord, perhaps the second in command of this realm, sits here.
4916.d:
Rime and ice lay in the fingerprints of this six-fingered ice daemon.
He looks at you carefully, not underestimating any lesser mortal.

4917.d:
Typical of bats, this flying mammal has a high pitched chittering
alarm that senses movement.  Its leathery wings lay folded about its
body.

4918.l: A horned devil bears an heavy-looking pack on his back.
4918.d:
A typical red devil, this man-sized creature carried a heavy sack in 
which you can see crude shards of coloured gems protrude from the
opening.

4919.l: A daemon, cloaked in thick robes, chants quietly here.
4919.d: You can make out no details of the daemon through his heavy clothing.

4920.l: A fire daemon stands here, its hair ablaze.
4920.d:
Standing almost eight feet tall, this lumbering beast stares down upon
you from behind three greenish eyes.
4920.noise: You hear the crackling of fire.

4990.l: Sil Silverstreak stands here, a feral grin playing on his unshaven face.
4990.d:
Bloodied and obviously hungry, this man is adorned with silver armor
and bright silver weapons.

5000.l: A giant scorpion digs itself out of the sand here.
5000.d:
Rather like the typical desert scorpions, this poisonous insect sports
a huge stinger that rises high above its body.
5000.noise: You hear a chittering noise on the breeze.

5001.l: A roguish raider of the desert stands here, watching you carefully.
5001.d:
Unshaven and foul-smelling, this raider appears to have recently robbed
a small caravan.  His clothes are new, obviously stolen, and the glass
dagger at his side has obviously never been used.

5002.l: A desert cobra slithers here, leaving a path in the sand.
5002.d:
The weakest and smallest of the desert snakes, this yard-long viper
slithers along the hot sands, absorbing much of the heat through its
yellowish scales.

5003.l: A banded hawk soars above you, oblivious to the heat.
5003.d:
Bright yellow bands stripe this desert hawk which scans the sand for a 
morsel of food.
5003.noise: You can hear the cry of a desert bird.

5004.l: A dust devil spins in the desert winds here.
5004.d:
This appears to be little more than a man-sized whirlwind of desert sand
that twirls about the desert.

5005.l: A metallic-scaled dragon naps here in the baking sun.
5005.d:
At over 80 feet long, this wyrm is clearly an old beast for its species.
He snoozes peacefully in the sun, not caring to awaken for your presence.
5005.noise: You can hear a powerful gust of air rushing nearby.

5006.l: A trader stands beside a cart here.
5006.d:
Weathered and with tan skin, this middle-aged woman looks hearty and
regal as she checks her goods for damage from the wind and sand.
5006.noise: You can hear the crunching of sand under wooden wheels.

5007.l: A massive blue dragon rests quietly here, pointedly ignoring you.
5007.d:
The blue dragon stretches her massive wings as she absorbs the warmth
from the sands beneath her.  The suns have made her scales a glistening
sapphire colour that sparkles against the light and gives her an almost
holy appearance.  Her wingspan is easily 100 feet wide, which almost
matches her incredible length.
5007.noise: You can hear a deep rumble nearby.

5200.l: Jack searches for evil giants to slay.
5200.d:
A young human, in his twenties, with a perpetual smile on his face and an
arsenal of weaponry on his back.

5500.l: A forest creeper grows along the ground here.
5500.d:
It looks like a living vine. Though it survives by strangling its prey,
you are much to big for it to kill. You hope.

5501.l: A large wolf paces back and forth here, guarding the forest from intruders.
5501.d: He is a dull grey, blending in with the night mist.

5502.l: A large Taltos stands here, surveying you kindly.
5502.d:
The Taltos stands about 7 feet tall, and is the most beautiful creature you
have ever seen. Almost human, you feel irrestibly drawn to it, right before it
tries to rip your head off.

5503.l: A small but powerful looking Taltos walks here.
5503.d:
The Taltos is short for his race.. only about 6 feet tall. However, he appears
to be highly intellgent, and just as beautiful and dangerous as the rest of
his kind.

5504.l: A Taltos female walks silently here.
5504.d:
She is so beautiful your heart almost breaks. She is so deadly, your spine
almost does the same.

drp.name: a pair of intricately designed bracers

5505.l: A HUGE Taltos stomps around here angrily.
5505.d:
This Taltos looks has the same alluring looks as the rest of his race, but
is carrying a ferocious looking weapon.

5506.l: The clanleader of the Taltos stands before you.
5506.d:
This Taltos is the father of the clan. High on the milk of the clanmother,
he's pretty harmless unless provoked.

5507.l: The mother of all Taltos rests here.
5507.d:
Female Taltos are rare, and one that can breed is rarer still. This
clanmother is revered by all living Taltos.

drp.name: a golden ring of intertwined leaves

5508.l: There's a lump here in the forest.
5508.d: She's Lump! She's Lump! She's Lump! She's in your head!

5509.l: A huge glowing sphere floats in the corner of your vision before attacking.
5509.d:
The will o' the wisp is just a glowing ball of light... that hates all living
things.

5510.l: A vaguely man-shaped beast stalks through the trees.
5510.d:
It's a humanoid beast, dressed in the tattered clothes of a sorcerer of the 
black arts. The evil robes are almost worn away, and you can see that every
inch of his skin is covered in thick, bristly hair... he's a werewolf!

5700.l: A wooden couch sits here strewn with colorful pillows.
5700.d:
A colorful couch sits here with big fluffy cushions and pillows.  Something
doesn't seem quite right though, the number of pillows seem disproportionate.

5701.l: A long-haired flame orange cat is sleeping on top of the chest.
5701.d:
The cat looks peaceful.  You get the feeling that even though it is sleeping it
is aware of your presence.

5800.l: A boundary warden stands here on constant vigil.
5800.d:
This man knows how to kill, that is obvious at first glance.  He is
covered in weapons, although he doesn't look like he would need them.  In
fact, it looks like he uses his bare hands most of the time.

spw.name: An Abrupt End To The Path
The Darkest Part Of The Forest
At The Fringe Of The Boundary

5801.s: Zedd, wizard of the First Order
5801.l: Zedd stands here adorned in plain robes.
5801.d:
This is the one of the most powerful wizards in the land.  He is eating
his stew and looks no more concerned of your presence than he would be of a
fly. His robes are very plain and he wears a stone around his neck.

5802.l: A heart hound rushes at you, aimed for your heart!
5802.d:
This hound looks really nasty and has large teeth and claws.  It goes
directly for the heart.

5803.l: A shadowy wraith appears from the mist and attacks!
5803.d: It looks like night itself and is coming for you!

5804.l: Shota the witch woman glares at you icily.
5804.d:
She is one of the most beautiful creatures you have ever seen in all
your travels.  She is so beautiful, you don't know if you could ever
even attempt to bring her harm. She doesn't look as nasty and evil as
the rumors say she is supposed to be.

5805.l: A long-tailed gar charges at you intent on killing you!
5805.d:
It has a long tail, two big arms and two large wings.  It also has teeth
and claws to match.

5806.l: A huge crimson dragon is here protecting her egg.
5806.d:
Scarlet is a dragon of a crimson tone.  She is a very majestic and
beautiful creature that is fiercely protective of her egg.

spw.name: The Cave At The Top Of The Mountain

5807.l: A woman covered in mud is here.
5807.d:
She is covered in mud from head to toe.  She is too busy with her
tasks to pay you any mind.

5808.l: A child covered in mud is playing here.
5808.d: It is covered in mud, just like the adults, and is busy playing.

spw.name: A Small Hut In The Village

5809.l: A man covered in mud sharpens his spear here.
5809.d: He is covered in mud and looks very competent with that spear.

5810.l: The wise Bird Man stands here covered in mud.
5810.d:
He looks to be the ruler of these people.  He is old and wise but
still looks capable of defending himself.

5888.l: Brophy the shopkeeper stands here selling his wares.
5888.d:
He looks to be a fair and honest businessman.  His wares seem to be
of high quality and at a fair price.

7001.l: A poor man stands dejected here wondering how he can feed his family.
7001.d:
A once proud  and strong man, now frail and afraid. He has too many children
and no means of caring for them. You can see his spirit flickering within 
sunken eyes if you look close enough.

7002.l: A haggard looking woman tends a small fire.
7002.d:
She looks haggard and worried. How can she make this poor soup stretch far
enough? Little and doesn't seem to be getting better.  When will more money
be coming in?  She looks hopelessly resigned to a life of misery.

7003.l: A lotus purveyor stands here, looking to peddle more black death.
7003.d:
A scum of the lowest sort, one who preys upon the addictions of others.
Dressed in an outrageouly floppy hat and multi-colored jerkin and hose,
he grins insolently at you, knowing that you can't resist.

7004.l: A young bully poses here, trying to look tough.
7004.d:
He's young and brash, scared of everything, but can't let anyone see it.
He'll pick a fight with smaller weaker opponents at the drop of a hat, 
but proves spineless when the going gets tough.
7004.noise: A bully says, "Whatcha lookin' at, punk?"

7005.l: A thug rests here, looking you over and trying not to be obvious.
7005.d:
Basically a bully grown up, but much more lethal than a bully. Still, you
can count on the fact that when the goin gets bad, the bad will get going.
7005.noise: A thug eyes your belongings intently.

7006.l: A deadly looking young man surveys the area.
7006.d:
While the man is young, he appears more mature than his age would lead you
to believe. His eyes seem to flick about the area absorbing everything. His
attire is simple and economical. While he wears a simple short sword about
his waist, you get the feeling from the way he stands that it would be the
last weapon he used.

7007.l: A young baby lies here crying.
7007.d: A young baby, crying because it is hungry. It looks so helpless.
7007.noise: A baby sniffs and cries out loud.

7008.l: A dirty young boy hides here, totally absorbed in a game of tag.
7008.d:
Covered from head to toe in filth, he looks like he's having a good time 
playing. He eyes you warily as you approach.
7008.noise: A dirty boy runs around in the street.

7009.l: A dirty young girl stands here, pretending to comb a doll's hair.
7009.d:
Like the boys playing in the streets, she's filthy dirty. She looks rather
wary and won't even come near you.

7010.l: A beady-eyed rat sits here, guarding it's loot.
7010.d: A small city rat of the ring-tailed variety.

7011.l: A man stands here wearing a startled look, mumbling incomprehensible things.
7011.d:
By all appearances he's as nutty as can be. He wears ragged and filthy
clothing about his rail-thin frame. By listening closely, you can sort of
make out what he's mumbling about, something about the church is actually
a manifestation of wargs who control the universal door to ... ???

spw.name: Second Floor of a Gutted Hotel

7012.l: An effete young boy hovers nearby, an anticipatory look upon his face.
7012.d:
A young boy, thin and slender, with golden-brown hair. He wears saffron
colored silk breeches and shirt, with soft slippers upon his feet. He 
hovers near the beggar king, hand resting on the hilt of a short sword.
He watches you intently, occasionally glancing at his master, the beggar
king.

7013.l: A young boy stands here, dressed in the garb of a butler.
7013.d:
One of the youngest you've seen here, he appears to be serving as a
butler.  Like all the others, he is slender and has blonde-brown hair.
Unlike the others, he appears somewhat uncomfortable here.  There is a nasty
bruise upon his left cheek and his eye is still swollen shut some.

7014.l: A homeless man sits here looking defeated.
7014.d:
Looking haggard and listless, he is one of the many without shelter or
means of supporting himself. Despite his condition, he does not appear to
be begging for any help. Perhaps he is to proud to do that?

spw.name: Second Floor of a Gutted Hotel

7015.l: A homeless woman sits here, knees drawn up, a wary look upon her face.
7015.d:
Like the homeless men in the area, she is gaunt and lifeless. She glances
around repetitively and rapidly, her fear plain upon her face. Despite her
condition, she does not appear to be begging. Most strange.

7016.l: A half-starved stray dog trots by, looking for scraps.
7016.d:
While its ribs show through its coat, it appears to eat better than many
of the inhabitants of this area. Its coat is matted and filthy with large
patches missing. Its yellowed teeth still look quite capable though.

7017.l: A filthy, dirty muskrat bares it fangs at you.
7017.d:
This weasel-like rodent appears to be scavenging for food.  Its claws
are caked with dirt and dried blood.

7018.l: A beggar sits here, begging for mercy ... and money!
7018.d:
A despicable site, many of the beggars around here seem to be missing body
parts. Perhaps they are old war veterans, forgotten and neglected. As you
walk by, they plead and beg for money. Looking upon their sad state, you
almost can't help but feel sorry for them.
7018.noise: A beggar cries out for alms.

7019.l: A Black Lotus user sits here, eyes glazed over.
7019.d:
Addicted to the deadly and deteriorating Black Lotus, he sits here staring
at a world that only he can see. A disposable pipe is held loosely in
his grasp, a small trickle of drool streams down one cheek. They come
in all sizes, shapes and sexes, but the end result is the same, a slow
death as they rot from the inside out.

spw.name: Second Floor of a Gutted Hotel

7020.l: A lotus user lies here, passed out from too much lotus.
7020.d:
After inhaling too much Black Lotus, the body shuts down. In some cases, it
can cease to function entirely. This is the danger of lotus, for the body
gets weaker the more that is used, and the chance of never waking up
increases with each hit. Impartial to all, lotus users come in all shapes
sizes, and sex.

spw.name: Second Floor of a Gutted Hotel

7021.l: A bar patron sits here, enjoying good food, drink, and company.
7021.d:
People of all sorts crowd the room, drinking, eating and talking about many
different things. The atmosphere is relaxed, and most patrons seem to having
an enjoyable time.

7022.l: A large lout is here, being obnoxious as usual.
7022.d:
An obnoxious sort, Richard Nogin stands at the bar telling boastful tales
of his prowess and insulting everyone around him. He stand well over six
and a half feet tall and has a neck as thick as most peoples thigh. This
prolly accounts for the reason why people seem to let him get away with
insulting them. Most people in the room seem to be studiously ignoring him.

7023.l: A sickly slave-mage is here, serving Tymora.
7023.d:
It is a grey skinned sickly creature with big eyes that bulge from its
face.  The slave-mage wears a bulky collar that allows its master to keep
its magical energies in check.

7024.l: A haughty looking man dressed in silks stares at you insolently.
7024.d:
Like the boys surrounding him, he is dressed in fine silks of saffron colors.
His hands are adorned with guady costume jewelry rings, his hair is oiled
and swept back. Given his status, you would expect him to be obese, but to
the contrary, he seems almost anemic and is very skinny. However, he lounges
about the room with indifference, knowing full well he rules all in this
domain.

7025.l: A beautiful and erotically clad woman smiles at you knowingly.
7025.d:
She wears a long kimono like dress, with a high collar and a diamond-shaped
cutout in front to reveal some extreme curvature of cleavage. Long, painted
fingernails adorn slender agile hands resting on her womanly hips while
silky-lidded eyes stare at you, a half-smile pursed on full red lips. As
you look at her, you can't help but notice the firm erect nipples protruding
from underneath her silken dress.

7026.noise: A soft moan escapes from one of the silken rooms.

7027.noise: You hear a female voice moan in ecstacy.

7028.noise: You hear the sounds of leather whips and chains from one of the rooms.

7029.noise: You hear a curious sucking sound coming from behind a curtain.

7030.noise: A faint rythmic sound emanates from somewhere behind the curtains.

7031.l: A serious looking boy in a plain grey shirt and breeches looks at you.
7031.d:
Small and lithe, the look upon his face belies his age. His stance is that
of someone versed in combat. His plain and simple attire is well suited to
this purpose as well.

7032.l: A well-toned young man stands here, looking at you with a sneer.
7032.d:
He is the oldest of the young boys that seems to populate this place, and
certainly the most dangerous looking. He wields a wicked looking thin-blade
sword with which he appears to be quite comfortable and familiar with. As
with all the others, he is light-haired and slender.

7033.l: A gambler sits here, intent upon the game they are playing.
7033.d:
Occasionally smiling, sometimes distraught, they are mostly serious bunch
intent upon losing their money gambling. While they may come out on top
from time to time, in the long run it's the house that wins.
7033.noise: You hear the sound of a noisy dice game from a back room.

7034.l: Sticks is here, watching the room, tapping out a rythym with his Bo sticks.
7034.d:
You've not seen many people who seem to enjoy their work as much as sticks.
He wanders about sometimes, sits in a corner sometimes, but is always
smiling and tapping out a rythym with his Bo sticks, or just whirling them
in his hands. He looks quite capable of keeping the many patrons of the
room in line.

7035.l: A beautiful woman stands behind the bar serving drinks.
7035.d:
Padrisha is a well known figure here. She is known not only for her skill
in mixing drinks and beauty, but also for her healthful concoctions.
Always smiling, she radiates caring and compassion. Perhaps this is one
reason everyone in the room is so relaxed.

drp.name: a shot of wheat grass juice

items_sold.name: a shot of wheat grass juice

7036.l: A finely yet simply dressed young boy searches about apprehensibly.
7036.d:
He seems out of place here, his clothes are fine if not simple, and he is
well manicured and clean. He seems to be searching about for something and
given his ashen color, the biting of his lip, and the scared look in his
eyes, he seems quite afraid of something.

7037.l: A cook stands here, cleaver in hand and chefs hat listing hard to starboard.
7037.d:
Beads of sweat dot her brow and her cheeks are ruddy. She wear a funky set
of multi-colored pants and a much stained double-breasted chefs smock. As
you stand there oogling, her brows knit together into a scowl.

7038.l: A cloaked and hooded figure sits here, half-hidden in the semi-darkness.
7038.d:
Looking closely, you are fairly certain that this figure is a man, though
it is impossible to tell for sure.  As you turn away, the figure leans forward
a bit and look to the end of the table.  As they do this, the light
highlights their face for a brief moment.  Your eyes must be deceiving
you though, it looked like the Bishop Ruar Thelion! Impossible!

7039.l: A cloaked and hooded figure sits here, half-hidden in the semi-darkness.
7039.d:
It is hard to see in this room and all the people surrounding the table are
wearing full cloaks, all alike, and have the hood drawn up. You cannot tell
with any certainty the sex of the person. Looking around at the figures, they
all look alike except for subtle differences such as hands and tell-tale
mustaches. This person has their back to you, so you have no idea as to their
identity.

7040.l: A hard, marble gargoyle sits here impassively.
7040.d:
Skillfully carved, the gargoyle seems almost alive. As you step closer, you
realize it is alive!

7041.l: A withered and skeletal looking bush is planted here.
7041.d:
Seemingly dead, the plant is far from that. It is the deadly grave-root, so
named for the duality of it's nature. The plant itself is deadly both for
its toxins as well as its aggressive nature. It feeds itself from the 
decaying corpse of living things. Despite the deadly nature of this plant,
the root is just the opposite, know for its healing.

7042.l: A cloaked and hooded figure sits here, half-hidden in the semi-darkness.
7042.d:
Scanning quickly now, you see this person is also male. The bushy beard and 
broad facial features indicates that this is probably Glynwyn Babcockson, a
high level member of the Warriors guild. What would he be doing in such
company?

7043.l: A cloaked and hooded figure sits here, half-hidden in the semi-darkness.
7043.d:
As your eyes begin to adjust to the dim light, they travel to the next person.
The sharp angular face of Master Assassin Alyssa Tomis. Unlike the rest, her
hood is slightly back and she wears a slight smile upon her face. She is as
beautiful as the stories say she is ... and probably as deadly!

7044.l: A cloaked and hooded figure sits here, half-hidden in the semi-darkness.
7044.d:
Glancing quickly now to the opposite side of the table, you quickly identify
Srali Modesta, Magus of the inner circle and high ranking Mages Guild member.
This is certainly strange company! There appears to be some documents
scattered about the table, but you can't quite make out what they might be of.

7045.l: A cloaked and hooded figure sits here, half-hidden in the semi-darkness.
7045.d:
Withdrawn into the depths of the shadows around their chair, this figure is 
impossible to accurately identify. As you start to look to the next person,
you see the glint of a ring. It's a signet from the Merchant's guild! By the 
blood, they are outspoken opponents of the Church's power! Yet here they sit
with a ranking member of the Theocracy!

7046.l: A cloaked and hooded figure sits here, half-hidden in the semi-darkness.
7046.d:
Sitting at the edge of the light, you discern that this is Avrie Soernsin,
head of the lesser know, and lesser powerful, Trader's Guild. Avrie managed a 
spin off from the main Merchant's Guild to establish the Trader's Guild. He
fidgits nervously in his seat.

7047.l: A cloaked and hooded figure sits here, half-hidden in the semi-darkness.
7047.d:
Glancing back across the table you see Lady Sophie, as she likes to be called,
Master Artisan of the Arts & Crafts Guild. Unlike most of the rest, she 
ignores your presence and continues to read something. Is that a map of the
city on the table in front of her?

7048.l: A cloaked and hooded figure sits here, half-hidden in the semi-darkness.
7048.d:
Finally looking to the end of the table sits an unknown figure, fully 
withdrawn into the shadows surrounding his chair. You can discern nothing of 
their identity. Judging by the size of the figure sitting, they must be well
over six feet tall. Thinking hard, you try to place them in this who's who of
power figures from Kir Draxin's upper eschelon. You hear someone clear their
throat.  Perhaps you'd best leave now.

7049.l: Jasper Withrold, Scribe to His Holiness putters about here.
7049.d:
Small and anemic, Jasper is typical of most scribes. The term bookish comes
to mind when envisioning him. His pinched features and hawk nose make him
a rather distinctive individual. Combined with his outlandishly ornate
emerald colored robes, you doubt Jasper could hide if he wanted to.

7900.l: Anastatia is here, searching for demons.
7900.d:
She is a young, beautiful human, charged by her religion with a horrible
quest:  To seek out and destroy demons - the bane of humanity.  A pity really
as she is quite beautiful, but beneath those shy and and naive looking eyes
lives the soul of a killer.  Don't mess with her.

7901.l: Talon is here, looking for his brother.
7901.d:
Talon is a tall elf with blond hair and icy blue eyes.  His fair skin is
flawless with the exception of a narrow scar that runs across his neck -
the result of a failed assassination attempt.  He is looking for his lost
brother.

7902.l: Dag grunts in your general direction.
7902.d:
Dag is a big, mean, smelly barbarian.  He takes one look at you and
snorts loudly, disgusted by your sophistication.

7903.l: A black cloaked figure sweeps by you and disappears.
7903.d:
Dracula stares back at you, his cold eyes peering deep into your soul. You
feel mesmerized.

7904.l: War rides through on a horse black as night.
7904.d:
War is one of the four horsemen of the Apocalypse. Clothed head-to-toe in black
armor, he fears no mortal man.

7905.l: Death rides on a pale horse.
7905.d:
Death is one of the four horsemen of the Apocalypse. This skeletal figure has
one goal: to collect souls for judgment. It looks as though he has decided to
start with yours.

7906.l: An imposing man on a black horse rides here.
7906.d:
Famine is one of the four horsemen of the Apocalypse.
Although wearing only rags, his immortal stature
makes him a threat to your very existence.

7907.l: Pestilence rides here on a lame horse.
7907.d:
Pestilence is one of the four horsemen of the Apocalypse. Spreading disease and
death across the land, he pays little attention to the living.

7908.l: The mighty Quetzalcoatl hovers before you.
7908.d:
Quetzalcoatl is a giant feathered snake.  The ssaurs and lizardmen worship
him as a trickster god - both benevolent and destructive at the same time.
Standing before him, you feel a sense of awe - and fear.

7909.l: A sharply-dressed, lithe elf adventures here.
7909.d:
He looks very strong and agile. Muscles ripple beneath his green tunic, and
his eyes seem to size you up with a glance. He's easily the scariest elf
you've ever seen.

spw.name: The Southern end of the hall

drp.name: a pair of mithril chain gloves
a pair of mithril chain boots
a pair of mithril chain sleeves
a pair of mithril chain leggings

7910.l: A nightbreed hunter is here, looking for weres and vamps.
7910.d: He's muttering something about revenge, and seems quite insane with rage.

7911.d:
He is a lithe, foreign looking man who wears a constant sneer across his
scarred face.

7912.l: A spy from a far-off land sneaks about.
7912.d:
Although he is trying to remain unobtrusive, this foreign spy
sticks out like a sore thumb.

7913.l: A huge mound of rotting vegetation shambles toward you.
7913.d:
No one knows how the Shambler came to be, one day it just seemed to appear.  It
is made up of a pile of rotting leaves, decomposing wood, and putrid vines that
stands ten feet tall.  Two moldy, quivering stumps hang from its sides, slimy
roots flailing wildly about.  It has no legs, instead moving like a slug,
leaving a trail of thick, green-tinted slime.

spw.name: The Southern end of the hall

7914.l: The huge, green scaled Behemoth is here, eating everything in sight.
7914.d:
The behemoth is huge.  It's at least fifty feet long and twenty feet tall.  Its
huge jaw clamps down on everything it sees with the two bulging red eyes
located on the front of its reptilian face, each as large as your head.  The
mottled green scales covering its body look thicker than the plates of steel
used to make the strongest of armors.

7915.l: Daerovis the Mighty Paladin is here searching for evil things to destroy.
7915.d:
He is a tall, handsome human, dressed in full battle armor.  His white armor
gleams in the sunlight, and he smiles as he surveys the landscape in front
of him.

7916.l: An old dwarf treks across the countryside.
7916.d:
Barnstad's entire race was nearly wiped out by the Dark One hundreds of years
ago.  He used to be a happy man, a fine craftsman.  But now, his friends
are all dead, battle scars mar his old face, and all that is left inside
him is hatred.

7917.l: Adonis the mighty paladin is here surveying the horizion.
7917.d:
A mighty champion is here covered in gleaming white armor that reflects
the light about him.  At his side is a gorgeous looking longsword that 
sheds its own light.  He smiles at you as you look upon him and then turns
his gaze out towards the horizon.

drp.name: a glistening vial of holy oils

7920.l: Pyros, the Daemon Lord screams in rage.
7920.d:
Surrounded by flames with an evil grin on its face, Pyros stands before you.
Known in the underworld as the Daemon Lord, Pyros is more than capable of
destroying you in this world.

7969.l: A mysterious man in a long black cloak wanders about.
7969.d:
To say that he is inconspicuous would be an understatement.  You find that if
you don't concentrate on following his movements every second, you lose track
of exactly what he is doing.

7970.l: A beautiful white horse with a single, spiral horn stands here.
7970.d:
The Unicorn is an ancient, mystical creature, the symbol of Life in druidic
religions.  There is rumored to be only a single one in the entire world.

7971.l: The Crow is here, dressed like a mime from hell.
7971.d:
He's dressed in black leather pants and a tight long-sleeve top.
Electrical tape holds his clothes together.

7979.l: A wide-eyed kender is here, adventuring.
7979.d:
Complete with top-knot and rows and rows of pouches, He looks to have been
adventuring for some time. His happy countenance is marked with a look of
much experience.

7980.l: Xena, warrior princess, searches for new adventure.
7980.d:
Wearing a low-cut, steel-breasted garment that leaves little to the imagi-
nation, she's an intelligent vixen who kicks ass and doesn't bother to take
names.

7981.l: A devilish space gnome is here.
7981.d:
These little buggers are the scum of the universe.
Whack 'em.

8001.l: Hans the gateguard is standing here.

8002.l: Franz the gateguard is leaning against the wall beside the gate.
8002.d: Looking as strong and stupid as ever!

8003.l: Darek the weaponsmith is gazing at you through a rack of swords.
8003.d:
Darek is a stout, dwarven weaponsmith of the highest caliber. His smithy
work is insurmountable, typical of shopkeepers in a city this size.

8004.l: Jack the armorer is here polishing his platemail.
8004.d: You see a very large, very strong armorer.
8004.noise: You hear the clanging of metal from the armory.

drp.name: a pair of scale mail leggings
a pair of scale mail sleeves
a pair of scale mail boots
a pair of scale mail gloves

8005.l: Good 'ol Byron is here sniffing his bronze cleaner.
8005.d: Definitely baked most of the time you'd imagine.

8006.l: Leon the leatherworker is busily seeing what he can do for you.
8006.d:
Always talking about sports, but never playing them, a tad odd
you think to yourself.

8007.l: Pula is sitting behind the counter waiting to serve you.
8007.d:
This is one woman you DEFINITELY don't want to rob.  Though she is
rather attractive in a hairy kinda way.

8008.l: Telf the baker stands here enjoying the dough.
8008.d:
Telf is not a thin fellow, but it looks as if he takes pride in
his work.  There is not a spot behind the counter, though there
are small amounts of flour on the walls and doors where he
has had to put his hands.

8009.l: Emmet stands against the back wall, watching you.
8009.d:
Emmet is a tall, lanky human in his mid-forties.  Knowing your kind well,
he watches you move about his store with a wary eye.

8010.l: An outcast drow elf mistress eyes you with cold oval pupils.
8010.d:
Pearly-white hair sweeps down around a beautiful, dark-skinned elven
face. The slanted eyes common of all elves reflect nothing of the 
feelings of this drow.

8011.l: The apothecary is here, brewing some potions.
8011.d:
Dressed in red flowing robes, Kira is grinding a foul-smelling stone into
powder.

drp.name: a yellow potion of see invisible

items_sold.name: a yellow potion of see invisible

8012.l: Belar the master warrior stands here waiting to teach you.
8012.d:
He is one of the biggest humans you've ever seen. Bulging muscles ripple
across his bare chest, and several scars across his body prove that he was
using weapons before you were even born. He has a calm look on his face.

8013.l: A well-dressed thief stands here silently.
8013.d:
You realize that whenever your guildmaster moves, you fail to notice it -
the way of the true thief.  She is to be dressed in poor clothing, having
the appearance of a beggar.

8014.l: Le Tal the master cleric is standing here.
8014.d:
You are in no doubt that this guildmaster is truly close to your god; he has
a peaceful, loving look.  You notice that he is surrounded by a white aura.

8015.l: Eldrich the sorcerer is standing here.
8015.d:
Even though your guildmaster looks old and tired, you can clearly see the
vast amount of knowledge she possesses.  She is wearing fine magic clothing,
and you notice that she is surrounded by a blue shimmering aura.

8016.l: A sorcerer is guarding the entrance.
8016.d:
He is an experienced mage who has specialized in the field of Combat Magic.
He is here to guard the Mage's Guild and his superior knowledge of offensive as
well as defensive spells make him a deadly opponent.

8017.l: A knight templar is guarding the entrance.
8017.d:
He is a specially trained warrior belonging to the military order of the Faith.
His duty is to protect the faithful from persecution and infidel attacks and
his religious devotion combined with his superior skill makes him a deadly
opponent.

8018.l: The old tavern keeper surveys you from behind the bar.
8018.d:
He is an old man, with many scars across his face.  You notice that
the few people who he does converse with treat him with utmost respect
and consideration.  He looks to be quite old, but the way he move about
the tavern in the course of his duties tells of quick dexterity and
fluidness of motion.  You get the impression that the tavern keeper is
studying you closely, even though he appears not to be at all.

8019.l: A big brute of a warrior is guarding the entrance.
8019.d:
He is a fighter who has specialized in killing others as effectively as 
possible, using all sorts of weapons.  His superior knowledge of how and 
where to use them combined with his extraordinary strength makes him a deadly 
opponent.

8020.l: An armored church guard keeps an eye on the gate.
8020.d:
He's a holy looking man with a pointed beard and helm to match. Though he
works for the church (or perhaps because of that fact) there's nothing
friendly about him as he sweeps your bloodstained apparel with a disdainful
glance.

8021.l: A horse stands here, flicking its tail.
8021.d:
It is a gelded, well-bred steed with a dark brown coat and legs trained for
long-distance travel.

8022.l: A stablehand stands here, brushing a horse.
8022.d:
He's dressed in some decent leather breeches and a matching vest. He
has an air about him that seems to reflect his knowledge of horses, and
stench about him that definitely reflects his commitment to the job.

8023.l: A lithe blonde prostitute flaunts her wares.
8023.d:
Already blonde hair has been dyed nearly white, and the skirt she's wearing
barely covers her naked rump.
That she was beautiful once cannot be denied, but now she looks more like a 
circus performer.

8024.l: Muntara, the Psionic guildmistress, sits here meditating.
8024.d: She has the serene look of one who can explode your mind from the inside out.

8025.k: ninja guild guard guildguard men-shen man
8025.l: A large man stands here, barring your way.
8025.d:
The ninja guildguard appears to be an oversized human with a grim countenance
and golden skin.

8026.l: An old, hunched man sits on a stool here, remembering the past.
8026.d:
He looks awfully old, but as his eyes seem to search into your soul, you
realize he's more than he looks.

8027.l: A city guardsman stands watch here.
8027.d:
He is a young human dressed in the garb of a Cross guardsman.  You guess
that he is a neophyte, just out of training, as the job of playing glorified
watchman is usually given to the newer members, while the veterans take patrol
or gate duty.

8059.l: Aversin, Captain of the Guard, stands here eyeing his surroundings.
8059.d:
Aversin is a tall, muscular human in his early forties.  He strikes you as
being a very charismatic leader -- you've heard that his guard is fanatically
devoted to him.  Although he has never been ordained, his garb is the same
as that of a Paladin of the Cross, signifying the great respect that the church
has for him and his position.

8060.l: A city guard patrols the wall road.
8060.d:
He's a big, strong, helpful, trust-worthy guard that looks like he'd take a
bribe in a heartbeat.

8061.l: A janitor is walking around, cleaning up.
8061.d:
Commissioned by the church, he "volunteered" to keep the city clean rather
than spend a day in the stockades.

8062.d:
Going about his business, the citizen keeps a wary eye out for armed visitors
like yourself - and an even more cautious eye out for the dominating city 
guards.

8063.l: A hybrid warg runs the streets, looking for fresh kills.
8063.d:
The warg is a small animal that looks like a cross between a dog and a pig that
has a foul smell and pieces of rotten meat hanging around his teeth.

8066.l: A petitioner tries to get you to sign something.
8066.d:
Dressed in a flowing trouser-suit, he thrusts a piece of paper under your
nose, babbling on about signing this form to outlaw weapons in the city.

8067.d:
He's a balding man with a leather tool belt around his waist. You figure
he's in town to help with the building of new shops and such.

8068.l: The town crier sobs as he tells his life story.
8068.d:
With a tear in his eye and a sorrow torn expression, you can only feel sorry
for him.

8069.l: A zealot tells you how to be saved.
8069.d:
He is dressed in old, filthy clothing and his hair is tangled and nappy.
He wanders about the city with a crazed look in his eyes and spouts scripture
from the book of the Cross.

8070.l: A street urchin gives you a pitiful look.
8070.d:
He's a shifty looking character who keeps glancing at you out of the corner
of his eye.

8071.l: A beggar asks for your loose change.
8071.d:
He's dressed in decrepit rags and his toes show through his shoes. You feel
a twinge of pity. Almost.

8072.l: A singing drunk vomits on the ground.
8072.d: He looks like he had a few too many bottles of ale for breakfast this morning.

8074.l: A wandering minstrel plays his flute.
8074.d:
He's an elven minstrel; traveled far from his homeland in search of the
perfect ballad.

8076.l: Harga is here trying to get people to buy his ribs.
8076.d:
This large man can only be the famous Harga, proprietor and owner of
Harga's House of Ribs. He looks like he's been up to his elbows in grease
for a long time.

8078.l: Thib the jeweler stands here, eyeing a fine stone through a monocle.
8078.d:
He's a tall, red-haired man with a serious look. A sharp dagger with an
emerald-inlaid hilt hangs from his side.

8079.l: A mime stands here, trapped in an invisible box.
8079.d:
Kill it! Kill it now!
God have mercy on us all, please kill it!

8080.l: An acolyte priestess runs errands for her mistress.
8080.d:
She is a young, naive thing, destined for the priesthood since birth.
She smiles at you shyly as she hurries by on her errand.

8081.l: A young sorcerer stands here, staring at the sights.
8081.d:
Obviously a tourist; he's gawking at the buildings and holding tightly onto
his purse.

8083.l: A balding psionic in grey robes guards the mistress's chamber.
8083.d:
He stares straight forward, but you can sense his feathery probes at your
mind as he continually searches you for signs of violence.

8086.l: Berzerker grins evilly at you as you enter his shop.
8086.d:
No one knows exactly where he came from, or how he got here, but he makes some
bad-ass tattoos. Just as you are about to turn away from him, his face seems
to twist into some foul mockery of a human's visage, but just as you notice
it, it returns to normal.

8087.l: Ferrenx the identifier stands here, perusing an old magic book.
8087.d:
He's dressed in fine silk clothes, dyed white to match his bowl-cut hair
and bushy eyebrows.

8088.l: A fat jailguard sits here, wiggling a loose tooth.
8088.d: He's fat, ugly, and willing to take a bribe.

8089.l: A guard is here, keeping you from going into prison.
8089.d:
This man came into town poor, but now works in one of the cities most important
positions, he keeps people from wandering into jail.

8092.l: The Servant is here, making sure everything is organized.
8092.d:
A long-snouted, pointed-eared individual, well-fanged and clawed, of a
greenish-silver cast of complexion, eyes large and shining, damp leathery wings
folded against its lean sides. From its expression, you can't tell whether it
is smiling or in pain.

8093.l: Tyr stands here, tending the bar.
8093.d:
Once a great warrior, he's now retired to "brew the perfect cask of ale", as
he puts it. The muscles stretching the arms of his tunic show he can still
break up -- or finish -- a bar fight.
8093.noise: You hear the clinking of bottles from the pub to the east.

8095.l: The Mortician, dressed all in black, stares at you knowingly.
8095.d:
Type 'Retrieve' to get your corpse back without venturing into
the wilds NAKED!

8096.l: An old guard stands watch here.
8096.d:
He is an old human, dressed in templar garb, but the heraldry on his uniform
is like none you have ever seen.  He must be a templar from an old religion
the likes of which you have never heard of.  Although he looks frail and
tired, there is still a familiar gleam in his soft green eyes.

8501.l: Boffa the cleric guildmaster is standing here patiently.
8501.d: Young, but wise enough to teach the youngest of adventurers.

8502.l: A young cleric templar is standing here.
8502.d:
He's barely old enough to shave, but you sense the protection of the
gods on him.

8503.l: A young sorcerer is standing here.
8503.d:
One of the most promising students, he has been assigned to keep out
intruders.

8504.l: Lana the mage guildmistress is eyeing you funny.
8504.d: A young lady but wise enough to teach the youngest of adventurers

8505.l: A young warrior is standing here.
8505.d:
He may be young, but the muscles rippling beneath his tunic suggest a good
fight is at hand if you try to pass unpermitted.

8506.l: Snarl the master warrior looks like he wants to hurt you.
8506.d: Young, but wise enough to teach the youngest of adventurers.

8507.l: A balding psionic in grey robes guards the mistress's chamber.
8507.d:
He stares straight forward, but you can sense his feathery probes at your 
as he continually searches you for signs of violence.

8508.l: Bon the thief guildmaster looks like she wants to steal something from you.
8508.d: Young, but wise enough to teach the youngest of adventurers.

8509.l: Muntara, the Psionic guildmistress, sits here meditating.
8509.d: She has the serene look of one who can explode your mind from the inside out.

8511.l: A small training monster doesn't look very tough.

8512.l: A training monster is here, boxing with himself.

8513.l: A large training monster looks very fierce!

8514.k: ninja guild guard guildguard men-shen man
8514.l: A large man stands here, barring your way.
8514.d:
The ninja guildguard appears to be an oversized human with a grim countenance
and golden skin.

8515.l: An old, hunched man sits on a stool here, remembering the past.
8515.d:
He looks awfully old, but as his eyes seem to search into your soul, you 
realize he's more than he looks.

8550.l: A viscious chimera snarls at you menacingly.
8550.d:
It has the head of a lion, body of a dragon and hindquarters of a goat.
Teeth the size of a dagger gleam in the faint green light from above.

8551.l: A young elven fighter stands here, looking for battle.
8551.d:
He's dressed in a simple green tunic with matching breeches. His pointy
ears and almond-shaped eyes give him away as a pure-bred elf. Beads of 
sweat drop off his brow as he looks around for his next victim.

8552.l: An enormous giant towers above your head.
8552.d:
He's a woodland giant, one of the "smaller" variety (as giants go). He's
not very intelligent, but his size more than makes up for it. He looks
like he could squash you like a bug.

8553.l: A young manticore opens its blood-caked maw and roars at you.
8553.d:
It looks like a brontosaurus with the head of a boar. Its gigantic body
is slow and bluky, but its long neck gives it a great reach.

8554.l: An ant the size of a small horse stands here, clicking its mandibles.
8554.d:
It looks like a giant ant -- a glistening red carapace with black pincers
protruding from its jaws.

8555.l: A tiger-headed Rakshasan adventurer stands here, whiskers twitching.
8555.d:
He's one of the Rakshasan race; the desert dwellers that are becoming
more and more common in the outposts of humanity.

drp.name: a pair of studded leather leggings

8556.l: A skeleton clad in rotting armor raises a blood soaked sword above its kill.
8556.d:
Dressed only in some rotting, ancient armor, it's a fearsome sight to behold;
a grinning skull with eyes burning like fire.

8557.l: A hooded cobra the length of three carts slithers silently over the field.
8557.d: It's a giant snake, with long fangs glistening in the meager light.

8558.l: A fat, lice-ridden sewer rat sits here, nibbling on some trash.
8558.d:
Its about the size of a small dog, with incisors protruding out the front
of its mouth. Its grey fur is crawling with a variety of parasites, and
watches you out of the perimeter of its vision.

9101.l: A cute little rabbit nibbles on some berries.
9101.d:
Looking at this little guy, you see his fluffy, brown fur and his tiny,
black eyes. He's pretty thin and looks hungry.

9102.l: A cute little rabbit nibbles on some berries.
9102.d:
Looking at this little gal, you see her fluffy, brown fur and her tiny,
black eyes. She's pretty thin and looks hungry.

9103.l: A squirrel is here, looking for his nuts.
9103.d:
It's a squirrel! Don't you know what a squirrel looks like? Well, that's
exactly how this squirrel looks.

9104.l: A squirrel is here, looking for her nuts.
9104.d:
It's a squirrel! Don't you know what a squirrel looks like? Well, that's
exactly how this squirrel looks.

9105.l: A black masked raccoon hides in the brush.
9105.d:
The black mask around his eyes marks this creature as the infamous raccoon
Legends say that the raccoon is a ferocious creature, wreaking havok and 
mayhem wherever it wanders. But then, legends are often wrong.

9106.l: A black masked raccoon hides in the brush.
9106.d:
The black mask around her eyes marks this creature as the infamous raccoon.
Legends say that the raccoon is a ferocious creature, wreaking havok and 
mayhem wherever it wanders. But then, legends are often wrong.

9107.l: As you approach, you startle a small deer.
9107.d:
This deer looks scared for his life! Just imagine how the poor thing feels
to see you.

9108.l: As you approach, you startle a small deer.
9108.d:
This deer looks scared for her life! Just imagine how the poor thing feels
to see you.

9109.l: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
9109.d: You see a fox, nothing else, just a fox.

9110.l: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
9110.d: You see a fox, nothing else, just a fox.

9111.l: A large grizzly bear is here, eating some fish.
9111.d: Looking at this bear, you wonder where he got his fish.

9112.l: A large grizzly bear is here, eating some fish.
9112.d: Looking at this bear, you wonder where she got her fish.

9113.d: This boar doesn't look particularly nice... Especially his razor-sharp tusks.

9114.d: This boar doesn't look particularly nice... Especially her razor-sharp tusks.

9115.l: A black wolf howls at the moon.
9115.d: Covered in black fur, this wolf looks ready to rip open someone's throat.

9116.l: A black wolf howls at the moon.
9116.d: Covered in black fur, this wolf looks ready to rip open someone's throat.

9117.l: A mountain lion plays with some yarn.
9117.d: It's good to be the king.

9118.l: A mountain lion slinks through the forest.
9118.d:
Ruddy-brown fur surrounds a feline face full of sharp teeth. She easily 
weighs over 150 pounds.

9119.l: A large, ugly beetle crawls around here.
9119.d:
It's jet black in color, except for a single patch of white that resembles a
human skull.

9120.l: A small man dances in circles here.
9120.d:
Perhaps the most striking feature of this gnome-sized race of humanoids is
their wildly flowing beards and hair, which seem to snake out in all 
directions. Their bodies are hairy, with their lower quarters being those of
a goat.

9121.l: A beautiful woman walks among the trees.
9121.d:
A nymph's beauty is beyond words--an ever-young woman with sleek figure and
long, thick hair, radiant skin and perfect teeth, full lips and gentle eyes.

9122.d: Satyr's have the torso, head, and arms of a man, and the hind legs of a goat.

9123.l: A giant skunk is here, marking his territory.
9123.d:
It's easily recognized by the long white stripe running from it's face, down
it's black-furred back, to the tip of it's tail.

9124.d:
Ettercaps are ugly bipedal creatures that get along with all types of giant
spiders.

9125.l: A leprechaun frolicks in circles here.
9125.d:
Rumored to be a cross between a species of halfling and a strong strain of
pixie, leprechauns are about 2 feet tall. He has pointed ears and his nose
ends in a tapered point.

9126.d:
The forest trapper, or miner, resembles a tailless manta ray mottle brown.
It's frontal and dorsal ridges are hard bone.

9127.l: A lumberjack is here, chopping down trees.
9127.d: He's big and mean looking, he probably only took this job to kill things.

9128.l: A long, branched vine is here.
9128.d:
It appears as a long, very thick vine with about four branches per ten-foot
section. The vine is olive green in color, and the plant stem is almost as
thick as a tree trunk.

9129.l: A large tree with rope-like appendages stands here.
9129.d:
Hangman trees are deciduous, resembling a thick oak with few branches and
sparse foliage. There are several knot-like protuberances located high on the
trunk.

9130.l: A plant that looks like it could eat a man is here.
9130.d:
It is a gigantic bush with towering stalks of purple blossoms and huge green
leaves at ground level.

9131.l: A beastman is here, camoflauged by surrounding foliage.
9131.d:
Beastmen resemble short, slender humans, except for the fine layer of dark
green fur that covers their bodies.

9132.l: A large lizard is here, walking upright.
9132.d:
This bonesnapper is about five feet tall. It's tough hide is not scaled, but
is very thick and leathery. The bonesnapper is dark green in color, enabling
it to blend in with the forest around it.

9133.l: A buckawn stands here with a puzzled look on his face.

9134.l: A quickling is here, darting around you.
9134.d:
Quicklings are small and slender beings.  They look much like miniature elves
with very sharp, feral features.  Their ears are unusually large and rise to
points above their heads.  Their eyes are cold and cruel with a tiny spark of
yellow light.

9135.l: The Jolly Green Giant is here, clubbing wildlife.

9136.l: Smokey the Bear is here, smokin' a blunt.
9136.d: Only you can prevent forest fires, man.

9137.l: The King of the Fairies prances around here.
9137.d: Winged and ethereal, this sprite looks at you from emerald green eyes.

9138.l: A tall human dressed in long green robes wanders about.
9138.d: An ancient druid. He is the most beautiful man you've ever seen.

spw.name: The Immortal Map Room for the Great Forest

9139.l: A brownie is here, climbing trees.
9139.d:
Brownies stand no more than 2' tall and are excedingly nimble. They resemble
small elves with brown hair and bright blue eyes.

9140.l: A centaur is here, relieving himself on your boots.
9140.d:
The appearance of a centaur is unmistakable: they have the upper torso, arms,
and head of a human being, and the lower body of a large, powerful horse.

9141.l: A large spider is here, spinning a web.
9141.d: It looks exactly like a giant spider, only smaller.

9142.l: A giant spider is here, spinning a web.
9142.d: It looks exactly like a large spider, only bigger.

9143.l: A sprite is here, laid back.
9143.d:
Sprites are shy and reclusive faerie people who dwell in meadows and wooded
glens. They have distinctly elven features and small, semitransparent wings.

9144.l: A pixie is here, being mischievous.
9144.d:
Pixies are elfin creatures, about two and a half feet tall. When visible,
their facial features resemble those of elves, only smaller.

9145.l: The Knight Who Says NIH! stands here.

9146.l: A gargantuan-sized insectoid creature is here.
9146.d:
The anhkheg has a chitinous shell which is brownish in color. It's underside
is pinkish. The creature's eyes are a glistening black.

9147.l: A long, golden furred animal is digging a burrow here.
9147.d:
Despite being only the size of a large badger, the aurumvorax, or "golden
gorger", is an incredibly dangerous creature. The animal is covered with 
coarse golden hair and has small silver eyes with golden pupils. It has
eight powerful legs that end in 3-inch long copper claws. The aurumvorax's
shoulders are massively muscled while its heavy jaw is full of coppery
teeth.

9148.l: The centaur leader is here, stomping the ground.
9148.d: He looks just like an ordinary centaur, only more noble.

9149.d:
He's got red hair, parcially covered by a green top-hat with a four leaf 
clover on it. He's wearing a green jacket and scarf and a blue shirt.

9150.l: A tall man strides through the forest.
9150.d: All set up to travel, this man looks like he LIKES walking?!?!?!

9151.l: Daral is here, flipping daggers into the air.
9151.d:
He looks like your average ruffian, except for his long, curly, purple hair
and bright green skin.

9152.l: An odd looking woman is walking around here with a basket of fruit on her head.
9152.d:
Wearing a slinky dress and a basket of fruit on her head, Carmen looks
ready for some "action".

9701.l: An old sailor turned salesman sits here, polishing a hull.
9701.d: He's a tall, bearded man, with tanned skin and a gold loop in one ear.

spw.name: On the Docks at the Lakeshore Tavern

9901.d:
Standing every bit of five feet tall, its three heads strain to see
every direction at once. Jaws wide enough to put your head in (but only
once) house razor sharp teeth.

9902.l: A heavy mist pulses with life.
9902.d: You see only a thick mist, which writhes as if alive.

9903.l: A shrieking demon sweeps down upon you.
9903.d:
You see a pale white, wraithly looking figure in tattered white robes.
Her skin glows slightly in the darkness. She looks rather pissed.

spw.name: A Junction in the Caverns of Hell

9904.l: A humanoid larva rolls about in anguish on the floor.
9904.d: Half man, half worm, the larva is about to hatch into something unspeakable.

9905.l: An evil looking man walks around here.
9905.d: He's bald, with the number '666' tattooed on his forehead.

9906.l: A flame-red imp scurries by on an errand for its master.
9906.d:
The imp is fire-red, with a bulbous nose and a barbed tail. Although
mischevious, it tries to stay out of your way.

9907.l: A massive demon covered in spikes and horns charges at you.
9907.d: You see a figure clothed in fire; his gaping maws licking flame.
9907.noise: The smell of burning brimstone fills your nostrils.

9908.l: A bone devil looks up from its morbid meal and stares maliciously at you.
9908.d: It looks like a living skeleton, with glowing green eyes and sharp fangs.
