9909.l: A demon rises from the depths of the lava.
9909.d:
The demon appears to be living lava; its tortured screams fill your ears
as it shrieks in pain and lust for blood.

9910.s: a demon of the first order
9910.l: A clawed demon licks his lips and smiles at you.
9910.d:
The demon looks humanoid, with several exceptions... inch long, razor sharp
claws extend from his hands, and his feet are hooved. Blood covers his mis-
shapen body.

9912.l: An extremely powerful looking devil stands here, surveying his domain.
9912.d:
He is evilly handsome, and only his small horns, tail and cloven left hoof
distinguish him from an ordinary human.
9912.noise: A wave of pure, unadulterated evil and hatred washes over you.

9913.l: A zombie is here, mindlessly awaiting orders.
9913.d:
He's your ordinary zombie, with bits of flesh beginning to fall off in chunks,
soon he'll be a skeleton.

9914.l: A beautiful, winged woman glances at you seductively.
9914.d: Her white feathered wings make her look like an angel.

9915.d: It's small, winged form is covered with sharp spines of all lengths.

9916.l: One of the fat, disgusting nupperibo stands here, looking confused.
9916.d:
The nupperibo is one of the least powerful demons, and is controlled by any
demon with an average intelligence. It's fat, bloated form jiggles and seems to
hypnotize you.

9917.l: A horned demon stalks you from behind a rock.
9917.d:
It's what you always thought a demon would look like, long horns, wings, and
a tail with a sharp barb on the end.

9918.l: a cloven footed goat-like demon wanders around here.
9918.d:
This creature has the head and legs of a goat and the torso and arms of a
human.  It is covered in a coarse fur, growing especially thick at the legs and
shoulders, and it has a tangled beard.  Its legs feature two knees apiece, the
lower set of which bend backward just above its hooves.

9919.l: A large cricket-like creature with a scorpion stinger is here looking for food.
9919.d:
As tall as a powerful warhorse, this creature looks like a gigantic locust, but
with a human-like face and a mighty segmented tail tipped with a barbed
stinger.  Sharp hooks mark the end of its six legs, and its translucent
wings pulse with ichor-filled veins.

9920.l: A massive pile of intestines floats here.
9920.d:
Floating above the ground, this creature looks like a cluster of intestines.
It has four flexible appendages, each tipped with a toothy maw.  On its
ball-like body is a single face dominated by the maniacal grin of its fifth maw.

9921.l: A massive demon stands menacingly before you.
9921.d:
Its horns, each as long as a ship's mast, shine like polished metal, while
its exposed chest has the color and appearance of human flesh.  With every
step it takes, the earth shakes.
9921.noise: The ground shakes so violently you nearly lose your footing.

9922.l: A tall, gorgeous looking man stands here with an evil grin on his face.
9922.d:
Feathery, black wings protrude from the back of this beautiful man, his body
supple and statuesque, his eyes alluring, his nails fine and sharp...

9923.l: A scantily clad, woman of unmatched beauty stands here seductivly.
9923.d:
Feathery, black wings protrude from the back of this beautiful, scantily clad
woman, her body supple and statuesque, her eyes enticing, her nails fine
and sharp...

9924.l: A massive demon covered in spikes and horns charges at you.
9924.d: You see a figure clothed in fire; his gaping maws licking flame.
9924.noise: The smell of burning brimstone fills your nostrils.

0.l: This object is BAD!  If you see it, there must be a bug in the game.  Please report it immediately using the BUG command, or tell a god if one is on.

1.l: A delicate marble fountain bubbles merrily in the sun.

2.l: A scroll lies here in the dirt.

edesc.desc:
The scroll is covered in magickal runes, which your trained eye scans to
discover it seems to be a spell of curse removal.

3.l: A bizarre arrow made of cloth lies here.

6.l: A small wooden boat lies here.

11.l: A slab of salted beef lies on the ground.

12.l: A nicely gutted fish lies here.

13.l: A nice hunk of bird leg here looks very tasty.

14.l: A nice piece of rabbit chops lies here.

15.l: A slab of barbecued ribs lies on the ground.

16.l: The head of someone lies here.

17.l: A beheaded corpse is here, spilling fresh blood.

18.l: A pile of dust lies here.

edesc.desc: It looks very old.. almost more like ancient ashes than dust.

19.s: a mangled pile of flesh and bones
19.l: A mangled pile of flesh and bones lies here.

edesc.desc: Looks like some sort of wild animal killed it's prey here.

20.l: A small puddle of liquid has been formed here.

edesc.desc:
You can't tell whether it was formed by rain, someone pouring out a liquid,
or something... relieving itself. In any case, it looks very unappealing.

21.l: An orange puddle has been made here.

edesc.desc:
It looks like something threw up. Whatever it was eating beforehand looks
even less appetizing now.

26.l: A crumbling statue stands here in a niche in the wall.

27.l: A odd-looking fish lies here, limp and slimy.

28.l: Some small game is here, attracting buzzards.

edesc.desc: This small grouse seems ideal as a one-person meal.

29.l: A dead field mouse is here, rotting away.

30.l: A brownish-looking worm is here, lying very still.

31.l: Some berries lie here, juicy and ripe.

33.l: A small quest token lies here.

40.l: A huge sword has been abandoned here

50.l: A wall of fire shoots out licks of flames and waves of heat.

51.l: A wall of ice blocks all passage.

52.s: a noxious cloud of poison gas
52.l: A noxious cloud of poison gas fills the air.

64.l: A mystical circle has been drawn on the ground here.

65.l: An ancient wicked dagger lies here.

66.l: The mighty sword Blackrazor lies here.

69.l: A really bad thing is lying here.

70.l: A potion of lycanthropy lies here.

71.l: A rare prototype object is lying here.

72.l: A large sack lies here, wonder what's in it?

74.l: A rolled up ancient looking vellum lies here.

75.l: A sinister looking double bladed axe is stuck in the ground here.

76.l: The Red Team's Flag is lying here.

77.l: The Blue Team's Flag is lying here.

78.l: A suit of grey, ghostly looking armor lies here.

79.l: An ancient, powerful glyph has been etched cleanly into the ground.

80.s: a gigantic pile of platinum coins
80.l: A giantic pile of platinum coins lies all over the room.

81.l: An earthen pot used for rituals sits on the ground here.

82.l: A tall vase used as a water clock stands here.

edesc.desc:
This tall vase has holes marked evenly into its sides, and when filled
with water at sunrise, it marks the passage of time.

83.l: A slender instrument made from animal bones lies here.

edesc.desc:
This flute has been ornately carved, and appears to be made from the
bones of some animal.

84.l: A large red ceremonial candle stands here.

90.l: A dusty red-covered book sits on the ground.

edesc.desc:
The book looks as old as creation itself and its pages are completely blank
except for one:

"...and he shall return to our fair land, the harbringer of death, destroyer
of all within his path. Known throughout the ages as the Devourer, his true
name is the secret to his control. When the moon is full, Senyakhaz will
come if summoned...

The remainder of the page crumbles before you can read further.
Eh?

91.l: A smouldering meteorite lies half-buried in the ground.

edesc.desc:
It glows softly with residual heat from its heavenly passage. It's made of
a mineral you have never seen before and appears to be impervious to any
form of damage. You wonder what it could contain...

edesc.desc:

93.l: There is the corpse of an orc here, recently deceased.

edesc.desc:
Perhaps it was the impact or perhaps the heat, but this orc probably didn't
know what hit it. There are a series of footprints leading away from the
corpse to the north and track marks as if something were dragged.

94.l: A piece of a strange looking mineral sits here.

edesc.desc:
It is rough with jagged edges, obviously having survived its travels through
space and time to reach you. It glows softly in your hand and you wonder

edesc.desc:
It glows softly and has been made using only the finest and purest of

96.k: hefty leather bound book keep stone
96.l: A hefty leather-bound book, covered in dust, has been left here.

edesc.keywords: hefty leather bound book keep stone
edesc.desc:
The book is more a journal than anything else. You skim through it and the
only page of note reads as follows:

"During the daemonic wars of Vymornia, a sanctuary was built high within
the mountains where the mages of the land could develop some form of defense
against the foul beasts. Hidden from the eye of the common man, Stonekeep
was born and although many have sought the secrets it contains, few have
returned to speak of it.

Many years have passed and the land is at peace. The acolytes of the keep
have not been seen for some time and the only evidence that they still
practice their arts is the occassional streak of fire across the sky."

..."and the creator of all, the Master of the Elements, shall return to
this physical plane"...

The rest is garbled and you can't make it out. Other sections of the book
reference a plane of elements yet no detail is given.

edesc.desc:
Although I am loathe to give you what you want and betray Nimos' trust in me,
it is for the good of my race. Keep in mind that Lady Amber would have better
instructions, for she has done it herself, but I was only guided and even then
was blindfolded. Should you still wish to enter the Citadel despite my warnings
note that it is well protected and has many dead ends, labrynths and endless
corridors. Follow the instructions I give here to the letter, lest your dark
soul be in peril.
First, the Citadel itself is accessable only through a pair of great iron doors
which cannot be opened by any means known to man save with the following
incantation, 'Hovas Nar. Kandra Mil. Volas Nar. Hilasha Mil. Dhrovik!'
These words cause the doors to open. As soon as you enter the Citadel, care
must be taken to say the following word, 'Nyphar' If this word is not 
pronounced upon entry into the Citadel, the place's guards will magically
appear.

The Paths of the Doomed are what leads to Nimos' mansion. They are labyrinthine
and confusing, their exact layout uncertain to me as I was always blindfolded
and sometimes magically incapacitated while we traveled there and I can only
pass on a few of the things which I experienced.
Throughout the maze strange voices jabbered and alien words were given tongue.
In many places I heard the words, barely recognizable, 'In whose name do you
come here?' or 'By what god do you swear?' In most cases the answer was by
fire (or water or earth depending upon the location in the labyrinth), I come
in the name of Nimos. The god worshiped was Nevyn.

In a chamber filled with the sound of rushing water, I heard the word, 
'thralliq' then the word 'ekkala' Later, in a room that was so hot and stifling
as to be barely habitable, I heart Nimos shout 'khalos' on one occasion and
'olash' soon after. In a room that seemed to be composed of fire I heard,
'Hala vill thora' and the flames ceased to caress my skin. Other phrases and
counter phrases are lost now, swpt away by the memory of the horror which lurks
beyond the Devouring Portal and all the monstrous acts to which I was 
compelled.
This is all I can remember. Again I warn against visiting this cursed place,
but perhaps my description will provide some assistance, already I feel the
weight of the rebirth of my race upon my shoulders.
There is a FIRST page, a SECOND page, and a THIRD page...

14431.l: A book labeled, 'The Battle of Lost Souls' lies here.

edesc.desc:
The Battle of Lost Souls was a great war fought between the evil Gil-Glash's
armies and the armies of the now dead Lothar, who in his time was a very
powerful warrior. Now, no one knows why the battle was started except perhaps
Gil-Glash, who after three centuries still lives, but most think Lothar finally
grew tired of Gil-Glash's reign of tyranny and wanted to put an end to it. But
what is in the past stays in the past, that is not true when dealing with the
battleground the Battle of Lost Souls was fought on, for everywhere lies the
stench of death and travellers that have wandered through tell stories of
great horrors that come out of the earth, pursuing them until they leave the
battleground.

14436.s: the Isle of the Necromancer Kings
14436.l: A book about the Isle of the Necromancer Kings is here.

edesc.desc:
Thus Sumulael and I raised up the inhabitants of Toal from their crypts and
tombs to serve us. We lived there like exiled royalty for many years, until my
husband's insanity and revolting habits grew intolerable. I ended up killing
the monster, eventually with the help of adventurers who had discovered the
secluded city in the wilderness. That is how I met my second husband, Talib.
He was one of the explorers who assisted me in destroying Sumulael and helped
me find my long-sought talisman.

I soon came to love Talib, after a fashion. I taught him all of my hidden
secrets. We were happy together in Toal, rebuilding the city to its former
glory. But in the end, that marriage also failed, for I found that you cannot
practice the Art when you are happy, nor advance in its study if you are
content. So I left behind my beloved, to write this book in solitude and focus
my mind on the difficult road ahead.

At first, when my husband and I beheld the bones of the city's former citizens,
we amused ourselves by raising the moldering remains to attend us as ghastly
servants, skeletal porters, and shadowy messengers. When the quest for the
talisman yielded nothing immediately, we animated more of the city's dead to
expand the search. Before long, our new slaves uncovered royal cemeteries
where the kings and queens of Toal had been buried for centuries before the
city's disastrous end. I remember quite vividly my delight at this discovery.
With a wave of my hand, I cracked open the tombs' monolithic stone doors, while
Sumulael, cackling with wicked glee, called forth the city's ancient royalty,
commanding even the oldest of padishahs to stumble forth, wrapped in their
worm-eaten shrouds or burial robes, from the corrupted depths of the crypts
and into our eternal slavery. And while the dead gave up their age-corrupted
treasures, none carried my coveted talisman.

The ruins of Toal were cloaked by the jungle when I rediscovered the broken
city walls with my first husband, Sumulael. That was in the early years of our
marriage, when my devotion to the Forbidden Arts ran strong with the careless
impetuousness of youth. We had been led to the city by disgruntled spirits, in
search of a legendary talisman. Even with our ghostly guides, the ruins of the
vine-choked city were extensive, and the exact location of our prize eluded us.

Thus the age-old conflict between king and high-priest began again in Uruk,
transplanted from the mainland by its colonists, and it sprang forth anew with
all the vehemence of old. As it destroyed the Old Dynasty, so too did it
unravel the Necromancer Kings. The New Dynasty eventually withered and died,
leaving only mournful spirits to glide over the still black waters by the ruins
of Nycopolis. Now only their histories and their mysterious artifacts remain
as sad, silent testimonies to their former power and glory.

The worship of this forgotten god, known as the Cult of Worms, soon flourished
again under an ambitious priestess named Yola, one of the first nobles to
accompany Ysawis into exile on Uruk. But the King was jealous of Yola's
mounting influence, and he conspired with his most powerful nobles to destroy
her. Yola disappeared soon after from Nycopolis. When she did, the Cult of
Worms floundered without her direction, and Ysawis reigned supreme once again
in his mighty new kingdom of necromancers.

Now, Uruk was not entirely uninhabited when Ysawis founded the New Dynasty. The
colonists found the traces of an even more ancient civilization on the island,
based on the low, sandy shores. They discovered entire ruined cities of antique
metal towers, sundered and dilapidated, lapped along the coast by the hungry
sea. In these mushroom-shaped spires, exotic totems and strange shrines were
unearthed, temples of some forgotten god called the King of Worms, and Lord
over Life and Undeath. Many of the New Dynasty began to worship this ancient
god whose first followers had long since abandoned Uruk to live forever beneath
the cold waves of the sea (or so the ancient legends say).

Long ago, when the Old Dynasty began to fail on the mainland, Ysawis Ligat was
exiled with a whole cadre of his supporters for practicing deviant and
forbidden magic. Ysawis departed the jungle valleys of his youth in search of
a new home. He crossed the sea and discovered Uruk, a large island of 
mysterious beauty that resembled, in many respects, his beloved homeland.

The island was divided into a low-lying coastal region, an inner high plateau
embraced by jungle, and a high ridge of mountains rising from the center of the
island like the spine of a vishap. On the high plateau, by the shores of a
sepia lake, Ysawis built Nycopolis and made his city the capital of a new
monarchy. He built the Great Summer Palace out of solid ivory and erected a
mighty Colossus in his image to guide visitors safely to his island. Ysawis was
the first and most powerful of the Necromancer Kings, and he ruled Uruk, some
say wisely, for many hundreds of years.

edesc.desc: There looks to be about 100 coins in total scattered around here.

15806.l: A heavy leather-bound book lies open before you.

Flicking through the pages, you begin to feel sick at some of the things
this book contains. It contains a number of spells, most of them so powerful
they were long ago banned by the magic users of the land. However, someone
here is still using them and you have every right to be afraid. Each of the
spells within the book uses live components, body parts from all manner of
creatures.

15807.l: A strange dagger impales the ground before you.

edesc.desc: It has a snake-like blade and a gold handle.

15808.l: An ornate looking ring has been left nearby.

The ring is completely covered with arcane inscriptionsand glows with a
magical light.

15809.l: A pair of thin, black-laced boots lies abandoned here.

edesc.desc: The boots are soft-soled and seem ideal for sneaking and hunting.

They are calf-high boots of a thick polished black leather. An incredible
pain to take on and off due to the fact that they are laced all the way
from the top of the foot to the top of the boot. There appears to be 
something written on the bottom.

15810.l: A serpentine key lies in the dust.

edesc.desc: It twists and turns in a snake-like manner...it must fit a strange lock.

15811.l: A large pile of gold fills the inside of the chest!

edesc.desc: There are many, many golden imperials.

15812.l: A small, clear, thin vial filled with a pale yellow liquid rests here.

edesc.desc:
You have no idea what this is. Is it a potion? A posion? A simple tonic?
Risking a small taste, you decide it looks nothing like it tastes, for
it has a strong peppery taste! Now where did that glass of water go ...

15813.l: A small chest made of hardwood and banded in mithril sits here.

edesc.desc:
It looks very valuable, yet despite its small size you don't seem able to
budge it from the table.

15814.l: A small, shiny golden key lies here.

edesc.desc: It looks like real gold!

15815.l: An ornate medallion on a heavy gold chain has been placed here.

edesc.desc:
A large sunburst of gold, the amulet feels heavy about your neck, comforting
and reassuring you. The chain is also gold and is comprised of heavy links.

15816.l: A wicked looking sabre lies here.

edesc.desc: It gleams in the light and appears to be quite sharp.

15817.l: A spiked wrist-guard is lying here.

edesc.desc: A leather band surrounded by silver spikes.

15818.l: A golden rose shines beautifully here.

edesc.desc: Exquisitely beautiful, it would surely win the heart of any maiden.

15819.l: A modified halberd lies on the ground, ready for use.

edesc.desc:
The only difference between this weapon and the standard halberd is the
set of spikes that surround the spear-like tip, providing extra damage.

15820.l: A dented platemail vest lies gleaming on the ground.

15821.l: A large, leather stock whip has been coiled up here.

15822.l: A glowing orb floats in the center of the room.

15825.l: A blue potion has been carelessly left here.

15850.l: A silverish ring lies here unused.

edesc.desc: A simple electrum band, engraved with gruesome images depicting sacrifice.

16000.l: A titan's mit is lying here.

edesc.desc:
This large glove is rather bulky and it's doubtful whether your hand can
fit inside it's spacious interior.  The glove has heavily padded segments
to help facilitate free movement of a hand much larger than your own.  Gems
e sparsely embedded on the exterior of the glove, and although you can see
the gems, strangely enough, you can't feel them, much less remove them...

16001.l: A roc feather is lying here.

edesc.desc:
A feather of a huge bird.   This feather is easily the size of a sword
and has some heft to it which is strange for a feather.

16002.l: A climber's hook is lying here.

edesc.desc:
An old hook used for grappling and climbing.  The hook's surface is
spotted with small circles of rust from over-exposure to the thin, damp air
of the mountains.

16003.l: A dragonne's scale is lying here.

edesc.desc:
A bronze shimmering scale from some exotic beast.  Light plays across it's
surface with a prism-like brilliance.

This small, red mushroom has a sweet smell to it.  You have a feeling
that this mushroom is indiginous to these mountains, and with that in
consideration, they could have a strange effect on whoever eats them...

16005.l: A climber's pack is lying here.

edesc.desc:
For all intents and purposes, this climber's pack appears normal.  A fine
layer of dust has accumulated on the pack, and suggests that the original
owner has forgotten all about it.

16006.l: A stone club is lying here.

16007.l: A green mushroom is growing here.

edesc.desc:
This brilliant green mushroom is very exotic looking.  You wager a guess
that this fungus is indiginous to the mountians, and with that in mind,
they could have strange effects on whoever eats them.

16008.s: a withered, dried out husk of a corpse
16008.l: A dried out husk of a corpse is lying here.

edesc.desc:
Upon closer inspection of this gruesome cadaver, you find that the former
humanoid that should have some heft to it's corpse is rather light, due to
it's insides being sucked dry and leaving the skin dry, wrinkled, cracked,
and leather-like.  Eye sockets holding withered milky looking eyes trap an
immortal look of preternatural horror on the face of this unfortunate
individual.  As the body is moved, you can actually hear it's bones rattling
loosely inside the withered mummified skin.

16100.l: A lightning trident is lying here.

edesc.desc:
You are gazing upon a trident wrapped in a mystical lightning that
cascades all over the surface of the weapon.  The trident's forward barbed
blades glow with a peaceful otherworldly light.

16101.l: A shimmering staff of light is lying here.

edesc.desc:
At first, you think this is a beam of light, and look around for the light's
source, and seeing none, realize that this is an item of light, that glows
with an ethereal brightness.  All manner of evil seem to shrink away from 
this extraordinary item made for the defenders of good and righteousness...

16102.l: A blue-bladed axe is lying here.

edesc.desc:
A double-bladed battle axe.  The axe's blade is made from some otherworldly
blue metal, with serpentine designs etched across the blade's face, and 
spiralling down the axe's shaft toward the handle.  The handle itself seems
to have a grip and heft just right for you, which you find to be rather odd,
considering the immensity of the blade.

16103.l: An ethereal fireball is suspended in the air here.

edesc.desc:
A blue flame in a semi-spherical shape hovers in the air here.  Despite
the color of the flame, it casts white light enough with which to see by.

16104.l: A phoenix feather is lying here.

edesc.desc:
A brilliantly colored feather that ranges in color from bright yellow at 
the root, to a deep crimson towards the end.  The feather appears as if it
is aflame, yet what's odd is, it just might be...

16105.l: A glowing headband is lying here.

edesc.desc:
A beautiful metal band designed to be worn about the head, with intricate
carvings of rather regal looking dragons decorating the sides of the band.
The metal resembles gold, yet glows with a pale, warm light.

16106.l: A pair of winged sandals are levitating here.

edesc.desc:
This pair of sandals would normally look like any common place sandals, if
it weren't for the small, feathery wings protruding from the ankles.  As you
get closer to the sandals, you notice the wings start to slowly flap up and
down, almost as if in anticipation...

16107.l: A white loincloth is lying here.

edesc.desc:
A pure white length of cloth in pristine condition that is worn around the
waist, and hangs down over the wearer's legs in front and back, exposing the
legs so as not to hinder movement.  The design of a golden dragon is sewn
onto the front of the cloth, and is surrounded by a golden trim border.

16108.l: A glowing bracelet is lying here.

edesc.desc:
A bracelet of a strange metal, the likes of which you've never seen before.
The light striking it's surface makes the bracelet glitter with light and
glow as it alive.  Intricate patterns of valiant dragons are sculpted on the
side of the bracelet.

16109.l: A white cape is lying here.

edesc.desc:
A pure white cape in pristine condition.  The perfect condition and
workmanship of this cape belittle how old it must really be.

16110.l: A gold apple is lying here.

edesc.desc:
This extraordinary fruit is made of a solid organic gold.  While it may
not be very edible, it is very wonderous to gaze upon.  You begin to recall
legends of a treasure of judgement and balance, which while it could bestow
great wealth, it came with a penalty of greed and suffering.  Could this be
that forbidden treasure?

16111.l: A pair of spiffy pants are lying here.

edesc.desc: Woah!!! Pants!!!

16112.l: A golden lance is lying here.

edesc.desc:
You are staring upon an exquisite lance, obviously made by a very skilled
craftsmen.  You even doubt it was crafted, possibly made by a divine being.
Light sparkles all over the surface, and refracts in all different 
directions.  For such a large weapon, it is strangely easy enough to use,
and is very balanced.

16113.l: A pixie's dagger is lying here.

edesc.desc:
A tiny blade designed for the hands of the wee folk of the pixie.  Very
odd for you to wield, it is however usable...

16114.l: A yellow colored scroll is lying here.

edesc.desc: A yellow colored paper, neatly rolled up into a scroll.

16115.l: A crystal fountain is here bubbling merrily.

edesc.desc:
Light sparkles across the fountain with golden details.  Even the cool
water bubbling from the fountain has a golden hue to it.  Exquisite flowered
vines grow up the sides of the fountain adding to it's graceful appearance.
A bright red apple.

16117.l: A strange exotic fruit is lying here.

edesc.desc:
Mutiple colored, this strange fruit is supposedly edible, but is so 
appealing that you almost want to keep it instead of eat it.  A thick, sweet
syrup runs down the side of the rainbow colored fruit, making you hungry.

16118.l: A small vine covered with grapes is lying here.

edesc.desc: A small vine covered in large, juicy, bright green grapes.
A brightly colored orange.

16120.l: A green colored scroll is lying here.

edesc.desc: A green colored paper, neatly rolled up into a scroll.

16121.l: A blue scroll is lying here.

edesc.desc: A blue colored paper, rolled neatly into a scroll.

16122.l: An orange scroll is lying here.

edesc.desc: An orange colored paper rolled neatly into a scroll.
A beautiful, crimson red ruby with sparkling facets.
A vivid green colored gem, the emerald is truly a precious gem.
A brightly colored blue gem of exquisite beauty.

A pristine diamond.  Light reflects from all different angles from this
attractive gem.

16127.l: An onyx crystal is lying here.

edesc.desc: An opaque black crystal of mysterious beauty.

16128.l: A dragon-shaped key is lying here.

edesc.desc:
A white gold key with the head of a marvelous dragon forming the handle,
scales wrapping around the shaft of the key and forming the prongs which
unlock what must be an important door somewhere...

16129.s: a mountain of gold and gems
16129.l: A mountain of gold and gems is lying here.

edesc.desc:
A huge hoard of gold and gems which are of value far beyond what you could
imagine.  The gold seems melted together somewhat, either by extreme heat,
or by the immense weight of bahamut as this is his bed.  Gems sparkle in the
light, encased in a tomb of gold forever.

16130.l: An old chest is lying here.

edesc.desc:
An old, yet sturdy chest of an unknown make, with an emblem of a dragon
emblazoned on it's clasp.

16131.l: A red scroll is lying here.

edesc.desc: A colored paper rolled eatly into a scroll.
A bright yellow banana.

A cool green colored pear with a small stem protruding from the top of it's
bell shape.

16134.l: A leafy fruit is lying here.

edesc.desc: Small, mint shaped leaves envelop this blue colored fruit with a tangy nectar.

16135.l: A juice filled fruit is lying here.

edesc.desc:
A plump, round purple colored fruit filled with a lightly sweet juice under
a thin peel.

16136.l: A bubbling black flask is lying here.

edesc.desc: A flask of some kind of mysterious bubbling syrupy black liquid.

16137.l: A multi colored flask is lying here.

edesc.desc:
A flask of some strange liquid which changes into various colors n wavy
patterns.

16138.l: A glittering flask is lying here.

edesc.desc: A flask of a clear liquid which glitters wherever light strikes it.

16139.l: A smoking fire red flask is lying here.

edesc.desc:
A thick red liquid the color of flame.  Smoke eminates from the strange
fluid.

16140.l: A placid blue flask is lying here.

edesc.desc: A flask of a smooth, blue liquid.

16141.l: A wavy orange flask is lying here.

edesc.desc:
A flask of an orange fluid which waves back and forth like an ocean wave.
Even at rest, the liquid still moves back and forth.

16200.l: A nasty little black dagger is lying here.

edesc.desc:
This small nasty knife has a slight curve in it eight inch dark metal
blade, likely for gutting sacrifices to what ever evil gods it's former
user served

16201.l: A nasty little spear with a sharp barb on the tip is lying here

edesc.desc:
It's about 4 feet long and a little under an inch thick, leather hand
grips are wrapped around it in two places.  There is a nasty little barb
on the six inch black metal tip.

16202.l: Some little bloody green legs are lying here.

16203.l: A dead stinking spike-covered vine is lying here.

edesc.desc:
It's about three feet long and about as thick as your wrist
with nasty cone-shaped spikes covering its' surface.

mobs.name: a wriggling mass of carnivorous vines

16204.l: The decayed skeleton of some unlucky adventurer is here impaled on a spear.

edesc.desc: Looks like he wasn't as lucky as you on his way down.

16205.l: A thick ebony short bow is lying here.

16206.l: A nasty little black arrow is lying here.

edesc.desc: It's a small black arrow with dark green fletching and a barbed tip.

16207.l: A small rotting leather belt is lying here.

16208.l: A smelly half rotten black fur cloak has been left here.

16214.l: A small sword is lying here.

16215.l: A rusty set of armor has been left here.

16217.l: A small fire is burning here.

16218.l: A large pot bubbles in the fire pit.

It's a large heavy cast iron cook pot.  Disgusting brown liquid with
large hunks of flesh and bones is boiling inside it.

16219.l: A tiny golden object is lying here.

It looks like something just broke it off a corpse, the flesh is ragged
and torn. The large nasty claws are extended from the rotten paw.

16222.l: A stone headed axe is lying here.

It's basically a sharp flat stone tied to the end of a short pole with
strips of leather and sinew.

16223.l: A small wooden shield is lying here.

16224.l: A wolf hide skirt is lying here.

16225.l: The decapitated head of a wolf is lying here.

It looks like something just ripped the head off and hollowed it out, the
jaws have been pulled all the way apart and tided with a few stings
of sinew allowing the wearer to see but still have some face protection.

16226.l: A black wooden club with a large iron spike in the end is lying here.

16227.l: A flickering torch is mounted on the wall here.

rms.name: A Guard Post in the Passage

The blade of this large axe is made of a strange deep red metal which
vibrates slightly when you touch it. The haft is made of dark ebony
hardwood with a six or seven inch spike at the base. Inscribed across
the wide crimson blade are several magic rune and symbols.

16241.l: A human leg torn off at the knee is lying here.

16250.l: A disgusting pile of rotten flesh is lying here.

edesc.desc:
It's a stinking cloak of skin cut from an elf. Various runes and glyphs
likely representing rituals and sacrifice to malevolent gods are sewn
and branded across it in several places.  Along the edge of the hood
are what appear to be small half scaleish pieces of skin, closer
investigation reveal that they are jagged cut ears.

16290.l: A small wooden sign is nailed to a tree here.

edesc.desc:
Bevare, oh ye os little experience; bevare, too
		ye os mvch might, for the forces vithin are not
		meant for svch.

16295.l: A emerald cape with big amber spots is lying here.

16300.l: A small wooden desk covered with guard applications sites against the wall here.

edesc.desc:
The desk is covered with forms and memoranda from the Church, as well as
a stack of guard service applications.  Completing training in this facility
is almost a guarentee of acceptance into the ranks of the Holy Guard.

16302.l: A dirty old straw hat is lying here.

16403.l: A heavy skin lies here, crumpled in a heap.

16404.l: A big black eyeball is lying here, staring coldly at you...

16405.l: A small spring is bubbling in the ground here.

This is a clear freshwater spring, it looks like it would quench your thirst

16408.l: A severed tail lies here, with a boney club at the end.

This is a large long tail of the ankylosaur, it is about 3 feet long with a
large boney ball at the end.

16409.l: A small green skin with lots of tiny thorns sticks to your boot as you walk by.

edesc.desc:
these boots are crafted from a small lizard skin, impregnated with lots of
tiny white thorns which help you get trackion on teh round ground.

16410.l: A tiny white thorn has been carelessly left here.

this is a tiny thorn torn from the body of a moloch lizard, it is slightly
curves and is very sharp at the end.

16411.l: A suit of armor made from dinosaur plates is resting in the grass.

edesc.desc:
this armor was made from the scale of a great dinosaur, they are green with
little blue flecks in the scales. You hope the beast that this armor came from
does not come back to retrieve it.

16412.l: Some crude leggings made form a reptile lie here.

edesc.desc:
these leggings look as if they were made from many layers of reptile skin
all glued together into 1 hard piece of armor.

You see a large stone statue of John F. Kennedy, the United States's 35th
President.

18002.l: A golden medallion is lying here looking shiny and pretty.

18005.l: A jigger of whiskey is lying here.

18007.l: A pint of Guinness is lying here...how wasteful.

To use, type "BALANCE", "WITHDRAW x", or "DEPOSIT x".  Please report any
strange occurrences to the bank manager.

18225.s: a pair of scale mail gloves

It is a 5'-long weapon, consisting of a convex blade on one end and a

It is about 5'3" tall, with 2'6" of that length a wicked curved blade, the

It is an heavy iron rod resembling an elephant goad. It's about 2' long, with
a point at one end. About 1/3 of the way from the top lies a curved blade
on one side.

18263.l: A halberd of oriental design lies in the dust here.

edesc.desc:
It looks like a spear with two crescent moon-shaped blades set just below
the spearhead.

18264.l: A savage looking sword lies here on the ground.

edesc.desc:
It is a straight, double-edged blade, with a forward curving hook on one end 
and a butt-spike protruding from the hilt. A bladed crescent moon-shaped guard  
for the hand gives it a savage look.

18265.l: An oriental broadsword lies on the ground here.

18266.l: A simple, well-worn staff is lying here.

18267.l: A shiny brass key of intricate design.

18268.l: An ancient helm of dwarven design rests here.

18300.l: A red book lies on the table here.

edesc.desc:
The Diary of Orodreth the Mage 
The diary mentions Orodreth's addiction to games and puzzles, and his attempts 
to make them life-size. Evidently the black portal here leads to a large 
labyrinth, and the red one leads to a huge checkboard.  Recalling past rumors, 
you remember that after Orodreth found the secret to immortality, his creations 
became infested with evil creatures and warped sentinence.

18301.l: A large, gold colored, solid feather has been left here.

edesc.desc: This is a large feather shaped object that is solid and very pretty.

18302.l: A checkered cape has been tossed here.

18303.l: A checkered shield has been dropped here.

18304.l: A smallish looking bag is lying here.

18305.l: A single red rose is resting here.

18307.s: a pair of rose colored glasses
18307.l: A pair of rose colored glasses sits, folded up, here.

edesc.desc:
As you peer upon the gold rims and the faint red glass plates that they
hold you remember a long forgotten story about a god who would only look
at the world through rose colored glassed.  Maybe these are those same
glasses?

18308.s: a pair of black, leather boots
18308.l: A pair of black, leather boots with silver insets is here.

18309.l: A pair of slightly dusty black pant is here.

edesc.desc:
They are slightly dusty and well used, as if worn on a long journey, but
are amazingly resilient.

18310.l: A sharp sword with a long blade and bone handle is lying here.

18311.l: A clean, pressed white tunic is here.

18312.l: A black, leather duster is crumpled up here.

18313.l: A powerful rune stone hovers slightly off the ground here.

edesc.desc:
This is the fabled Rune Stone of Orodreth.  Legends claim that this small
piece of glowing rock bestows the blessings of the god Orodreth upon the
bearer. The stone is small, fitting in the palm of your hand- but is
very heavy.  Indecipherable symbols are ornately carved onto the stone.

18314.l: A small stone piece in the shape of a khanda is here.

edesc.desc:
It is an ornate shape consisting of four symbolic weapons.  In the center is
a double edged sword from which the symbol derives its name.  Surrounding that
is a circular quoit.  On either side there are crossed kirpans, or daggers.

18315.l: A wide brimed, black cash hat is here.

edesc.desc:
This wide brimed cash hat is made of smooth fur felt.  It has a black
leather band around the crown.  Time itself has worn upon it, but the
material and craftsmanship have allowed it to stand up amazingly well.

18600.l: Great ram-like horns are lying on the ground.

18601.l: A sickle-shaped claw is lying on the ground.

edesc.desc:
A long sickle or crescent shaped claw. It looks like it came from something
big.

18613.l: A stone lies on the ground.

18615.l: The claw of some creature lies here.

18650.l: Something odd lies on the ground here.

18701.l: A small cow bell is on the ground here.

edesc.desc:
This is a minature version of a normal cow bell.  It has a leather strap for
hanging about a neck.

18702.l: An ender spear is stuck in the ground here.

edesc.desc:
This is a small spear, but it is just as deadly sharp as any of its bigger
cousins.

18703.l: An ender staff is just lying here.

edesc.desc:
This staff is carved to have the perfect balance to be used as a weapon.  It is
a little smaller than a normal staff, but it is quite usable.

18704.l: An ender sword is here gleaming in the light.

edesc.desc: This little sword is polished to a mirror reflection and is razor sharp.

18705.l: The ender king's sceptre is unceremoniously lying on the ground here.

edesc.desc:
This is a staff that can be used to guide your way, it seems like it may even 
be more than that.

18706.l: The ender queen's jewel has been tossed here.

edesc.desc:
This is a simple-looking jewel that the ender queen usually keeps close to
her heart.  You begin to wonder if someone is looking for it.

18707.l: An ender dirk is stuck in a piece of wood here.

edesc.desc:
This is a slender-bladed weapon.  It is quite small in size and is razor sharp,
ideal for piercing the flesh of an opponent.

18708.l: A small ender knife is here.

edesc.desc: This is a small knife that is very sharp.

18709.l: An ender's pouch is sitting on the ground here.

edesc.desc:
This is a small pouch with a deep bottom, you wonder how much you can actually
fit in such a small pouch.

18710.l: A little ender ball is on the ground here.

edesc.desc: This is a simple ball that all kids seem to like to play with.

18711.l: An ender pie is cooling here.

edesc.desc: This is a meat based pie that looks quite tasty.
This is a sweet cake, that is quite small but looks very appetizing.

18713.l: An ender smithy's hammer is resting here.

edesc.desc: This is strong but small hammer that has been well used to pound metal.

18714.l: An ender tailor's sewing kit is here.

edesc.desc: This is a tiny little sewing kit.  How can anyone use needles that small?

18715.l: A small fountain is floating just above the ground here.

edesc.desc:
This is some kind of magical fountain.  It probably should not be here, who
knows where it originally came from.

18716.l: A simple silver key is lying on the ground here.

edesc.desc: This key is small but sturdy, you wonder what it opens...

18717.l: A small rusty key is lying half hidden in the dirt here.

18718.l: A large wooden chest is here.

18719.l: A huge pile of gold coins is here.

18826.l: A pair of full plate greaves lies here.

18838.l: The Paultinian fountain's clear water tempts your parched throat.

19100.l: A spork of mighty salad-tossing is lying here.

edesc.desc:
This is a weapon wearas the wielder of it is the most fiercesome person
to ever step foot in a kitchen...

19101.l: The sword of the Damned lies here.

edesc.desc:
The sword gives off an evil radiance of blackflame.  The hilt has intricate
carvings of skulls and other such skeletal forms all over it.

This odd looking serpent scale is like nothing you've ever seen before.
You have your doubts about it, but one thing is for sure, it's not of
this world...
North...

19104.l: A loaf of molded bread rots here.

edesc.desc: Hmmm, should you eat this?  They always say a little mold won't hurt ya..

19105.l: A crimson knife is lying here.

edesc.desc:
This knife has permanent blood stains all over it, and drips a shadow of
old blood that has been shed by it's owner.  The blade is a 
blackish crimson in color and gives you the creeps.

These old-looking binoculars seem to exude a strange coldness.  Rust flakes
away in small chips as you look more closely at them.  They hardly seem
worth carrying around...

19107.l: A dark colored feather lies on the ground here.

edesc.desc:
This drab looking feather seems to emanate a ghostly cool light by some
unknown means.

This old eyepatch has seen many years of use, perhaps too many.  The
patch looks like it's falling apart at the seams.

19111.l: A strange looking shadow lies here.

edesc.desc:
This very odd shadow seems to defy the very laws of physics, and appears
to be something that can be worn.  The mere touch of it sends chills up
and down your spine.

19112.l: A pair of old spectacles are lying here.

edesc.desc:
You hold in your hand a pair of glasses that appear to be a miracle in
and of itself in that it is still in one piece.  Quite stylish, about a 
couple hundred odd years or so ago...

19113.l: A rusty disc of metal lies here.

edesc.desc:
This ancient looking shield is past it's prime.  Rust has worn small
holes here and there across the shield's surface.

19114.l: A pair of dusty pants lie here.

edesc.desc:
This pair of pants is coated with a thick layer of dust.  No amount of 
cleaning will change that.  Careful, something this old might fall apart.

19115.l: A small ring lies discarded here.

edesc.desc:
This small, odd looking ring has various abstract forms carved into it
by a master jeweler.  The carvings instill various feelings in you, is
it a matter of art appreciation or something more?

19116.l: A broken bottle is lying here.

edesc.desc:
This broken bottle has several nasty looking jagged edges about the
end opposite the neck where you hold it.  In a pinch, it could serve
as a weapon of desperation.
An old key.
A small, rusted, common key.

Some chunks and handles of the wheel are missing, and the wheel itself does
not move for you.

19120.l: Someone has left their journal here.

edesc.desc:
It seems to be the journal of an old explorer, you find an interesting
passage:

I have many times heard tales of the legendary Ghost Ship that occasionally
docks in the port cities of Alaozar and Xixieqi. Tonight I shall finally see
if those rumors are true, I shall stake out at the docks north of Alaozar and
try to come aboard the apparition, for I have heard there are hordes of jewels
and artifacts inside the ship's hold. I shall leave this journal with my
friend, who shall warn the populace of the threat that comes so close to home.
                                                   Twick Elmdaerle

19121.l: An old chest is lying here.

edesc.desc:
An ancient looking chest that is a wonder that it is still in one piece much
less operable.

19122.l: A shadowy looking key is lying here.

edesc.desc:
A small, nondescript key that resembles a shadow.  Oddly enough, it is a 
shadow that is tangible, and that you can pick up.

19400.l: A sword lies here on the ground smoldering with flames.

19401.l: A small red gem lies here glittering brilliantly.

19402.l: A lovely blaze red rose lies here.

19406.l: Someone left thier backpack on the ground here.

19413.l: A long chain with weights at both ends lies here in a pile.

edesc.desc:
A small campfire burns brightly, illuminating the entire cave with a warm

19602.s: the statue of the Goddess Nat
19602.l: A statue of the most beautiful woman you have ever seen stands here.

edesc.desc:
The statue is an interpretation of the Goddess Nat. Due to its holy
magnificence, you are unable to determine the material from which it has been
made. She is dressed in nothing but a flowing white robe, her lithe figure
outlined in its silky material. Her long brown hair lies lazily down her back.
She is the quintessence of perfection - she holds in one hand a broken sword
representing peace and in the other hand, three smaller statues.

One is a divine figure dressed in white, wielding a sacred sword with the
writings of Nat inscribed along its shimmering blade. Another, its counterpart,
is dressed in black and wields a long thin blade which appears to be as cold
as ice. The third portrays a younger character whose leather whip drapes at
his side as he looks at you with the eyes of youthful experience and
compassion.

well, providing quality refreshment to the birds and the friars.

On closer inspection, you realise it has been made from the spines of male
humans - there is a simple plaque at its base which reads "Hail to our Queen
Whistler". Carved in neat script at the bottom corner of the plaque are the

edesc.desc:
This once cursed monster ruled the seas, from the far east oceans of Zepcaca
to the west of Fentero. Led by Sidious, a crew of Titans vanquished the
powerful creature.

After such a fierce battle, only a few dozen remained standing, their comrades
slain. The corpse of the foul beast was buried within a deep cave never to
be seen again.

It wasn't until 10 years later that the Titans began building a magnificient
castle within this damned, hellish cave.
