but effective weapon.

2519.l: A small hardwood chest sits on the ground.

2520.l: A large hammer, slightly rusty and old, lies heavily on the ground.

edesc.desc:
The hammer is actually the striking piece from a large bell but is well
suited for use as a weapon. It has been ravaged by time but may still pack
a blow.

2521.l: A small tree branch has been sharpened at one end and lies here.

edesc.desc:
A rather basic weapon to say the least, it's merely a branch that's been
ripped from a tree and sharpened at one end, similar to a stake. It could
still hurt, mind you, so don't go pointing it at something you don't want to
anger.

2701.l: Gods Armor lies on the ground here.

2702.l: A green and gold body armor is here.

2703.l: A green and gold body armor is here.

2707.l: A dark, metal ball floats above the ground here.

2708.l: A dark, metal ball floats above the ground here.

2709.l: A dark, metal ball floats above the ground here.

2710.l: An iron belaying pin lies here.

edesc.desc: It looks like a belaying pin like you would see on a ship.

2711.l: A large butcher knife lies here getting dull.

2714.l: A ruddy orange potion sits here.

2715.l: Someone has scribbled a message on this parchment.

edesc.desc:
Some scribbled notes say:
                           Grayswandir, Corwin's sword
                           Werewindle, Brand's sword
                           Frakir, Merlin's sentinent strangling cord
                           spikard, the ancient ring of power

2716.l: A disk of amber lies here.

edesc.desc: A disk of purest amber.
The soil is fine and loose.

2718.l: A pair of green (very, very) short pants has been tossed here.

2719.l: The jewel-studded crown of Amber lies here.

edesc.desc:
A magnificient crown, studded with all types of jewels; you feel
like a better person just by wearing it.

2720.l: A priceless Faberge egg sits here.

edesc.desc:
An authentic, original Faberge egg. The egg opens to reveal a man and
a woman in the throes of passion.

2721.l: A large seashell sits here giving off light.

edesc.desc: A large seashell that probably protected its creator for years.

2722.l: A plumed, three-cornered hat rests here.

edesc.desc: A dark three-cornered hat with a long green plume.

2723.l: A silver girdle lies here, gleaming.

edesc.desc: A stunning silver scaled girdle.

2724.l: A short cord coils and uncoils here.

edesc.desc: It appears to be a living cord. You wonder if it has a proper name...

2725.l: An ancient, powerful ring lies here.

edesc.desc:
It's an ancient ring, golden in color, with a myriad spikes radiating
out from a central hub to form a wheel. It emanates pure power.

2726.l: A beautiful white silk shirt lies here.

mobs.name: a waiter at the Grand Hotel

2727.l: A ring with a huge emerald lies here.

edesc.desc: It's a ring inset with a large, brilliant emerald.

2728.l: A ring with a huge ruby lies here.

edesc.desc: It's a ring inset with a huge, beautiful ruby.

2729.l: A ring with a huge sapphire lies here.

edesc.desc: It's a ring inset with a huge star sapphire.

2730.l: A green and black shield lies here.

edesc.desc:
An impressive green and black shield depicting a lion rending a
unicorn as a legend.

2731.l: A beautiful golden sword lies here

edesc.desc:
YES! This is Werewindle, the legendary sword of Brand and sister sword of
Grayswandir... a beautiful sword crafted from some kind of golden metal.
There is a huge emerald in the pommel. Preternatural, black energies flow
through the blade.
Looks like the kind of key that would work with a safe.

2733.l: A very secure-looking safe sits in the corner.

edesc.desc:
It looks like someone has taken a lot of trouble to protect their
valuables.

2734.l: A large, comfortable bed is here.

edesc.desc: It looks like a big, roomy bed that would be very comforable.
It looks like a very stylish wood and brass wet bar.
It's a clear, sparkling bottle for holding clear sparkling water.
A sturdy white arrow.

2738.s: a gleaming pair of silver-scaled gauntlets

edesc.desc: A magnificent pair of gauntlets fashioned from silver scales.

2739.s: a dark black cloak with a silvery rose clasp
2739.l: A silver rose sits atop a pile of black fabric.

edesc.desc:
A deeply black cloak of some heavy fabric with a silver clasp
fashioned in the shape of a rose.

2740.l: A powerful silver and gray sword lies here.

edesc.desc:
YES! It is Grayswandir, the sword of Corwin, formed by him from the
raw stuff of shadow... the sister sword of Werewindle. It is gray and
silver; blue sparks jump from the mystic etchings upon its blade.

2741.l: A green and gold plaid kilt lies here.

edesc.desc: A handsome kilt made from green and gold plaid cloth.
100% blue cotton denim, button-fly jeans.

mobs.name: a waiter at the Grand Hotel

edesc.desc:
A plain, simple, green robe with gold trim. It looks both sturdy
and comfortable.

2744.l: A crumpled green vest lies here.

edesc.desc:
This shirt has been cut off so wearers reveal their midriff. Printed on
on the front of the shirt are the words:

                            HARD ROCK CAFE
                                 AMBER

2746.s: a bottle of Bayle's Red wine

edesc.desc:
The label says it's a bottle of Bayle's Red wine. Bayle considers this
to be his everyday wine, although it is actually the preferred wine of
most of the Royal family.

2747.l: A shiny strip of cloth sits here.

edesc.desc: The sort of skimpy little thing a showgirl might almost wear.

2748.l: A pile of shimmering material lies here.

edesc.desc: This is a sleeky, sexy dress.

2749.l: A playing dart is stuck here.

2750.s: a blue and gray dressing gown
2750.l: A blue and gray dressing gown lies here.

edesc.desc: A huge, heavy blue and gray dressing gown.

2751.l: A wide, black belt is coiled up here.

edesc.desc: You see a wide, black belt.

2752.l: A silver hunting horn on a heavy cord lies here.

edesc.desc:
It's a large silver horn, suitable for calling the hounds during a
hunt, with a heavy cord so you can sling it all around your neck.

2753.l: A hellish dagger lies here smoking.

edesc.desc:
The black dagger that looks like it's been in a fire. It still smokes a
bit.

2754.s: a bottle of Bayle's White wine

edesc.desc:
The label says it's a bottle of Bayle's White wine. This is the expensive
brand made and sold by the Bayles family. However, some years it comes out
a little too yellow and Bayles has to unload it cheaply.

2755.s: a plate of delicious blackened snapper
2755.l: A plate of wonderful-looking cajun blackened snapper sits here.

edesc.desc:
It's a plate full of cajun blackened snapper and all the fixin's. It
looks delicious!

2756.l: The corpse of the Captain lies here, still bleeding.

edesc.desc: The Captain appears to be recently deceased.

2757.l: A tattoo needle lies here becoming more unsanitary.

edesc.desc: It's a long, sharp needle that doesn't look too clean.

2758.s: a tattoo of a red dragon
2758.l: Strangely enough, a drawing of a dragon lies here.

edesc.desc:
A bright red tattoo of a huge one-eyed dragon.
Actually, it's very good work.

2759.l: A suit of gleaming white scale armor is here.

edesc.desc: A stunningly white suit of scaled armor that looks like porcelain.
Sleeves of armor, made of bright white scale.
Beautiful white scale leggings.

2762.l: A plain piece of black cloth lies here.

edesc.desc: It's a hunter's crossbow made of a strong, white wood.

2764.l: Green and gold boots are sitting here.

edesc.desc: Basic GI boots in Amber.

mobs.name: Cecil the High Sheriff of Amber

2765.l: Some sneaky looking boots sit here.

edesc.desc: The labels on the soles of these boots identify them as "Shadowwalkers".

2766.l: Green and gold sleeves lie here.

edesc.desc: Basic GI arm armor in Amber.

mobs.name: Cecil the High Sheriff of Amber

2767.l: Green and gold leggings are on the ground here.

edesc.desc: Basic GI leg armor in Amber.

mobs.name: Cecil the High Sheriff of Amber

2768.l: A green and gold body armor is here.

edesc.desc: Basic GI armor in Amber.

mobs.name: Cecil the High Sheriff of Amber

2769.l: Some ornate foreign-looking robes lie here.

edesc.desc: A very handsome set of colorful oriental robes.

2770.l: A huge ruby on a heavy gold chain lies here.

edesc.desc:
It's the biggest damn ruby you've ever seen, and it's somewhat 
disturbing. There seems to be some sort of pattern moving within the
jewel. If you look at it too long, you get dizzy.

2771.l: A gold ring inset with a green gemstone lies here.

2772.l: A swirling red medallion on a chain lies here.

2773.l: A huge ruby on a heavy gold chain lies here.

edesc.desc:
It's the biggest damn ruby you've ever seen, and it's somewhat 
disturbing. There seems to be some sort of pattern moving within the
jewel. As you gaze into it longer you start to feel drawn within the jewel.

2774.l: A huge ruby on a heavy gold chain lies here.

edesc.desc:
It's the biggest damn ruby you've ever seen, and it's somewhat 
disturbing. There seems to be some sort of pattern moving within the
jewel. You easily shake off the pulling feeling of the jewel and assert
your mental dominance over it, commanding it to your every whim.
The shaft of the key is stamped "City Vault".

mobs.name: Cecil the High Sheriff of Amber

edesc.desc: A key marked "Manager".
It's a very small key.

2817.l: A big, brass key lies here.

edesc.desc: The word "brig" is scratched along its shaft.

2828.l: A big, old key lies here.

edesc.desc: The word 'castle' is scratched into the shaft of the key.

2891.l: A brass tool is lying here.

edesc.desc:
A brass tool of some sort. It looks like the kind of thing a plumber
would use to open a corroded valve.

2892.l: A copper key, green with age, lies here.

edesc.desc:
A copper key with a lovely green patina. You can just make out that
there's a "B" debossed on its handle.

2905.s: a small black and silver key
2905.l: A small black and silver key lies here.

edesc.desc: A small black and silver key marked "D".
It looks like a room key. It is marked with a "C".

2927.l: The Royal Throne of Amber is sitting here.

edesc.desc:
The Royal Throne of Amber is a large, ornate chair carved from a single
piece of solid amber. It's probably the largest piece in existence!
There are several scenes on its sides and arms, but the carving of
the unicorn on its backrest is the most impressive.

The carving of the unicorn on the throne's backrest depicts a beautiful
and thoughtful unicorn standing in a small clearing in a forest.
It looks like a door key. It is marked with a "M".
It looks like a room key. It is marked "Royal".
It looks like a room key. It is marked with a "L".
It looks like a room key. It is marked with a "C".

30101.l: The head of a huge condor is lying here.

edesc.desc:
You see the severed head of a great condor.  If worn as a helment the beak
would serve as an extra weapon.

30102.l: The nest of a huge bird is here, littered with giant golden feathers.

30103.l: A cute birdbath stands before you.

30104.l: A pixie dagger is lying here.

30105.l: An algea covered birdbath stands here.

30107.l: A polished black birdbath stands here.

30108.l: A huge beehive hangs from a tree limb.

30109.l: A dirty scythe is lying here.

30111.l: A beautiful golden throne is at one end of this room.

30112.l: A shimmering pixie staff lies here.

30113.l: A shimmering pixie orb floats here.

30300.k: couch electric lightning plastic lump goo
30300.s: an electric couch made of molten plastic
30300.l: A blue streak of lightning strikes the plastic floor and splatters into a couch!

edesc.keywords: couch electric lump lightning plastic goo
edesc.desc:
Electricity fizzles about the edges of this lump of plastic, causing black,
acrid smoke to rise into the air, swirling as it rises into the black
maelstrom about you.

30301.l: A pair of brightly colored canvas shoes are sitting around.

edesc.desc:
Traditionally, these shoes were made in two parts, the spun woolen sole made by
the men, and the canvas upper part made by the women. The two parts are then
sewn together by the women, who add an extra patch of wool to the toe.
The quality of these little shoes is the pride of the village's shoemakers.

30302.l: A rack of clothing spins about, displaying fine wares from across the globe.

30303.l: Some clothes are flopping around on the floor here.

30304.l: A super-gondo weapon of super destruction lies around here somewhere.

30305.l: A rough textured shirt with long sleeves is hanging on a hook.

edesc.desc:
It is dyed a soft reddish color, probably with dye derived from pokeberry or
rhubarb. It is well made, double stitched at the seams and even has a small
cotton tag on the back. It appears to have been used before though, for there
is a small black stain underneath the left forearm and another on the lower
right.
It is a small faded black stain, presumably from paint.

It is an ordinary tag you'd find on the back of most clothes, and says:
Wash in cold water
do not use magickal detergent
keep away from flame, acid, and toxic gases.

30306.l: A test pen is squirting ink wildly.

30307.l: A message for you is lying here.

30308.l: A pair of socks gather dirt on the ground.

edesc.desc:
They're made from cotton grown on the southern plains, near the ocean.
On the tip there is a seam of blue thread holding the whole sock together.

Personally, I never understood why they couldnt just weave the front end
together.

30309.l: A robe of the Cappaccino monks is here.

edesc.desc: They're rather large pockets.

It is dark red, dyed to the color of hot, frothy cappuccino with a bit of
cinnamon to spice things up. Made of wool and canvas, it is scratchy and rough
but will stand up to the elements well. There are also many pockets for keeping
medicines and reagents in.

30310.l: A really big bag is lying on the ground, covering about an acre of space.

30311.l: A big fat powerful arrow is lyin about on the ground.

30312.l: An unfinished bow is lying here.

30313.l: A, um, really big turannosourpuss rex is here.

30314.l: A fine pair of smooth black Docker's are lying around.

edesc.keywords: fine black pants smooth snazzy dockers
edesc.desc:
Nice pants.

Double stitched with carved tortoise shell buttons, white silk pocket linings,
and even a bronze zipper, the luxury of luxuries for the upper class in this
day and age, these pants surely stand out from the rest. And so does the price
tag, that is if you are the type that buys goods from stores.
Damn, they really expect you to pay 100 gold coins for this crap??

30315.k: garment prison blue light garments standard regulation
30315.l: Some lightly blue colored garments are folded up almost neatly.

edesc.keywords: garment prison blue light garments standard regulation
edesc.desc:
Made out of rough cotton and washed in lukewarm water for years, these garments
loosely fit on you, made to accomodate most sizes. Intended to be worn as 
punishment, they are stitched together with one thread, and air drafts in
through a hole in the shoulder. A numbered identification badge is on the
left pocket.

An earlier prisoner wearing this garment must have accidentally snagged on 
something.

30316.l: An unfinished object is lying here.

30317.k: belt leather red reddish coil coiled strip long
30317.l: A long strip of reddish colored leather is coiled up on the ground.

edesc.keywords: belt reddish red leather long strip coil coiled
edesc.desc:
It is rounded in a semi-corner at the edges, and stitched 1/4th inch from the
edges with brown thread. Made from ochre-dyed alligator leather, the edges of 
the scales have folded and rubbed the dye off, leaving off-white circles in the
creases of the belt scales. The sizing holes have brass edges and interlock 
perfectly with the oiled brass buckle.

30318.k: tea mug glass metal ivory bodum
30318.l: A glass mug with metal straps on it shines brightly on a countertop.

edesc.desc:
Made of two parts, a beaker shaped flask that is made of remarkably clear
glass, and two steel straps encircling it attached to a handle, this mug would
seem out of place in any normal rowdy tavern.

There are a few words etched into the glass underneath the handle.

bodum

ne pas utiliser sur le cabaret

It is made of knobby fibrous wood with flaky bark that comes off when you
rub your finger along the rough surface. The leaves are tough and dark green,
shaped almost like a maple leaf but they are covered with short white hairs.
Several different vines branch out of the ground at the same spot, as if a
clump of grapes fell on the ground and sprouted in different directions.

The bark is colored dark reddish-brown and is pruned in many spots, leaving 
many little knobby circles at the corners of the vine branches.

3100.l: A black lacquered helm lies here.

3102.l: A black pile of cloth lies here.

3103.l: A black pile of cloth lies here.

3104.l: A katana lies in the dirt.

3106.l: A pile of silver chain mail lies here.

3107.l: A pair of black boots sit here.

3110.l: A pair of golden boots sit here.

3116.l: A pile of brown cloth is here.

edesc.desc: It's a coarse, brown hooded robe.
It's made of soft black velvet. Elvis would have loved it.

3118.l: A pair of velvet pants lies here.

edesc.desc: It's made of soft black velvet. Elvis would have loved it.

3119.l: A sleek silver dirk lies here.

edesc.desc: The sleek little knife sharply shines.

3121.l: A towel lies here in the dust.

edesc.desc: No hoopy frood would be caught dead without one.

3122.l: A small wooden board carved with runes lies here.

3123.l: A set of dull black armor is lying here.

3124.l: A pair of dull black sleeves are lying here.

edesc.desc: It's a black medallion with a skull imprinted on it.

3127.l: Some velvet robes lie on the floor.

3129.l: Some dull black leggings are lying here.

3137.l: A vial of blood lies here.

edesc.desc: It's a vial of blood from some poor soul.

3143.l: A wooden table sits here on four uneven legs.

3146.l: A gigantic black throne is here.

edesc.desc: It looks to be made of elven bones, dyed black with blood and ichor.

3150.l: A suit of lacquered black armor lies here.

edesc.desc: Sorry, closed for repairs.

3500.l: A small, thin card is lying here.

3501.l: A thin circlet moves about on the ground like a worm.

3502.l: An organic blade is lying here.

3503.l: An organic, thin dagger lays half hidden on the ground.

3504.l: An organic suit of dull armor rests here.

3505.l: A scaly helmet is lying here.

3506.l: Some organic armgear is lying here.

3508.l: An odd, organic mask is lying here.

3509.l: Rubbery, organic leggings are lying here.

3510.l: A long, organic shield is lying here.

3511.l: A strange, circular creature twitches on the ground.

3512.l: Thin, rubbery booties rest on the ground.

3513.l: A thin, slimy strand of seaweed is coiled on the floor.

3514.l: A small puddle of luminescent liquid rests on the floor.

3515.l: A piece of kelp with a gourd-like tale is resting on the floor.

3516.l: An ancient, powerful looking bracer lays on the ground.

4001.l: A shimmering portal of blue light hovers in the middle of the room.

edesc.desc: It has a strange, other-worldly glow.

4002.l: A shimmering portal of red light hovers in the middle of the room.

edesc.desc: It has a strange, other-worldly glow.

4101.l: A shiny mug is sitting on the ground.

4102.l: A chipped mug is lying on the ground.

4103.l: A glass full of red liquid lies on the ground.

4104.l: A glass full of green liquid lies on the ground.

4105.l: A pile of ebony cloth lies in the dust.

4106.l: A longish sword, covered in all manner of magical runes lies here.

4107.l: A bright ball of light lies in the dust.

4108.l: A shimmering talisman lies in the corner.

4109.l: A shield made of silver is collecting dust.

4110.l: A circlet of wood lies on the ground.

4111.l: A belt made of solid gold has been left here.

4112.l: A robe cover with dozens of pockets is lying here.

4113.l: A pair of gloves lies here, giving off sparks.

4201.l: A jacket made from the scales of the giant kresh lies here.

4202.l: A helmet made from the scales of the giant kresh rests here.

4203.l: Some leggings made from the scales of the giant kresh is here.

4204.l: Some armplates made from the scales of the giant kresh lie here.

4205.l: A shield made from the scales of the giant kresh lies here.

4206.l: A girdle made from the scales of the giant kresh rests here.

4207.l: A long, sturdy spear lies on he ground.

4208.l: A length of rope sparkles in the sun light.

4209.l: A ring made of opal gathers dust on the ground.

4210.l: A ring made of jade gathers dust on the ground.

edesc.desc:
The ring is a circular band of carved jade.  Complex runes have been etched
onto both the inside and outside surfaces of the ring, perhaps glyphs of
combat or protection.

4211.l: Someone has left a worn key lying here.

4212.l: A small prism made of ice gives off a soft glowing light.

4213.l: A large mound of gold coins lies here.

4214.l: A wonderfully well cared for well rises out of a corner of the room.

4220.l: A key made from solid ice is here. You wonder why it doesn't melt.

4221.l: A chest made completely from ice is here. Even the lock is made of ice.

4290.l: A long iron key twisted into and odd shape lies on the ground.

4301.l: An unfinished object is lying here.

4302.l: A damned dirty hoe lies here, tantalizing you.

4303.s: a pair of dirty denim overalls
4303.l: Dirty denim overalls lie here on the ground.

4304.l: An amazing statue of Mars glares down at you with martial fury.

edesc.desc:
Mighty Mars is depicted here in a massive granite statue.
In godly armor, Mars wields a fasces of imperium and haunts
your pathetic soul with a piercing glare of nightmarish anger.

4305.l: A cistern here is filled with grapes waiting to be smashed.

4306.l: A basket filled with shiny red apples rests here.

4307.l: A trough rests here for feeding the livestock.

4308.l: Some gruel rests here, looking pretty awful.

4309.l: A black scythe of the east rests on the ground.

edesc.desc:
This is a black scythe of eastern lands, used for the cultivation of various
sundry crops, notably rice and chung-fei.

4310.l: A holy visor of golden spikes lies here.

4311.l: A shiny red apple sits here, looking tasty.

4312.l: A pretty pink bow lies here on the ground.

4313.s: a dirty kilt with a "happy hole" in front
4313.l: A skirt lies on the floor, with a noticeable hole in the groinal area.

4314.l: A rutabaga lies here, growing slowly out of the soil.

edesc.desc:
This is a variety of turnip, a brand of brassicaceous plant,
classified as Bassica napobrassica, and has a yellow-white fleshed,
edible tuber.

4315.l: A pair of trousers stained by refuse lie here.

4316.l: A pipe for smoking sits here.  It looks tasty!

4317.l: A bottle of evil Shenanigans lies here.

edesc.desc:
This bottle just looks like a long night and a bad headache
waiting to happen.  On the label of the bottle is a crazy
jester with mad eyes.  He has a big grin and an outrageous
outfit, and invites you to join him in some tomfoolery.

4318.l: A melted ice cream lies here.

4320.l: A tangerine sits here, rent free....what a bum.

edesc.desc: It's a yellow-red fruit which looks mighty tasty.

4322.l: A wooden key rests on the ground.

4323.l: An amazing golden egg sits here on the ground, but not for long.

edesc.desc:
This is a lucky find.  Only a blessed chicken could create such
a wondrous rarity.  A merchant of treasures would be certain to pay
a goodly sum for such an item.

4325.s: the Mighty dragon War helm of Takeda Shingen
4325.l: A bigass war helm lies here.

4329.l: A roasted cornish hen lies here, looking scrumptious.

edesc.desc:
This roasted cornish hen is plump and muscular,
sure to be a fine weapon or a fine meal.

4330.l: An unfinished object is lying here.

4331.s: the dragon Emperor robes of Tang Xuanzong

4332.l: It's here!  The Fasces of Eternal Imperium!  You just shat your pants!

4333.s: the Radiant Halo of the One God

4334.s: a wooden replica of the True Cross
4334.l: A wooden replica of the True Cross rests behind the pulpit.

edesc.desc:
The people of Cedric's manor fervently hold this to be the True Cross
itself, but it is clearly a shabby remake of the original, intended to
strengthen the grip of faith over the minds of gullible cretins.

rms.name: The chapel of Our Lady Saint Torres

4335.s: the brown habit of a sagely teacher
4335.l: An unfinished object is lying here.

4336.l: A stone thrower rests upon a raised parapet, ready to fire.

edesc.desc:
This strong, compact onager was fashioned by Cedric's engineers
to fire projectiles upon any group of men who might breach the
palisade around Cedric's lands.  In the basket at the end of the
engine's arm is a diseased yak, intended to both infect and
demoralize anyone so unfortunate as to attack wily Cedric's
manor house.

4337.s: a big black pot of nastiness
4337.l: A big black pot of nastiness sits on a swivel on the edge of the wall.

edesc.desc:
This is a large black pot fitted to a swivel on the castle
wall, covered by a heavy lid.  Within the deadly container is
pitch, straw, tar, metal shards, bees' nests, and rancid
feces, all slathered in animal grease.  The dastardly pot is
here to be set alight and dumped upon anyone who might reach
as far as the walls themselves, with indubitably horrific
effects.

4339.l: A powerful ballista of incredible torsion waits to be fired.

edesc.desc:
This powerful ballista is built in the scorpion design. It is
in essence a counter-siege weapon, capable of firing bolts the size of
a man, which can obliterate several men at once.  The giant crossbow
must be cranked back to generate torsion capable of flinging the massive
iron bolts hard enough to impale any group of men foolish enough to
assault Cedric's fortified manor house.

4340.l: A heavy switch lies on the ground, tinged with blood.

edesc.desc:
This is just a gruesome hunk of iron designed to brain any
fool who states publicly anything other than the fact that
working Cedric's lands for no pay under the hot sun under
threat of severe punishment is just the greatest thing
since sliced bread.

4341.l: A fine scholar's robe rests on the ground.

edesc.desc: This is a nice, comfortable robe of ermine and black brocade.

4342.l: A bloodied knife sits on the ground.

edesc.desc:
The thousands of fowl this knife has dispatched have left it
bloodied and stained.  The taint on this weapon to birdkind is
palpable, both feared and hated among avians.

4343.l: Palmate antlers lie on the ground here.

edesc.desc: They're big, really sharp, and from an eight point moose.

4344.l: A bloody apron smears the ground with gore.

edesc.desc:
This apron is smeared from the blood of unmentionable slaughter
and butchery.

4346.l: A magic candle forged by a master chandler lies here.

edesc.desc:
This is surely forged by the hand of a master chandler, able
to work the wax to such a compact state that its light seems
to glow eternal.

mobs.name: Old Sam Baker the candlestick maker

4348.l: An unfinished object is lying here.

4350.l: An unfinished object is lying here.

4361.l: A large vat of hot gravy sits here, emitting an irresistible odor.

edesc.desc:
This vat is filled with a traditional sauce used for roast dinners.
The gravy is comprised of roast potatoes, roast meat, Yorkshire
pudding and boiled vegetables.

4362.s: a cauldron of tomato onion sauce
4362.l: A black cauldron filled with a tomato-onion mixture rests here.

edesc.desc:
This cauldron contains one of Cedric's favorite mixtures for
his specialty dishes for rare guests.  Tomato, onion, dill,
garlic, paprika, and rutabaga seed mix in a bubbling hot pool
within this cauldron, set over an open flame and awaiting
the call of the chefs.

4363.l: This is truly a crapload of gravy.

4364.s: a barrel of apple and cranberry sauce
4364.l: A barrel of apple and cranberry sauce rests against the wall.

edesc.desc:
This delectable sauce is most often used with pork, ham, or
potato pancakes, or served baked with cherry tart as elegant
desserts in and of themselves.

4368.l: An old rake is here.  Who cares?

edesc.desc: It's an old rake, and boy does it suck.

It's an iron helmet with a pair of tubes made of molded wax,
designed to feed the wearer a line of ale from two openings
on the top of the helmet designed to hold lager bottles.

4371.s: the Holy Lance of the Savior
4371.l: A holy martyr's lance lies upon the ground with a perfect glow.

edesc.desc:
This wonderous relic was spared from the life of a
true daughter of God, a free lamb of the garden able
to walk her own path. She was punished harshly for
her choice of expression, but you wield the lance
of the great woman in her stead.

4372.s: the tattered rags of a Holy Martyr
4372.l: Tattered rags of a selfless martyr lie here.

edesc.desc:
These rags are the remains of a once proud wardrobe.
Their wearer must have been cruelly beaten and whipped
to have worn such threaded rags of clothing. A strength
has been lent the rags from the dignity of their owner.
Putting them on, you feel an incredible sense of
benevolence, but also the hollow echo of death's grip.
Be cautious of the effects of wearing these rags.

4373.l: A fifteen foot tall Chef's Hat is here, making you laugh.

edesc.desc:
This hat is simply humongous....
Its brim is large enough to house an entire family
of gypsy midgets.  You consider the potential benefits
of renting out its space to migrant workers at the
thought of it.  Several straps form from the corners of
the hat in a central carriage which fits neatly to your
head, allowing you to wear this ridiculous piece of apparel.

4374.s: a huge barrel of brine, salt, and vinegar
4374.l: A huge barrel of brine, salt, and vinegar rests against the northern wall.

edesc.desc:
This enormous wooden barrel was fashioned by a cooper to contain
all the preserving agents necessary for storing the foods here
in the larder.  Three wooden slats have been carved into the giant
barrel to store each of the agents, which are often extracted for
usage in storing fishes, meats, and grains.

4375.s: a totally fantastic pair of pea green slacks
4375.l: A pair of pea green slacks arouses your heart with lustful envy.

edesc.desc:
This pair of slacks makes you want to go out on the
town and wave your groin in the direction of members
of the opposite sex while eating a lime and shaking
your buttocks to the sound of flutes and tubas.

4377.l: A cooled rectangular icebox extends along the southern wall.

edesc.desc:
This is basically a long stone rectangular slab carved out
to protrude from the southern wall, hollowed out and filled
with snow collected from the northern climes for cooling.
Fish and cured meats rests within the icebox, frozen and
able to rest here for months without spoiling.

4379.l: A wooden table rests here, with multicolored spices all over it.

edesc.desc:
This table is six feet wide and three feet long, and has a smooth
sanded surface which is currently covered with many varieties of
rare and expensive spices, from myrrh to the dust of Sheba.  A
series of knife marks are apparent in the center of the table.

4381.l: A massive claymore sits here, forged of iron.

edesc.desc:
This is a simple but brutally effective weapon.  It's designed for
wielding with two hands, to be used both as shield and as a long range
slashing or piercing weapon.

4391.l: A little black spatula sits on the ground.

edesc.desc:
This weapon, unfortunately, just doesn't live up to its
name.  Chef Pierre, being a braggart, liked to think of
himself as some sort of conqueror of the various meats
delivered to his kitchen.  It's really just a silly
little spatula.

4392.s: a humongous pile of fish meat
4392.l: A veritable mountain of stinky fish meat towers over you.

edesc.desc:
This pile is just a massive amount of shrimp, sea bass, crawfish, trout,
perch, flounder, shad, clown shoes, hypodermic needles, and other oceanic
trash caught in nets and piled up here to be dissected later.

4394.s: a bottle of fine red Merlot
4394.l: A bottle of Merlot sits here.

4395.l: A bottle of Cabernet Sauvignon rests here.

edesc.desc: Ah, it smells wonderful!

4396.l: A dirty shovel lies on the ground.  Fascinating, eh?

edesc.desc:
You know how it goes, baby!  It's an old dirty shovel, dig it?
Use your imagination, expand your mind!

4397.l: An old wooden stool, worn from years of use, rests here.

edesc.desc:
This stool is old as Sam himself, and has been year through
decades of chandlery, burnt and scarred in as many places
as Old Sam from dripping wax.

4398.l: A red felt fez is here, styling up the place with its presence.

edesc.desc:
Well, well well...This is quite a hat.  It's just a silly cone shaped,
brimless hat.  This is the ultimate in headwear for aspiring young
boys who wish to one day know the pleasure of scrubbing dishes or
digging turnips without pay.  This particular one is shabby and
folded, from the many spankings endured by its original owner.

4399.l: A pile of forbidden powder lies here.

edesc.desc:
This is a rarely seen substance from beyond the mountains.  Only a
trader of the Black Hand could have such contacts as are necessary
to obtain this mysterious powder.  Nothing is known of how it is
grown, or where it comes from.

4402.l: A disgusting, gore-covered meat cleaver is on the ground.

edesc.desc:
This cleaver is old and bent, but still incredibly sharp.
The years of its use as a wild instrument of death wielded
by a crazed drunkard have made the cleaver powerful but
extremely inaccurate.

4404.l: The Book of Common Prayer rests in a heavy binding on the ground.

edesc.desc:
This massive book contains a great number of gospels and
epistles dedicated to the holy communion.  Morality plays
and background mythology fill most of the pages of the
great volume, which also contains a section establishing
canon law.

4405.l: A clerical collar is stuck to the floor by dried up booze.

edesc.desc:
This thing is more trouble than it's worth.  It reeks of alcohol,
and the fumes which rise up when wearing it makes even you a bit
tipsy.  It distracts you greatly in battle and turns you into an
undisciplined fool.  It might be better to just get rid of it.

4406.l: Sticky, alcohol-stained robes lie in a mess on the floor.

4407.l: A plumed helmet of a granite lion's head is on the ground.

edesc.desc:
This is a very nice looking helmet, consisting of the
decapitated head of a magical granite lion.  A yellow
plume extends from its head, giving the helm a dash
of chivalric beauty.

mobs.name: a granite statue of a lion

4408.l: An antiquated bronze knife rests on the floor.

edesc.desc:
This is a rather old school knife of bronze, and emits a
pleasant odor of strange and rare spices.

4409.l: Spicy beef cutlets are here, tempting your appetite.

edesc.desc:
These finely cut portions of beef have been hammered with
tomato, garlic, flour, and lard.  They were then roasted
to perfection, resulting in these tasty portions of meat.

rms.name: a huge barrel of brine, salt, and vinegar

4410.l: A well-stocked wine rack rests against the wall, holding many choice wines.

edesc.desc:
This is a very well stocked wine rack.  Bottles of all vintages and
regions fill the racks.  Chardonnays, Zinfandels, Champagnes, Petit
Verdots, and Aperitifs line every row, making this one of the finer
wine selections you've ever seen.

4411.l: A wild mushroom grows here in water and dirt.

edesc.desc:
It's wild and untreated, it may make you sick if you eat it.  Then
again, it may make you consort with the Queen of Heaven upon a
toadstoll flying in the clouds, if it's the right kind o' shroom.
Maybe it's worth a shot?

4414.l: The Bigass Axe of Biiiiiig Mama is here, by Golly!

4500.l: A huge double-bladed axe lies here.

4501.l: A nasty feather has been dropped here.

4503.l: A talisman with a dancing skeleton on it has been left here.

4701.l: A superbly crafted bow is resting here.

4702.l: The furred pelt of a snow tiger is lying here.

4703.l: You see a crude, heavy sword here.

4704.l: A key made of solid ice lies here.

edesc.desc: It's a key. It's made of ice. Wierd, eh?

4705.l: A skirt crafted out of intricate, powerful dragon scales lies here folded up.

mobs.name: Khal'mast, the dragon of the northlands

4777.l: A scroll with grey ink rests here.

edesc.desc:
The crate is large and smells of rotten fish.  Wood splinters 
appear to prevent safe lifting of it.

4801.l: An odd hoopak made from treated bamboo lies here.

edesc.desc:
A favourite weapon of smaller folk, this weapon appears to be a
sling-spear.

4802.l: A missile-ready bamboo hoopak rests against the ground here.

edesc.desc:
This hoopak is designed exclusively for slinging stones.
The blunted end is tipped with metal, but seems ineffective
as a weapon.

4803.l: A coil of rope lies on the ground here.

edesc.desc: It is hemp, and feels heavy and wet.
The water bottle glistens with superior Oriental craftsmanship.

4805.l: A fine crystal bottle sits here, ready for consumption.

edesc.desc: It is a typical wine bottle - long necked and made of glass.

4806.l: A ceramic jug lies here, sloshing with liquid.

edesc.desc: It is a ceramic beer jug.  No designs paint its white surface.

4807.l: A small glass bottle lies here.

edesc.desc: This little flask smells strongly of spirits.

4808.l: A fresh garlic root dries in the heat here.

edesc.desc:
The garlic root smells strong and seems moist, as though it is ready
for potting or planting.

4809.l: An odd shaped root lies ready for use in potions here.

edesc.desc:
Among the deadlier poisons, this pale root seems to have been shaved
and sheared to remove its more potent components.

4810.l: A red berry grows here on a vine in the darkness.

edesc.desc:
This deadly berry is useful for poisoning small animals and rodents.
Its reddish colour seems to attract pests.

4811.l: A potion labelled "General Remedy" occupies a vial here.

edesc.desc: The potion is clear and smells of ginseng and garlic.

4812.l: A strong-smelling potion lies corked in a vial here.

edesc.desc:
Liquid snuff.  This potion will make you far more intoxicated than
alcohol ever will.

4813.l: A bamboo divining rod lies here.

edesc.desc:
The diving rod has been carved from pale bamboo reeds and points
downward when water is nearby.

4814.l: A foul-smelling potion rests corked in a vial here.

edesc.desc:
This potion is a curative, so strong is the scent of garlic that it must
purify the blood.

4815.l: A delicious vegetable gyoza sits on a plate here, ready to be devoured.

edesc.desc: This is a simple seafood dumpling.

4816.l: A succulent dish of takosu emits its sweet scent here.

edesc.desc: It is a lavender-coloured dish and smells strongly of vinegar.

4817.l: A plate of sunomono lies chilled on the table.

edesc.desc: This is raw shrimp, pink and cold.

4818.l: A plate of sweet ebi is chilled with ice here.

edesc.desc:
This is a sweeter, less mild shrimp.  It is grey and brown
and is cold to the touch.

4819.l: An ancient tome written in an unknown language lies here.

edesc.desc:
You cannot make out the spells listed in this tome.
The binding is bamboo and the pages are vellum.

4820.l: There is a huge mushroom growing here.

edesc.desc: It is a simple mushroom.

4821.l: Here, you see a hand-painted snuff bottle.

edesc.desc:
Collectors items, these bottled are used to store small quantities
of opium.  Each one is handpainted with a different scene.  This one
bears the picture of a mountain waterfall spilling over rocks.

4822.l: There is a small amount of snuff here, piled into a small mound.

edesc.desc: This white powder can make its users feel euphoric when snorted.

4823.l: There is an oil lamp here.

edesc.desc:
The brass oil lamp appears to be about half-full of a clear,
resinous liquid.

4824.l: A small amulet hangs from a gold chain here.

edesc.desc: This is a simple yin-yang, a sign of balance and harmony.

4825.l: A bamboo staff lies on the ground here.

edesc.desc: At 7 feet tall, this staff is quite an impressive weapon.

4826.l: A clear potion, perhaps even water, sloshes in a small vial here.

edesc.desc: Odorless and clear - could be water.

4827.l: A wand of some kind lies on the counter here.

edesc.desc:
The wand seems blessed, but not magical.  The wood is warped,
however, which accounts for the lack of magical feeling.

4828.l: A scale mail vest shines brightly here.

edesc.desc:
Hundreds of hammered interlocking scales make this vest of armour
suitable for flexibility and maneuvering in combat.

4829.l: A nice pair of gauntlets is lying here.

edesc.desc:
These appear to be chain mail gloves with a flexible layer of steel
scales over them.

4830.l: A pair of scale boots rests here on the floor.

edesc.desc:
These are hard leather boots.  Tiny scale plates have been sewn
onto the fabric to provide added foot protection.

4831.l: A newly-tanned yakhide vest is here.

edesc.desc:
This vest appears to be made from the hide of a yak rather than
the skin of a cow.  A small, thin trim of yak hair lines its
borders.

4832.l: A beautiful Xixieqian no-dachi lies in its scabbard here.

edesc.desc:
This oriental longsword seems capable of lopping off the heads of
several opponents at once.  It looks very heavy and cumbersome, but
shines with a new polish.
This is a short bamboo staff, suitable for training or children.

This is a bamboo shortbow.  Yak intestines provide the bowstring with
added spring.

It appears to be the kind of robe a serving girl or housewife would wear
to go about her daily chores.

4836.l: A silken vest lies folded here.

edesc.desc:
This stylish vest seems suitable for being worn on top of normal
clothes, though it would be a tight fit.  Complex designs showing
rushing rivers and mossy rocks adorn the vest's back.

4837.l: A backpack rests on the ground here.

edesc.desc: This is a simple leather rucksack.
It is back and made of velvet.
Though made from chestnut, the torch is coated in pine sap.

4841.l: A bamboo arrow lies ready for use.

edesc.desc: This arrow is over an arm's length and is tipped with a barbed steel head.
This is a simple wooden barrel, used to store water, fish, or fruits.

4845.l: A fountain of bubbling water burbles here.

edesc.desc:
The fountain is that of a carved dragon that spews water from its
mouth to pool in its curved, coiled tail.

4846.l: A wooden key lies here collecting dust.

4847.l: One part of a broken key lies here on the ground.

edesc.desc: It looks like a piece of a wooden key that has been snapped in half.

4900.l: A slab of volcanic obsidian has fallen here.

edesc.desc:
The slab of obsidian looks to be too heavy to carry, despite the fact that
obsidian fetches a high price to jewelers.

4901.l: Some studded leathery armor rests on the ground here.

edesc.desc:
Crafted from the stripped flesh of an often-dead daemon, this suit
of armor has a series of metal studs hammered into it for added
protection from attacks.

4902.l: A strip of daemon flesh cures here as it hangs.

edesc.desc:
This is nothing more than a strip of flesh that has been flayed from
a recently-killed fire daemon.

4903.l: A vial of greenish liquid sits here.

edesc.desc:
This small glass vial contains what appears to be a congealing greenish
liquid.

4904.l: A vial of reddish liquid rests here.

edesc.desc:
This vial contains a transparent reddish fluid, akin to the ichor that
an frost elemental oozes upon death.

4905.l: Some congealed blood is pooled here.

edesc.desc:
Apparently, some resinous substance in the victim's blood mingled with
some element to form this reddish gem.

4906.l: The severed horn of a daemon lies here.

edesc.desc:
This appears to be the severed horm of an ice daemon.  The white deposits
on the undersurface of the horn seem to have been crystalized.

4907.l: The severed tail of a fire devil lies here, its barbs sharp and poised.

edesc.desc:
This severed tail would make a formidable weapon against an unprotected
creature.

4908.l: A vial of clear liquid lies here.

edesc.desc:
This vial seems to contain a fluid that emanates an acrid scent even
through the cork stopper.

4909.l: A vial of white powder lies here.

edesc.desc:
This quaffable vial seems to be filled with a mixture of crushed talc
and bone dust.

4910.l: Some bone dust litters the ground here.

edesc.desc: This is nothing more than a pile of fragmented bones.

4911.l: A torch which seems to burn black flames stands here.

edesc.desc:
This torch seems to burn with an unholy fire that seems to sap your life
force in order to keep it burning.

4912.l: A cloak made of glistening drider silk is crumpled up on the ground here.

edesc.desc:
Woven from the silk of a drider, this garment seems to be very strong
and flexible.  It's white sheen is bright, as though it was newly created.

4913.l: An obsidian sword lies here, its blade finely polished.

edesc.desc: This sword is made from fragile, though sharp, volcanic glass.

This giagantic two-headed axe is far too heavy for any
normal mortal wielder and looks capable of severing a
grown ogre in two.

This blade is easily five feet in length.  It gleams with an almost
unholy illumination and seems to be able to draw the life out of its
victim as it slices into them.

4916.l: Some bone dice lie on the ground here.

edesc.desc:
These eight-sided dice appear to have been used a great deal in this
gaming hall judging by the smoothed, worn edges.

4917.l: A chunk of sulfur lies here.

edesc.desc:
This foul-smelling element keeps the volcanic fires raging deep within
the mountain.

4918.l: A black shard of crystal floats here.

edesc.desc:
The shard appears to absorb the natural magical energy of its surroundings
and converts it into a magical defense.
The gate key looks to be made of obsidian.

4920.l: A few daemon bones lie on the acid-eaten ground.

edesc.desc: These bones appear to have been acid bleached over the passage of time.

You certainly have no desire to drink the acid which would surely
dissolve your container before you could consume it and commit
suicide.

4922.l: A vicious looking serrated blade lies here covered in gore.

5000.l: A fine, glass dagger rests spoked in the ground here.

edesc.desc:
This blade seems to be polished to transparency.  Hilted with a leather
pommel, this foot-long weapon seems combat worthy.

5001.l: A glass bottle lies here, corked.

edesc.desc:
This bottle appears to be suitable for keeping liquids from evaporating
in the sun.

5002.l: A scimitar lies here, its curved blade smooth and sharp.

5100.l: A pool of water bubbles here.

edesc.desc: The water is murky, but drinkable, it seems.

5200.l: A long, ornate dagger lies here forgotten.

5500.l: A spear made of ironwood has been left here.

5502.s: a pair of intricately designed bracers
5502.l: A pair of intricately designed bracers has been dropped here.

5503.l: A pair of gauntlets is lying on the ground.

5504.l: An ironwood wand has been dropped in the dirt.

5505.s: a golden ring of intertwined leaves
5505.l: A small golden ring lies in the dirt.

5506.l: A strange orb pulses on the ground here.

5700.l: A half finished painting sits here.

edesc.desc:
It could have been a beautiful painting ... had it been finished.  There
appears to be something on the reverse side.

5701.l: A dried up palette lies here.

edesc.desc:
In elven script is written ...

A traitor abides here ... beware, he is ...

All the paint has long since dried up. There looks to be some crude writing
on the back.

5702.l: A skeletal figure sits slumped over in a chair.

edesc.desc:
The skeleton appears to be Elven judging by its fine bone structure. By the 
looks of it, he is the artist of the painting as he is holding a palette and
brush still in his hand.  His position makes you wonder how he died ...

A palette is in the skeleton.
A brush is in the skeleton.

5703.l: A small iron chest sits here.

edesc.desc: It looks quite secure and very heavy.

5704.l: A small iron key lays here.

5705.l: A large leatherbound book rests here.

edesc.desc: The rest of the book is burnt beyond recognition ...

Only the following is readable:

.... today i make my attempt .... destroy the wizard and take ....
The page is burnt beyond recognition ...

edesc.keywords: page-1 page1 page 1 chapter chapter-1 chapter1
edesc.desc:
Page-1

Besides the page number, the page is burnt beyond recognition ...

It is a large leatherbound book with a runic "F" on it's cover. The book
is closed.

5706.l: A wooden couch sits here strewn with colorful pillows.

edesc.desc:
A colorful couch sits here with big fluffy cushions and pillows.  Something
doesn't seem quite right though, the number of pillows seems disproportionate.

5707.l: A finely wrought silver wire basket hangs suspended here.

edesc.desc:
It appear magikal and looks to be of one solid piece having no
discernable beginning, end, or seams.

5708.l: A figure stands frozen stooped over the table.

edesc.desc:
The figure is dressed in a simple brown tunic and appears to be a
servant.  It looks like he was polishing the table.  Whatever has
frozen him in place also defies all your atempts to affect him.

5709.l: A small oak keg sits here.

5710.l: A large oak barrel rests here.

5712.l: A large oak throne with a high back sits here.

edesc.desc:
the script says:

Only the master may know the way ...

It is a large oak throne with a high back and two brightly glowing
orbs set on the back posts. Some script is written on the back of
the chair.

5713.l: A strange jewel encrusted band lies here.

edesc.desc:
It looks valuable.  Intermingled with the gems are magikal inscriptions.
The ten gems encircling the band appear to be sapphires.

5714.l: A students spell book sits here.

edesc.desc:
Sleep Spell

Final description needed ...

Read Magic Spell

More spell description needed ...

Dancing Lights Spell

Blah blah, spell description needed ....

The spell book has the following listed in the index.

Page-1 Dancing Lights
Page-2 Read Magic
Page-3 Sleep

5715.l: A small wooden chest stands in the corner.

edesc.desc:
It is a robust chest made from short, heavy planks that have been fastened
together with tenons.

5716.l: A worn deck of cards is stacked here.

5717.l: A roll of vellum sits here.

5718.l: A pair of pants has been left here.

5720.l: A pair of worn leather shoes sits here.

5721.l: A shirt lies here on the ground

5722.l: A pair of leather sandals has been dropped here.

5723.l: A stoppered vial of black ink rests here.

5724.l: A small, but sturdy, embossed bullet shield has been left here.

edesc.desc:
You see a nicely crafted shield painted white and embossed with a green
sword on its face.

5725.l: A chain mail shirt lies here.

5727.l: A tiny metal key has been placed here.

5728.l: A student's spell book lies here.

edesc.desc:
Index

Page-1
Page-2
Page-3
Page-4
Page-5

Dancing Lights Spell

Magikal blah blah ...

Read Magic Spell

BLah blah...

Sleep Spell

Zzzzzzzzzz......

Shocking Grasp Spell

How electrifying!

Wizard Lock Spell

Lock em down ....

5730.l: A man in nightclothes is frozen in combat here.

edesc.desc:
He appears to have been engaged in combat before something froze them
in place.  All attempt to affect him is to naught.  A jeweled band
hangs at an odd angle from his head.

5731.l: A man in nightclothes is frozen in combat here.

edesc.desc:
He appear to have been engaged in combat before something froze them
in place.  All attempts to affect him are for naught.

5732.l: An engraved platinum medallion has been placed here.

5733.l: A polished red orb is resting here.

5734.l: There is a silvery breast plate on the floor.

edesc.desc:
On the breast plate you a relief of a griffin.  The metal seems to
be some kind of silver or platinum.

5735.l: A small wood carving knife has been stuck here.

edesc.desc: A small bladed knife used for carving wood.

5736.l: A large round shield has been left here.

edesc.desc:
It is made from hardwoods that have been re-inforced with heavy
iron bands.

5739.l: A carved hill giant stands here.

5740.l: A jeweled dagger with a long thin blade is here.

edesc.desc:
The dagger looks usable as a weapon, but was probably used for ceremonial
purposes. It is inset with many small semi-precious stones.

5800.l: A breast plate of high quality has been left here.

edesc.desc:
This breast plate has been forged by a fine armourer in the midlands and
looks to be very durable.

5801.l: Someone has left a pair of unusual leggings lying here.

edesc.desc: They are made from a durable metal and look to be very protective.

5802.l: A pair of D'haran boots have been carelessly left here.

edesc.desc:
These boots are the boots of a true warrior.  They look to already
have been battle hardened even though the shopkeeper swears they are
new.

5803.l: A pair of white bracers have been left lying here.

edesc.desc:
These bracers are meant to be worn on your arms and are the bracers that
confessors wear as they travel the midlands.  They are of the palest
white you have ever seen.

5804.l: A rather odd looking scroll written on a muddy parchment lies here.

5805.l: Someone has left a sword of a confessor lying here.

edesc.desc:
This was the sword of a confessor, how the shopkeeper got a hold of it
you have no idea.

5806.l: A babbling brook flows gently by here.

edesc.desc: This brook flows gently by you.  It looks safe enough to drink from.

rms.name: A Worn Path In The Forest

5807.l: A small fountain is here shooting water into the air.

edesc.desc:
The air smells of salt for some reason.  This water doesn't look quite
as refreshing as you would think.

5808.l: A huge tooth is just lying on the ground.

edesc.desc:
This is the tooth of a dragon and not a gift to be taken lightly.  It
has magical properties about it, but what, you do not know.

5809.l: Some type of strange looking rock has been left here.

edesc.desc:
This rock radiates an intense magical power.  It is a special rock from
the most powerful wizard in the land.

5810.l: A spear all covered in mud has been left here.

edesc.desc:
This spear is of excellent quality.  It looks to have killed many a
creature in it's time.

7001.s: a shot of wheat grass juice
7001.l: A shot of dark green liquid rests here.

7002.l: An ornate key on a leather thong, depicting a naked young boy, lies here.

7003.l: An oddly shaped slender piece of metal lies here.

edesc.desc:
It has an odd shape and upon close examination, has tiny magikal
runes over most of the surface. It is extremely lightweight for its
size and is of some sort of dull brushed metal.

7004.l: A large, simple steel key was left here.

7005.l: An old, broken beer tap has been discarded here.

7006.l: A well-tuned meat cleaver has been carefully set here.

edesc.desc:
Polished to perfection, honed to a razor-edged sharpness, this sucker
is well suited to seperating body parts from bodies.

7007.l: A sweat-stained balanced bo stick lies here.

edesc.desc:
It's about a foot to a foot-and-a-half long and seems to be well-used,
judging by the polished feel of the wood and the dark stains marking it.
Hefting it, you find the balance to be exceptional. The owner of this
weapon sure knows his craft.

7008.l: A beautifully wrought hair-clasp has been dropped here.

edesc.desc:
It is a beautiful work of art, a magnificent array of fine details carved
intricately into a silvery metal. Given it's fine nature, it is likely
that it is of elven design.

7009.l: A badly dented breastplate lies abandoned here.

7010.l: A small jeweled cloak-pin has been set here.

7011.l: A leather bracer with bits of metal wired to it sits here.

edesc.desc:
A cheaply made leather bracer that has been modified by wiring bits of 
metal and scraps to it in an attempt to make it stronger.

7012.l: A heavy leather belt lies coiled here.

7013.l: A pair of fine calf-skin leather gloves rest here.

edesc.desc: A pait of baby soft calf-skin gloves.

7014.l: A simple leather sling was dropped here.

7015.l: A smooth rounded pebble lies here.

7016.l: A small vial of tar-like black fluid has been dropped here.

edesc.desc:
Small and tacky, this is the extracted concentrate of the black lotus fruit.
It can be eaten, heated and injected with bamboo shoots, or smoked. Most 
usally it is smoked as that is the quickest method with best effect.

7017.l: A strange smelling murky brew sits here.

7018.l: A long and twisted staff of an unknown material lies here.

7019.l: A brittle yellowed scroll rests here.

7020.l: A large pouch on a heavy leather thong lies crumpled on the ground.

7021.l: A slender rapier has been set here.

edesc.desc: Crafted by Feinweir Bakdralash, Master Weaponer

Carefully crafted, this slender weapon is ineffectual in the hand of the
uninitiated, and deadly in the hands of the skilled. Made of many layers
of folded steel, the strength of the thin blade is surprisingly resilient.
A fine wire-mesh basket protects the hands of the wielder and provides
a guard with which to break the opponents blade. There is an inscriptions
along the blade.

7022.l: A crimson silken sash lies crumpled on the ground.

7023.l: A soft, supple vest made of scales was dropped here.

edesc.desc:
Made from some sort of reptilian creature, the vest is amazingly soft and
supple, yet virtually resistant to piercing and slashing.

7024.l: A large, and heavy, iron chest rest here.

edesc.desc: Made completely of iron, the chest is rather, ummm, impenetrable.

7025.l: A fat, oblong wand sits here.

7026.l: A large pile of golden Imperials is heaped here.

7027.l: A heavy golden baton has been tossed here.

7028.l: A nasty white, pulpy root lays here.

7916.l: A holy-looking longsword lies here glowing radiantly.

7917.l: A small vial of holy oils lies here glowing faintly.

7950.l: A daemonic helm, radiating with power, lies here on the ground.

edesc.desc:
The helm glows a soft red and has been constructed from the skull of a
lesser daemon.

7951.l: A set of daemonic greaves glows softly nearby.

edesc.desc:
The greaves have been constructed from the thick hide of a lesser daemon
and should offer some protection.

7952.l: A set of daemonic sleeves has been discarded here.

edesc.desc:
The sleeves have been constructed from the thick hide of a lesser daemon
and should offer some protection.

7953.l: A magnificent breastplate made from dragon scales has been left here.

edesc.desc:
This piece is remarkable! It glows with a mystical brightness and seems to
reflect the majority of the ambient light. It is rather heavy but should
afford you great protection from your foes.

7954.l: A spectral orb shimmers softly on the ground.

edesc.desc:
The orb changes its color the closer you get to it and it begins to pulse
rapidly.

7955.l: A set of serpentine armlets lie here.

edesc.desc:
These armlets are actually a pair of ebony and ivory anacondas dancing in
circles around one another, flicking forked tongues in a spiraling duel. At
the top of the entangled serpents are clips to attach to the arm, with a small
bronze plate to protect them and the lower shoulders. The armlets are
certainly lighter and flashier than most mail, but provide adequate protection
at best.

8000.l: A beer barrel has been left here.

8001.l: A cask of beer has been left here.

8002.l: A dark bottle of ale has been left here.

8003.l: A clear bottle with a dragon's head on the label lies here.

8004.l: A dark bottle has been left here.

8005.l: A tin cup lies here in the dust.

8006.l: A beltpouch lies on the ground.

8007.l: A small ring of gold lies here.

edesc.desc:
Inscribed on the inside in flowing script are the words:
"Forever in Love"

8008.l: A runed, golden necklace lies here.

edesc.desc: The necklace is inscribed with a minor rune of protection.

8010.l: A loaf of bread lies here.

8011.l: A nice looking delicious danish pastry has been placed here.

8012.l: A shiny canteen lies on the ground.

8015.l: A rather dubious looking piece of meat is on the ground here.

edesc.desc:
It's not so much that the meat looks poisoned or anything, but that you
just are not sure of it's origins.  You doubt that a hunter would drop a
side of venison or rabbit meat... what in the world could this meat have
come from, you wonder...

8019.l: A frayed tunic is lying on the ground.

8020.l: A dagger with a long thin blade is here.

edesc.desc: It says: "May this sword be a good companion."
The small sword seems to have an inscription of some sort inscription...

8022.l: A long sword has been left here.

8023.l: A simple looking wooden club is here.

8024.l: A medium sized warhammer is here.

8027.l: A set of lockpicks have been left here.

edesc.desc:
It's a set of wires and strangely-shaped ribbons of metal fastened together
by a steel ring. With these and a little bit of skill, you could pick most
anything.

8028.l: A mangled set of lockpicks lie here.

edesc.desc: They're broken beyond repair, and certainly beyond use.

8034.l: An automatic teller machine has been installed in the wall here.

edesc.desc:
There is a small note on the machine which says:

To use, type "BALANCE", "WITHDRAW x", or "DEPOSIT x".  Please report any
strange occurrences to the bank manager.

rms.name: The Fourth Floor of a Tall Tower

8035.l: A large fountain carved from blue-streaked marble is here, bubbling merrily.

edesc.desc:
It is very beautiful white marble, shot through with electric blue streaks
that look almost like lightning dancing along the sides of the fountain.

8036.l: A small, sharp dagger is on the ground here.

8037.l: A shiny short sword is here.

8038.l: A well-used backpack lies in the dirt here.

edesc.desc:
It's a leather pack, well-used yet still operational; the flap on top
opens and closes securely.

8040.l: A breast plate is lying on the ground.

8041.l: A chain mail shirt is lying on the ground.

8042.l: A small wooden shield is lying on the ground.

8045.l: A scale mail jacket is lying on the ground.

8046.l: A bronze breast plate is lying on the ground.

edesc.desc:
The scroll has a magic formula drawn upon it:
     ???
    ?   ?
       ?
      ?
      ?
      *

8051.s: a yellow potion of see invisible
8051.l: A small yellow potion has carelessly been left here.

edesc.desc: The potion has a small label 'Detect The Invisible'.

8052.l: A scroll has carelessly been left here.

edesc.desc: The scroll has written a formulae of 'Word of Recall' upon it.

8053.l: A wand has carelessly been left here.

edesc.desc:
The wand is an old dark stick.  You notice a small symbol etched at the
base of the wand.  It looks like this:

     \ /
    - O -
     / \

8054.l: A staff has carelessly been left here.

edesc.desc:
The staff is made of old oak, and is around five feet long. It fits
perfectly into your hand. You notice a small symbol etched at the
base of the staff, it looks like:

  ZZZZZ
     Z
    Z
   Z
  ZZZZZ  z   z

8055.l: A staff has carelessly been left here.

edesc.desc: The staff is made of metals unknown to you.

8060.l: A raft has been left here.

edesc.desc: The raft looks very primitive.

8061.l: A canoe has been left here.

edesc.desc: The canoe is fairly light.

8062.l: A beautiful multicolored mushroom has been left on the ground.

8063.l: A leather water skin has been left here.

8064.l: A large board filled with items for sale or trade hangs from the wall.

8065.l: A holy looking bulletin board has been mounted on a wall here.

8066.l: A large chest sits here, inscribed with dozens of magick runes.

edesc.desc:
It is covered in dozens of magick runes; some you recognize as common warding
symbols, some as sigils of strength and permanence. Other symbols on the 
chest almost glow with a light of their own... The chest itself looks
extremely heavy and unbreakable.

8067.l: A golden weapons cabinet takes up most of the wall.

edesc.desc:
Almost head high and twice as wide, this cabinet is a tribute to dwarven
craftsmanship. The exterior is gold foil, inlaid with precious stones and 
etched with scenes of battle. The glass front is of such quality it could
only have been created by magic, and the felt-lined interior can hold dozens
of weapons.

8068.l: An armor display case is mounted in the stone here.

edesc.desc:
It is mounted about a foot off the floor, and rises just above eye-level.
Housed within it are stands for suits of armor, shields and helms, and the
entire case itself seems a tribute to prowess in war.

8086.l: A pair of leather sleeves is lying on the ground.

It is very beautiful white marble, shot through with electric blue streaks
that look almost like lightning dancing along the sides of the fountain.
